releases.name: Ketvoice for Windows 2.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice for Windows 2.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A new Ketvoice for the computer: a liquid glass window that moves with your screen's refresh rate, a far stronger Ketmix on desktop PCs, your account connected everywhere, and sources you add yourself.

## A new window

- **Liquid glass**: the sidebar, the player and the side panel float over the page in real glass that bends the light at its edges. A soft lens follows the cursor over buttons and tabs.
- **The player is an island** at the bottom of the window. Click it and it unfolds into the full player in one motion, cover and all.
- **A full-frame Home** opens on what you play most, with the rest below.
- **A side panel** for lyrics, the queue, the artist, Ketmix and listening together, open next to any page.
- **Smooth everywhere**: pages slide in on springs, scrolling glides, and animations follow 120 Hz and 144 Hz screens. Reduced motion is respected.
- **Compact player**: a small window that stays on top of the others. Press Ctrl+M or use the tray menu.
- Your colours, fonts, sidebar, Home and player buttons from 1.2 carry over to the new window.

## Ketmix, at full power on desktop PCs

- **Ketmix power**: Auto, Balanced or Maximum. On Auto, a desktop PC gets the large models below and a laptop keeps today's lighter ones, so its battery and fans stay calm.
- **Studio-quality voice separation**, a full beat and downbeat model, neural key detection, energy curves, song structure (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro) and sound similarity, so Ketmix picks better moments and better next songs.
- **Graphics card acceleration** when your card supports it, with a silent fallback to the processor.
- **Your library is prepared while the PC is idle**, so mixes are ready before you press play.
- **Live mix view**: watch both songs, their beats and every move Ketmix makes during a transition.
- **Ketmix learns** (optional): rate a transition up or down and Ketmix leans towards what you like.
- The models download once, on request, and are checked before use.

## Your account, connected

- **Connections page**: Discord, Last.fm and ListenBrainz in one place, with their status.
- **Discord**: show what you are listening to on your Discord profile, with a link to the song. You can hide the title.
- **Scrobbling** to Last.fm and ListenBrainz, kept offline and sent later when you are not connected.
- **Live sync**: pick up on the computer where you left off on the phone, and the other way round.
- **Connected devices**: see where you are signed in, move playback to another device, or sign a device out from here.
- **Sign in with a QR code**: scan it with your phone or type the code on the website; no password to type on the computer.
- **Several profiles on one PC**, each with its own library and settings.
- **No telemetry**: nothing about how you use Ketvoice is sent anywhere. A My data page shows what leaves your PC, exports everything your account holds, and can delete your account.

## Together

- **Listening rooms** on the computer, shared with phones: host or join with a code or a link, react, and let others add songs.
- **A profile of your own**: photo, banner, bio, colour, and what you are playing, your artists of the month and pinned playlists, each visible to you, your friends or everyone.
- **Friends and their activity** (optional): see what your friends are playing and join their room.
- **Share links** for songs, albums, playlists and profiles open in the app on Windows and Android, and show a clean page everywhere else.

## Sources and playback

- **Sources page**: add a source by the address of its manifest, test it, turn it on or off and set its order. Your sources follow your account. A catalogue lists sources you can add in one click.
- **Smart cache**: the songs you are likely to play next start almost instantly.
- **Exclusive mode** (optional): bit-perfect playback straight to your audio device.
- **True gapless** (optional): live albums and continuous mixes play with no gap at all.

## Lyrics and library

- **Word-by-word sync by AI** on desktop PCs: lyrics that only had lines get each word timed to the voice. You can always go back to the original timing.
- **More lyrics sources at once**, the best timing first, and your choice of source for each song.
- **Live translation and romanisation**, with the translation under each line if you want.
- **Floating lyrics** (optional): a transparent band on your desktop that lights up as the words are sung. Lock it and clicks go through it.
- **One-click import** of an outside playlist, with a report of what was found, what is uncertain and what is missing, and a way to fix each song.
- **Follow an outside playlist**: new songs are added for you or offered.
- **Drag and drop anywhere**: links, audio files, folders, lyrics files and source manifests.
- **Watched folders**: songs you add to your music folders appear in Ketvoice on their own.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-2.0.0.msi` below and open it. It installs over Ketvoice for Windows 1.2.0, 1.1.0 or 1.0.0 and keeps your library, settings and downloads. It works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown: choose "More info", then "Run anyway". If you already use Ketvoice for Windows, it can also offer the update itself.

releases.name: Ketvoice word sync model v1
releases.body:
Word sync by AI for desktop PCs (Windows 2.0, Ketmix power set to Maximum): OpenAI Whisper small (MIT code
and weights), converted to ONNX for aligning known lyrics on the separated voice. Downloaded by the app on request
and checked against its SHA-256; not an app version. Converted and checked by
.github/workflows/publish-ketvoice-align.yml; licences in LICENSES.md.

- ketvoice-align-encoder.onnx: 30 s of 16 kHz mono → encoder features (log-mel in the graph).
- ketvoice-align-decoder.onnx: tokens + features → alignment heads' cross-attention, next-token probabilities, language logits.
- ketvoice-align-vocab.tiktoken: Whisper's multilingual byte-pair ranks.

releases.name: Ketmix PC models v1
releases.body:
Optional large models of Ketmix for desktop PCs (Windows 2.0, « Puissance de Ketmix » → Maximum). Downloaded by
the app on request and checked against their SHA-256; not an app version. Converted and checked by
.github/workflows/publish-ketmix-pc-models.yml; licences in LICENSES.md (all permissive: MIT and Apache-2.0).

- ketmix-beat-final0.onnx: Beat This! final0 (Foscarin, Schlüter, Widmer, ISMIR 2024; MIT). [1, 1500, 128] log-mel → beat, downbeat logits.
- ketmix-voice-melroformer.onnx: Mel-Band RoFormer vocal model by Kimberley Jensen (MIT), architecture from ZFTurbo's Music-Source-Separation-Training (MIT). STFT outside the graph.
- ketmix-key-skey.onnx: S-KEY (Kong et al., Deezer, ICASSP 2025; MIT). Mono 22.05 kHz → 24 key probabilities.
- ketmix-sound-clap-int8.onnx: LAION CLAP for music, audio encoder (Apache-2.0), int8. 10 s mono 48 kHz → 512-d embedding.

releases.name: Ketvoice 9.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 9.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketvoice becomes yours: your colours, your font, your corners, your tabs, your Home, your player buttons and your menus. Plus a headphone equalizer that follows your headphones, and an editor to time lyrics yourself. Left untouched, Ketvoice looks and behaves exactly as before.

## Personalisation

A new “Personalisation” page in Settings, with a live preview at the top.

- **Your theme**: set the background, surfaces, text and accent colours for light and dark mode with a full colour picker, or start from seven ready-made themes. Text always stays readable: a colour that would be too faint is adjusted just enough, and the page tells you.
- **Share a theme**: copy your theme as a short code and paste a friend's code to try theirs.
- **Font, size and corners**: choose among five fonts, make the text smaller or larger without changing the rest of your phone, go from square to very round corners, and pick compact, normal or airy lists.
- **Lyrics your way**: their font, size and alignment, the colour of the word being sung, and how strong the blur and the word movement are.
- **Layout**:
  - Choose and reorder two to five tabs, now including Downloads and Favourites.
  - Show, hide and reorder every section of Home; a long press on the greeting opens the editor right there.
  - Choose the buttons of the player's bottom row and up to two extra buttons on the mini player, make the artwork a little smaller or larger, and turn the Canvas off in the player.
  - Pick list or grid and a default order for your playlists, albums, artists and songs, reorder or hide the items of a song's menu, and choose what a swipe left or right on a song does.
- “Reset everything” and “Reset the layout” bring back the original look in one tap.

## Headphone EQ

- Import a headphone correction (the common parametric EQ text format, from a file or pasted), link it to your headphones, and Ketvoice applies it every time they are connected, Ketmix blends and the voice level included. A toggle lets you hear the difference.

## Lyrics editor

- “Edit lyrics…” in a song's menu and in the lyrics sources: paste or load the words, then tap in rhythm to time each line, or each word in word mode. Nudge a time, undo, and preview the result in the real lyrics view.
- Save the timing for yourself, or export it as an LRC file.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-9.0.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-9.0.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-9.0.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 8.4.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 8.4.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A new glass look called Crystal, Ketvoice in the car the way you would expect it, a Ketmix that bridges any two tempos, and a set of everyday helpers: the audio output you want, a search in Settings, playlists that stay up to date and a year recap with its own soundtrack.

## Crystal

- **A second glass look**: pick “Glass style” in the Glass settings and choose Crystal. The tab bar, the mini player, the selection pill and the menus take a new clear glass, with its own springs, a pill that lifts, stretches and lands, and menus that bloom from the button. Liquid 27 stays the default and is unchanged.

## In the car

- **Voice**: ask Google to play an artist, a song, an album, a genre or one of your playlists on Ketvoice, to play your likes or your downloads, to start a radio from an artist or a song, or just to play some music to pick up where you left off.
- **A real library on the car screen**: Home with your mixes and shelves, Library (playlists, albums, artists, songs, likes and downloads), Radio and Downloads, with covers, “Play all” and “Shuffle” at the top of every list.
- **The whole queue** shows on the car screen, and a tap jumps to any song in it.
- **Buttons on the playing screen**: like, shuffle, repeat, a radio from the current song and Ketmix on or off. They also appear in the phone's media controls.
- Downloads stay browsable and playable without a connection, and covers you have seen once keep showing offline.

## Ketmix

- **Loop bridge**: a new transition for two songs far apart in tempo. The outgoing song hands over to a four-bar instrumental loop, both songs glide together to the new tempo while staying on the beat, and the next song comes in on its own instrumental bars. Ketmix picks it by itself when the tempos are too far apart for a normal blend, and you can choose it in Ketmix Studio.
- **Tighter beats**: beats are now placed between the analysis frames instead of on a 20 ms grid, so blends land closer to the beat.

## Everyday

- **Audio output**: the audio output sheet now lists your real outputs (Bluetooth, wired, USB, the phone's speaker, hearing aids) and sends Ketvoice's sound to the one you pick, live as devices come and go.
- **Search in Settings**: type at the top of Settings to find any option, with or without accents; a tap opens it and highlights it.
- **Downloaded playlists stay up to date**: when a playlist you downloaded gets new songs, a notification offers to download just those. You can turn it off in the Downloads settings.
- **A soundtrack for your year recap**: each card of the recap plays the best part of its song and fades into the next one. Your own queue, history and statistics are left untouched, and a button mutes it.
- **Hosting a Ketogether session**: set how many people can join (2 to 10), remove a listener, see who stepped away with their place kept, follow a short log of who paused, skipped or added a song, and check how close everyone is in sync.
- **Lyrics source order**: put the lyrics sources in the order you prefer in the lyrics settings; the first one that has the lyrics wins.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-8.4.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-8.4.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-8.4.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice for Windows 1.2.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice for Windows 1.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Make Ketvoice your own on the computer: your colours, font, text size and corners, lyrics in your style, the sidebar, Home, player buttons, library and menus you want. It also brings an equaliser for each pair of headphones, a choice of audio output, a lyrics editor and the newest Ketmix.

## Personalisation

- **Your colours**: pick the colours of the page, the cards, the text and the accent, or start from a preset. Ketvoice keeps text readable whatever you choose. Share a theme with a code, and use a code made on the phone.
- **Font, size and corners**: five fonts, text from 85 % to 130 %, corners from square to very round, and three list densities.
- **Lyrics in your style**: font, size, centred or left-aligned, the colour of the line being sung, how much the other lines blur and how much they move.
- Everything follows your Ketvoice account, so the look you set on your phone comes to the computer, and the other way round. Leave everything as it is and Ketvoice looks exactly as before.

## Layout

- **Sidebar**: choose and order its entries. Search, Downloads and Favourites can have entries of their own.
- **Home**: order and hide its sections.
- **Player bar**: choose two to five buttons on the right, in your order. Like, add to a playlist and download are new choices.
- **Library**: albums and artists as a grid or a list, and the order each page opens with.
- **Title menu**: order and hide its items.
- **Search in Settings**: type a few letters at the top of Settings to jump to the right option.

## Listening

- **Equaliser for each pair of headphones**: import a parametric profile file for your headphones, link it to an audio output, and Ketvoice corrects the sound whenever music plays there. Compare with and without the correction at any time.
- **Choose the audio output**: send music to any speaker or headset connected to the computer, straight from the player bar. Ketvoice remembers it and comes back to it when it is plugged in again.
- **Ketmix loop bridge**: Ketmix can now loop a bar to bridge two songs of very different tempo, and the bar loop of the phone plays on the computer too.
- Ketmix now knows where each song is sung, from its lyrics, and plans its transitions around the voice.
- **Downloaded playlists stay up to date**: when a playlist you downloaded gains new titles, Ketvoice offers to download them.
- Choose the order in which Ketvoice looks for lyrics.

## Lyrics

- Words fill at an even pace with a softer edge, held notes come to life letter by letter, and the lines around the one being sung are gently softened.
- **Lyrics editor**: time the lyrics of any song yourself, line by line or word by word, while it plays. Press Space to set each time, use the arrows to adjust, Ctrl+Z to undo, and preview the result before you save. You can also export the timed lyrics as a file.
- The player artwork and the Canvas take the height of their own shape, and the Canvas fills its column edge to edge.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-1.2.0.msi` below and open it. It installs over Ketvoice 1.1.0 or 1.0.0 and keeps your library, settings and downloads. It works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown: choose “More info”, then “Run anyway”. If you already use Ketvoice for Windows, it can also offer the update itself.

releases.name: Ketvoice 8.3.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 8.3.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Smoother lyrics that come alive on held notes, a player artwork sized to what it shows, and glass that is lighter, cleaner and more physical.

## Lyrics

- **Smoother word fill**: each word lights up at an even pace, with a soft leading edge instead of a hard line. A word lifts by how long it is sung, then settles back.
- **Held notes come alive**: on a long note, the letters swell one after another with a soft glow, then return to rest when the note ends.
- **Focus on the line being sung**: lines further away soften with a light blur, which clears as soon as you scroll the lyrics yourself. You can turn it off with “Lyrics blur” in the lyrics settings.
- Backing vocals open under the line with a small rise, and the three dots now also wait through every instrumental break of four seconds or more.

## Player

- **The artwork takes its own shape**: the cover or the Canvas fills the width of the player and takes the height that suits it, down to the song's title. A square cover is shown whole, and a tall Canvas loses far less.
- Moving from a cover to a Canvas, or from one song to the next, resizes the artwork smoothly.

## Glass

- **Lighter glass**: the blur behind the glass is computed on a smaller picture and scaled back up, so the tab bar, menus and sheets cost much less to draw while looking the same.
- **Cleaner glass**: menus, sheets and alerts now open over a still picture of the page, so what is behind them no longer shimmers while they grow. Over a playing Canvas the glass stays live.
- **A tab bar that moves like a drop**: when you change tab, the selection lifts off the bar, stretches with its speed, bends the glass under it and settles back flat.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-8.3.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-8.3.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-8.3.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 8.2.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 8.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A player background that moves with the colours of the artwork, livelier lyrics, featured cards on Home, and Ketvoice that adapts itself to your battery, your phone's heat and your Wi-Fi.

## Look

- **A living player background**: the colours of the artwork now flow slowly behind the player, like a soft gradient, instead of a fixed blurred picture. It rests when the Canvas plays, with reduced motion and in performance mode.
- **Livelier lyrics**: lines settle into place on springs, the word being sung grows very slightly, and the lines already sung fade softly. Duets keep their sides, and a held note still glows a little.
- **Featured on Home**: large cards at the top of Home. The card in the middle plays its Canvas silently; the others wait, so the row stays light.

## Faster and lighter

- The startup profile now covers the parts of the app used most (opening the app, Home, the player, lists and playback), so the phone prepares them when it installs Ketvoice.
- On Wi-Fi, Ketvoice gets ready for what you are likely to open next: the album and artist of the song playing, the covers of the next songs and of the first Home rows.
- **Automatic power saving**: when the battery is at 20 % or less without charging, or when the phone gets hot, Ketvoice switches to performance mode on its own and tells you, then switches back. You can turn this off in Settings.

## Diagnostic

- A new “Diagnostic” switch in Settings, under About, records how the app runs on your phone: dropped frames, start time, time to the first sound, how long Home, search and pages take, and memory. “Share the diagnostic” gives you the file to send if you report a slowdown. It is off by default, nothing is ever sent on its own, and the file holds no song titles, searches or account details.

## Ketmix

- Your Ketmix Studio presets now follow your Ketvoice account, so the presets you save on your phone are also on your other devices, including Ketvoice for Windows.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-8.2.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-8.2.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-8.2.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 8.1.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 8.1.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A faster Ketvoice: smoother scrolling and player animations, a Home that comes up at once, quicker searches and pages, the Canvas back edge to edge, and control of Ketvoice for Windows from your phone.

## Smoother

- Scrolling Home with the tab bar folding, and opening or closing the full player, now redraw far less of the screen at every frame. The glass, the fold and the player animation look the same.
- Phone control reads its settings away from the screen, so opening the player never waits on it.

## Faster

- The Home sections from your YouTube Music account appear at once from the copy kept last time, then refresh. “New from your artists” loads about three times faster.
- Playing a song again, or going back to the previous one, starts much sooner.
- Searching the same thing twice answers immediately, and searches no longer ask the same source twice.
- Album and artist pages start loading as soon as you touch them.
- The Canvas of the song on screen comes before the ones prepared ahead, so it shows about twice as fast.
- Ketvoice opens with less work on the screen's thread.

## Player

- The Canvas fills the top of the player and the album header edge to edge again, as before 7.6, instead of being shown whole with stretched colours around it.
- In the lyrics or the queue, a tap on the small cover in the header brings you back to the player.

## Your devices

- A new “Your devices” section in the audio output sheet shows Ketvoice running on your other devices, including Ketvoice for Windows. See what plays there, change songs, the position and the volume, or move playback from one device to the other.
- It works between devices signed in to the same Ketvoice account, through a private key that only your devices know.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-8.1.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-8.1.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-8.1.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay. Ketvoice for Windows is on the [Windows release](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/tag/windows-v1.0.0).

releases.name: Ketvoice 8.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 8.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Glass that really bends light, menus that grow out of what you touch, a player that folds into the lyrics, Ketmix Studio and live statistics.

## Liquid Glass

- **Refractive glass**: the tab bar, the mini player, glass buttons, menus and sheets bend what passes under them, with a lens at the edges and a faint colour fringe on the rim. On Android 13 and up, the performance mode now keeps a lighter version of it instead of turning it off.
- **A tab bar that melts**: as you scroll, the tabs slide together into one capsule showing the current tab, following the speed of your scroll; tap it to bring them back.

## Motion

- **Menus that grow out of the button**: song menus, ⋯ menus, sheets and alerts open from the control you touched and fold back into it.
- **Springs everywhere**: page transitions, menus, selections and controls move on springs, so an animation you interrupt continues from where it is, without a jump.
- **Icons that react**: next and previous slide, the repeat icon changes shape, the Ketmix badge breathes during a mix, tabs bounce when you pick them and the bell rings when you turn on alerts.

## Player and lyrics

- **The player folds into the lyrics**: when you open the lyrics or the queue, the artwork slides into a small header next to the title in one continuous movement, and grows back when you close them. You can also drag the artwork up.
- **Duets**: when a featured singer takes over, their lines move to the other side, like Apple Music. Lines follow the singer information of the lyrics, or verse headers that name the featured artist.

## Ketmix Studio

- The mix editor opens full screen as Ketmix Studio, with undo and redo, a beat magnet and a visible “+ Point” button to place a volume point at the playhead.
- Pinch to zoom into the waveforms and pan with two fingers.
- **My presets**: save a transition you like, then apply it to other songs, rename or delete it.
- **Share a mix**: send a mix as a short code; your friend pastes it into their editor.

## Statistics

- A new Statistics page, always up to date: minutes this week, month or year compared with the period before, top artists, songs and genres, listening by hour, your streak, new artists and Ketmix mixes.
- Share “My top 5” and “My minutes” as images.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-8.0.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-8.0.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-8.0.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice for Windows 1.1.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice for Windows 1.1.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Windows 11 glass, a full-screen player, buttons in the taskbar preview, Ketmix Studio on the computer, voices ready before you play, and a lighter, smoother app.

## Look

- **Windows 11 glass**: the window takes the Mica material of Windows 11, and the sidebar and the player bar become frosted glass above it. On Windows 10, with transparency effects off, in high contrast or when you turn it off in Settings, Ketvoice keeps its solid colours.
- **Full-screen player**: press F11 or the button in the player. The cover or the Canvas fills the left side, the lyrics scroll on the right, over the colours of the artwork. Esc brings the window back.
- **Taskbar preview**: hover Ketvoice in the taskbar to see the cover, with previous, play/pause and next buttons under it.
- The lyrics move like on the phone 8.2: lines settle into place on springs and the word being sung grows very slightly.

## Ketmix

- **Ketmix Studio on the computer**: see both songs as waves, move and stretch the transition, draw the volume of the music and the voice with key points, undo and redo, listen to a preview, and save presets. Share a transition with a code, and use a code made on the phone.
- Your Studio presets follow your Ketvoice account, so the ones you save on your phone are here too, and the other way round.
- **Voices ready ahead**: while the computer is plugged in, Ketvoice prepares the voice separation of your downloaded songs in the background, so the voice level slider and Ketmix vocal transitions start at once.

## Faster and lighter

- Ketvoice draws with Direct3D in step with your screen, for smoother scrolling and animations. If Direct3D cannot start, it falls back on its own.
- Less memory: covers in memory are capped and decoded no larger than needed, and Ketvoice gives unused memory back to Windows when it sits in the notification area.
- Ketvoice keeps a cache of its own code in its data folder after the first start, which Java reads at every later start.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-1.1.0.msi` below and open it. It installs over Ketvoice 1.0.0 and keeps your library, settings and downloads. It works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown: choose “More info”, then “Run anyway”. If you already use Ketvoice 1.0.0, it can also offer the update itself.

releases.name: Ketvoice for Windows 1.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice for Windows 1.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The first version of Ketvoice for Windows. It is a native app with the same library, Ketmix, lyrics and account as the phone, laid out for a computer: a sidebar, a player bar at the top and pages you can resize.

## Listening

- Streams and downloads play through FFmpeg, with gapless playback, a 10-band equalizer and a Lossless or Hi-Res badge when the file really is one.
- Downloads work offline, show their progress live and can be upgraded to a better quality, one song at a time.
- Local music: choose folders on your computer and their songs appear under Songs, Albums and Artists.
- The Windows media controls, the media keys and the notification area all drive the player. Closing the window can leave Ketvoice playing in the notification area.
- A mini player that stays on top of other windows (Ctrl+M).

## Ketmix

- Songs mix into each other on two decks, planned by the same analysis as on the phone: beat matching with the pitch kept, a bass swap, filters, echo, and a gentle return to the original tempo afterwards.
- Skipping a song can mix it instead of cutting it.
- Optional voice separation: cut or keep the vocals in a transition, and a voice level slider beside the lyrics, like on the phone.
- The optional rhythm and voice models download once and are checked before use.

## Lyrics and Canvas

- Synced lyrics word by word, with duets on each side, translation, and a romanization switch at the top of the lyrics sources. Click a line to jump to it.
- Animated Canvas videos in the full player and as a motion header at the top of album pages, kept on your computer once played.
- The full player's background moves with the colours of the artwork.

## Your account

- Sign in with email or Discord, and your favourites, playlists and settings follow you between the phone, the web and the computer.
- Control your phone from the computer and the computer from your phone: see what plays, change songs, the position and the volume, or move playback from one to the other.
- A live Statistics page: your minutes, top songs and artists, and when you listen.
- Import playlists from Apple Music, Tidal, SoundCloud, Spotify and Deezer links.

## Everywhere

- Search ranked like on the phone, complete artist and album pages, and “Play next” and “Add to playlist” in every menu.
- Keyboard shortcuts: space to play or pause, arrows to seek and change the volume, Ctrl+F to search, and more, listed in Settings.
- All 11 interface languages, switched without a restart.
- Updates: Ketvoice checks for new Windows versions, verifies the download and installs it over the current version.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-1.0.0.msi` below and open it. It works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). Windows may warn that the publisher is unknown: choose “More info”, then “Run anyway”. To remove Ketvoice, use Installed apps in Windows Settings; your library stays in your account.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.6.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.6.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Canvas shown whole and kept for good, a much lighter app, voice level while streaming, volume points in your own mixes, new Ketmix transitions and a welcome step that sets everything up.

## Canvas

- **Shown whole**: a Canvas is no longer cropped. When its shape is close to the space it fills it; otherwise it is shown complete, as large as fits, with its own edge colours filling the rest, never a dark band. Your framing still comes first.
- **Kept for good**: every song's Canvas is now saved while you listen, even with the screen off on Wi-Fi, and the next two songs in your queue are fetched ahead. Playing an album again shows each Canvas at once.
- **The right Canvas on every song**: songs of the same album no longer all show the first song's Canvas.

## Faster

- The full player and the seek bar no longer redraw the whole screen many times a second while music plays, and the mini player and tab bar do far less work.
- While paused, the app wakes up a few times a minute instead of several times a second.
- The app starts lighter: translations load in the background and Downloads read less from storage.
- Cover colours are remembered when you scroll back.

## Voice and your own mixes

- **Voice level while streaming**: the voice slider now works on songs you stream. The part you are listening to is prepared first, and the slider works as soon as it is ready; the whole song is kept for next time.
- **Volume points in the mix editor**: tap the transition to place a point, then set Voice, Instruments and Music for the first song, and swipe to set them for the second. Points can be moved or removed and are drawn on each song's lane, so you can build a real mix of your own.

## Ketmix

- **Three new transitions**: “Cut” stops the outgoing song on the beat of a phrase, “On the drop” brings the next song in at its drop, and “Vocal handoff” lets one voice step back as the other starts.
- **Cleaner mixes**: filters fade in and out instead of switching, which removes clicks; songs meet with a smaller dip in level; and the two songs together never go past full scale.

## Welcome and icon

- **Improve your listening**: a new welcome step offers the voice separation models, the rhythm model where needed and a scan of the music on your phone, each with its size and live progress. It warns you if you continue without them, and it is also in Settings.
- The GTA VI event is over; its icon is now the default app icon. Other icons stay available in Settings. Ketvoice is not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.6.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.6.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.6.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.5.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.5.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Google Cast, lyrics you can pronounce, album pages with truer colours, artwork that stays cached, faster downloads, one glass slider and a standby screen for your nightstand.

## Listen anywhere

- **Google Cast** (phone and Lite): send your music to a Google or Nest speaker, a Chromecast TV or a sound bar from « Sortie audio ». Downloads can be cast too. Ketmix, voice level and the equalizer pause while casting.
- **Romanisation**: a new switch at the top of the lyrics source menu shows how each line is pronounced in Latin letters, under the lyrics. It covers Japanese kana, Chinese (pinyin), Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi and Thai.
- **Standby mode**: while your phone charges in landscape, Ketvoice can show a large clock, the cover or Canvas, the title and the line being sung. Turn it on in Settings; Ketvoice is also offered as a system screensaver.

## Album pages

- **Truer colours**: album pages pick the colour you see on the cover, not a small detail of it. For example, The Party Never Ends is now purple, 1989 blue and black covers stay black. The player and widgets use the same colours.
- **Canvas animé**: choose it in Settings and an album with a Canvas opens like Apple Music, with the video across the whole top of the screen and the title, artist, Play and Shuffle over its fade. The former « Cover and Canvas » choice is replaced by it.
- Canvas appear at once: a still of the first frame shows while the video starts, the album keeps its Canvas when you come back, and album Canvas are fetched ahead on Wi-Fi.
- The cover is bigger, the title, artist and buttons sit closer together, and the header scrolls away with the list instead of fading out.

## Faster

- **Artwork and Canvas stay cached**: an album's Canvas shows at once the second time, without waiting for the network, and covers you have seen appear immediately.
- **Faster downloads**: large files download over several connections, and the check for a better quality stops as soon as a lossless version is found.
- **Faster Ketmix analysis**: the slowest steps of preparing a song for Ketmix are several times faster.
- **Improve one song**: « Améliorer la qualité » is now in the menu of each downloaded song, no selection needed.

## Playback

- Pausing and resuming fade in a fraction of a second instead of cutting.
- **Mix when I skip**: a new switch in Settings → Ketmix. Turn it off and Next changes song right away, even with Ketmix on.

## Glass and lists

- **One glass slider**: a single slider in Appearance goes from transparent to tinted, replacing the Clear/Tinted switch and the old transparency steps.
- **Controls that turn to glass**: while you hold the seek bar, the volume or the voice slider, a small glass lens forms under your finger.
- **Search and sort in your lists**: playlists, Favourites and Downloads have a search field and sorting by date added, title, artist, album or duration.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.5.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.5.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.5.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.4.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.4.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Two new home-screen widgets that really control your music, an immersive artist page, smoother player colours, and bigger covers on Downloads and Favourites.

## Widgets

- **Two new widgets replace the old ones**: « En cours » (2×2) and « En cours + contrôles » (4×2).
- Play, pause, previous, next and the heart work right from the home screen, without opening the app. When nothing is playing, Play picks up your last queue.
- The widgets follow playback live: the title, cover, heart and progress change as you listen, in the app, from the notification or from your headphones.
- Their background takes the colours of the cover, with text that stays readable.
- The widget picker shows a preview of each widget.

## Pages

- **Downloads and Favourites** open on a much bigger cover, and the header now scrolls away with the list instead of fading out.
- On Downloads, the ⋯ on a song opens the same menu as a long press, and the ⋯ at the top opens the page menu (select, sort).
- Song lists are airier: taller rows, softly rounded covers and thin separators that start after the cover.
- « Découvertes de la semaine » is removed.

## Artist page and player

- **Artist pages** open on the artist's photo, up to the top of the screen, with the name large over it. The photo moves gently as you scroll.
- **Player colours** no longer flash grey between songs. They glide from one song to the next, keep the cover's own hue and stay readable on white covers.
- The blurred background is smoother, without bands or hard edges, and the Canvas fades in over the cover's colours instead of showing black.
- The player opens already in the colours of the song playing, and the status bar icons stay readable over artist photos.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.4.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.4.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.4.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay. Widgets from earlier versions may need to be added again.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.3.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.3.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Select and upgrade your downloads, import playlists from Apple Music, Tidal and SoundCloud, album pages with a floating cover, a player that breathes, and a share card made for Stories.

## Downloads

- The top of Downloads is cleaner: no more « Select » button.
- **Hold a song** and choose « Sélectionner » to start selecting, then tap to add more songs.
- **Hold a selected song** to act on the whole selection: Play, Add to a playlist, Delete, or **Download again in better quality**.
- Better quality is checked song by song first. The app tells you how many can be improved (for example 128 kb/s → FLAC), downloads them in the background and replaces a file only once the new one is complete. Lyrics, Canvas and separations stay.
- A song being downloaded shows its progress as a ring filling over its cover.

## Playlist import

- Import a playlist from **Apple Music**, **Tidal** or **SoundCloud** by pasting its public link, like Spotify and Deezer already. No account or key is needed.
- Songs are matched by ISRC and length when available. When a service shows only part of a playlist publicly, the app tells you how many songs it could read.

## Albums, search and player

- **Album and playlist pages** open on a large centred cover with a soft shadow in its own colour, with Play and Shuffle below. In Settings you can choose a full-screen Canvas header, or the cover floating over its Canvas.
- Play, Shuffle, links and badges on album and artist pages take the colour of the cover, kept readable.
- **Search** opens on the songs you played recently, then your artists, then large colourful category tiles.
- **The player breathes**: the artwork eases back when you pause and springs forward when you play, and the coloured background slows down with it.
- **About this song** in the ⋯ menu shows artists, album, year, label, genre, BPM, ISRC and audio quality.

## Ketmix and sharing

- During a Ketmix mix, the mini player shows both covers crossing, with a fine wave between them.
- **Share** opens a new card with the cover, title, artist and an optional lyric line, ready for an Instagram Story or any app.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.3.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.3.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.3.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.2.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Better sound sooner, a Library laid out like Apple Music, new Favourites and Downloads pages, and search that finds what you mean.

## Home and Library

- Home reads more like Apple Music: « Reprendre » and the mix of the day side by side in one row, and a « Votre bibliothèque » shelf with Favourites, Downloads and your pinned playlists.
- The Library opens on Favourites and Downloads with their covers, then Artists, Albums, Songs, local music and Replay, then all your playlists right there.
- **Favourites** has its own page with a heart cover, the number of songs and total time, Play, Shuffle, search and three sorts.
- **Downloads** has a cover made of four different album covers from your latest downloads.
- **Lossless** and **Hi-Res Lossless** badges appear in the player, in song rows and in downloads when the file really is lossless.
- At the end of an album or playlist, « Titres recommandés » suggests songs by the same artist and in the same style.

## Sound

- **Better quality really kicks in**: the app now switches to the better stream once it is ready, smoothly, including for songs brought in by Ketmix.
- **Songs start faster**: the first sound gets the connection to itself; the next songs, the full copy and a missing Canvas wait a few seconds.
- **Large Canvas take less space**: while the phone charges, big Canvas videos are saved again smaller at screen quality, and stay available offline.

## Sync and search

- The **Sync** button on your profile works again. It used to say « Offline » even on Wi-Fi; it now tells you whether you are offline, signed out or the server had an error.
- Your phone and the web player follow each other's changes: likes, playlists, name, photo and Canvas.
- **Search** puts exact titles and artists first, ignores accents, forgives a typo, groups duplicates and places karaoke or remix versions after the original.
- **Recommendations** learn from the artists you play, your likes and the songs you skip early.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.2.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.2.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.2.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.1.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.1.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix mixes more carefully, glass that stays readable, a true black theme, a compact widget and a radio that does not repeat itself.

## Ketmix

- **Endings are kept**: Ketmix no longer cuts real music off the end of a song to start a mix. When no good point fits, it makes a shorter transition instead.
- **False endings and hidden tracks**: a song that goes silent and starts again is no longer mixed inside the silence.
- **Tempo matching only when it is safe**: songs are played in time only when both beat grids are steady, and not under a voice when the tempo would have to move more than 3.5 %.
- **Songs that do not go together** change with a short fade instead of a DJ blend.
- **Two voices at once**: when two sung lines still meet, the outgoing song steps back.
- **Steady volume**: volume leveling holds still during a transition, so there is no dip or bump.
- **Listen in the editor** plays the next song again: in the transition editor, « Listen » now brings in the incoming song, with and without the mix.
- The DJ set mode is removed.

## Glass and theme

- Glass is kept for navigation: the tab bar, the mini player, the sidebar, menus and top bars. Buttons and cards in pages are solid, and glass is never stacked on glass.
- **Clear or Tinted**: a new choice above the transparency slider. Tinted is clearly more opaque, and it turns on by itself when Android's high-contrast text is on.
- Menus and sheets are much more opaque than the tab bar, so their text stays readable over any artwork.
- **Black**: a new switch under Theme for true black pages on OLED screens.

## Layout and more

- The mini player keeps « Next » when the tab bar folds, and a swipe on it changes song.
- Titles, artists and albums sorted by name get an A–Z index on the right edge.
- **New widget « Commandes »**: previous, play/pause and next, even at its smallest size.
- The radio and autoplay do not replay a song you heard in the last four hours.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.1.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.1.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.1.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 7.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 7.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A new Home made for you, music that keeps going in the same style, Downloads laid out like Apple Music, and a Ketmix DJ set. Ket 27 stays, sharper.

## A Home made for you

- **Pour toi** opens on what you were playing (« Reprendre »), a mix of the day built from your listening, moods that follow the hour, and new releases from the artists you follow.

## Ket 27, sharper

- Clearer secondary text in light mode, a steadier spacing and corner scale, one set of springs for sheets, menus and pages, and solid Play and Pause buttons.

## Music that keeps going

- **Lecture automatique**: when your queue ends, Ketvoice adds songs in the same style as the one you started, ten at a time. They come from the song's own radio; without a network, from your downloads of the same artist or style.
- Songs you add always come first. Blocked artists are left out, and no artist takes over the list.
- The queue shows these songs in their own section, with a switch and « Effacer ».

## Downloads like Apple Music

- Downloads opens on Titles, Albums, Artists and Playlists, with counts. Playlists lists those that have songs on your phone.
- A downloaded album now opens as a real album page, from Downloads or the Library: play, shuffle, the state of each song, « Télécharger les titres manquants » and « Supprimer le téléchargement ».
- Albums that are only partly downloaded say how many songs are on the device.

## Ketmix

- **The rhythm model is built in**: the phone and Quest apps now ship Ketmix's beat and bar model, so precise beat matching works right away. The Lite app still downloads it when you ask.
- **Mode DJ set**: play a playlist or your queue as a set. Ketmix orders it by tempo and key, builds the energy up to a peak and brings it down, and mixes every song, albums included.
- **Export the set** to an M4A file you can share. Only downloaded and local songs go into the file.

## Fixes

- The large Play button no longer shows a thin dark line down its middle.
- « Ouvrir dans Ketvoice » on the website's artist pages opens the artist in the app.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-7.0.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-7.0.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-7.0.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay. The phone and Quest apps are about 19 MB larger because they include the rhythm model.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.9.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.9.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A new Ketmix editor you can shape and hear, and three things only Ketmix does.

## The Ketmix editor, redone

- **One timeline**: the ending of the outgoing song lies over the start of the next one, on the same clock. The transition is a box: drag it to move the mix, pull its edges to make it longer or shorter. It still lands on the beat and the bar.
- **What you see is what plays**: the volume, the bass handoff and the filter are drawn over the waves, with the bar numbers, where each voice sings and where the lyric lines start.
- **Presets**: Auto, then every Ketmix style, each one heard at once.
- **Details**: the shape of the volume, how long the bass takes to change hands, a high-pass or low-pass filter, and whether the tempo may be matched.
- **Listen anytime**: « Listen » plays just the transition, even when that song is not playing, and « Without mix » plays the same moment as a plain cut to compare. What you were listening to resumes after.
- **Save** keeps your changes for that pair of songs; closing with changes asks first. « … » brings back Ketmix's own choice or applies your settings to the whole queue.
- Pinch or use − and + to zoom.

## Only on Ketmix

- **Mixes that respect the lyrics**: Ketmix reads the synced lyrics. A blend never cuts a sung line: the voice leaves at the end of its line, and the next song comes in just before its own line.
- **Bar loop**: when a song ends on a fade, Ketmix can loop a clean instrumental bar on the beat while the next song comes in.
- **Variety**: after two tempo blends in a row, an echo or a rise takes a turn when the songs allow it.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.9.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-6.9.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-6.9.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.8.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.8.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix can now use a small AI model to find the beat and the bars of your songs.

## Ketmix (BETA)

- **A rhythm model, on request**: in Settings → Ketmix, « Precise rhythm » downloads a small AI model (about 19 MB). It finds the beats and the first beat of every bar, so a blend can land on the bar instead of next to it.
- Without the model, Ketmix works exactly as before. With it, a title is analysed by the model when it is confident, and by Ketmix's own analysis otherwise.
- On Ketvoice Lite and on phones with little memory, the model works only while the phone charges.
- The model is Beat This! (JKU Linz, MIT license), converted by Ketvoice.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.8.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-6.8.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-6.8.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.7.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.7.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix blends more like a DJ would, Ketvoice Lite gets lighter again, and the GTA VI welcome screen is back.

## Ketmix (BETA)

- **The blend fits the pair**: two songs that need a big tempo change or sit at very different levels get a shorter blend.
- **Never two voices at once**: a blend no longer starts under the last sung words while the next song is already singing.
- **On the bar**: when the next song starts with a pickup, its first bar now lands on the phrase, and the basses swap on a downbeat.
- **Even levels**: going into a quieter song, the outgoing one eases down first, so the level never drops or jumps.
- **Albums in order**: songs that run into each other (applause, a held chord) and albums without a beat are left as recorded.

## Ketvoice Lite

- Starts faster: in French nothing is read for translations, and other languages load only their own.
- On Android 11 the frosted glass is no longer recomputed while nothing changes behind it.
- On tablets the player bar at the bottom no longer redraws the whole bar as the song advances.

## Vice City

- The « Enjoy GTA VI » welcome screen is back as it was: the sunset picture, the glass panel and the sunset button. The theme itself keeps its quiet look.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.7.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-6.7.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-6.7.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.6.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.6.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A smoother app, Playlists and Downloads redone in the style of Apple Music, better layouts on tablets, and a quieter Vice City theme.

## Smoother

- Home, the Library, Wrapped and loading screens no longer redraw themselves several times a second while music plays.
- The Albums and Artists grids build only the rows you see, and searching the Library is faster.
- Background downloads no longer make every cover on the page redraw.
- Pictures are decoded at the size of your screen, never larger, so scrolling stays even.
- On phones with less memory, Ketvoice now uses the lighter settings of Ketvoice Lite that you cannot see.

## Playlists

- Library › Playlists is a clean list or grid of covers with « Playlist · owner » under each name, and « New playlist » and « Import playlists » at the top.
- The menu at the top right switches between list and grid, sorts by date, title or number of songs, and filters pinned or shared playlists.
- A playlist page shows the large cover, the owner in your accent colour, Play and Shuffle side by side, the songs, and the total « N songs, X h Y min » at the bottom.
- « Edit order » is in the playlist's menu. Share, Members and « Make this playlist public » now work from the playlist page too.

## Downloads

- A large title with the number of songs, their size and length, Play and Shuffle, and a simple storage card.
- Each song shows its format, size, lyrics, Canvas and separated-voice badges; removing a download is in its « … » menu.

## Tablets

- The sidebar stays as it is. Cover grids now fit the window: 4 columns in portrait, 6 in landscape.
- Playlist and album pages put the cover beside the title, with the songs full width below.
- Lists go two by two on wide windows.

## Vice City

- The neon is gone. The theme keeps your light or dark look and adds a flamingo-pink accent and one flat sunset with palm trees, on the Vice FM card and the welcome screen.
- The theme is still available until 10 December.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.6.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-6.6.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-6.6.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.5.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.5.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketvoice Lite now runs on Android 11 and is tuned for phones and tablets with little memory — with the same effects.

## Ketvoice Lite

- **Android 11 and up**: Ketvoice Lite now installs on Android 11. The glass keeps its frosted blur there too — Ketvoice computes it itself where Android 11 cannot — and the blurred cover backgrounds and the rounded widgets look the same as on newer phones.
- **Phones and tablets with little memory**: on a device with 2 to 4 GB, Lite keeps every effect you see and makes each one lighter to draw — blur and glow worked out at a lower resolution, images decoded no larger than the screen, one Canvas video at a time, voice separation with the quick model away from the charger, and memory freed as soon as Android asks.
- **Tablets**: Lite gets the same large-screen layouts as the regular app — the glass sidebar, two panes and the side-by-side player.
- **Settings → About** shows which mode is active and why, for example « This phone has 2 GB of memory: lighter effects, identical to the eye ».

## Also

- The glass in Blur mode no longer washes out to white on some phones.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.5.0.apk` (phone, Android 12 and up), `Ketvoice-6.5.0-Lite.apk` (lighter app, Android 11 and up) or `Ketvoice-6.5.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.4.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.4.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Follow your friends, brand-new widgets, an offline library that fills itself, your own music cleaned up — and a neon night for Vice City.

## Friends

- **Follow public profiles** and see their activity on Home: the playlists they publish, the songs they add and, if they share it, what they are listening to. React with an emoji; tap a line to play it.
- Your followers, the people you follow and the profiles you blocked are in your Ketvoice account, with *Publish my activity* to stop sharing at any time. Only public profiles can be followed, and activity older than 30 days disappears.

## Widgets, redone

- Every widget follows your launcher's rounded corners, takes the colours of the cover, adapts to any size and looks right in light and dark.
- New widgets: **Live lyrics** (the sung line and the next one), **Ketmix** (a switch and what it mixes next) and **Replay** (this month's minutes and your top artist and song).
- **Quick Settings tiles** for play/pause and Ketmix, and *Add the widget* buttons in Settings → Appearance → Widgets.

## Smart offline

- Turn it on in Settings → Downloads: on Wi-Fi (and while charging, if you like), Ketvoice downloads your new favourites, what you play most, your most played playlists and the next songs of your weekly discoveries — within the space you choose (1 to 10 GB, or a share of the free space).
- To make room it only removes what it downloaded itself, least played first; it never touches your own downloads and never brings back a song you deleted. Its downloads carry an *Auto* badge.

## Your own music

- Tags read and cleaned, corrections proposed from the catalogue (accept them per album or all at once), covers from the file, the folder or the catalogue, and synced lyrics found for you.
- Songs, Albums (with discs and track numbers), Artists and Folders views, and *Also on streaming* under the songs the catalogue has too.
- Ketvoice writes into your files only if you choose *Write to the file* (MP3 and FLAC), and keeps a copy of the original while it writes.

## Vice City, neon night

- A synthwave floor scrolls under the tab bar, the large titles shine in 80s chrome with a neon underline, and the KETVOICE sign flickers on when Home opens.
- The player gets a neon ring on play/pause and pink and cyan times; a held note in the lyrics glows from pink to cyan; menus, sheets and messages get a neon edge.
- **Vice FM** on Home: a fresh mix of synthwave and 80s hits from the catalogue at every tap.
- The theme stays available until 10 December. Ketvoice is not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.4.0.apk` (phone), `Ketvoice-6.4.0-Lite.apk` (lighter phone app) or `Ketvoice-6.4.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.3.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Shared playlists, a public profile, Air Ket to move your whole Ketvoice to a new phone, Canvas that stay on your phone and a faster start.

## Shared playlists

- **One playlist, several people**: share a playlist from its menu with a code or a link. Everyone with a Ketvoice account can add, remove and reorder songs, and all see the changes within minutes.
- Shared playlists carry a *Shared* badge in your library, play like any other, and have a members sheet with everyone's photo. The owner can remove someone; anyone can leave.
- Join with a code from the library, or by opening an invitation link.

## Public profile

- Choose to make your profile public: your name, your photo, the playlists you publish and, only if you turn it on, the song you are listening to now. Both switches are off until you turn them on, in your Ketvoice account.
- Open a profile by its handle, from a link or from the search in your account.

## Air Ket

- **Move everything to a new phone, directly**: on the old phone open *Air Ket* in Settings, on the new one choose *Receive with Air Ket*, and type the six-digit code (or scan the QR code with the camera). No account and no server: the two phones talk over your Wi-Fi, encrypted.
- It carries your settings, favourites, playlists, followed and blocked artists, history, Replay and custom lyrics, and, if you want, your downloaded songs with their lyrics, covers and Canvas.
- You choose to replace or merge what the new phone already has, and a transfer that stops picks up where it left off.

## Canvas

- **Kept on your phone**: a Canvas you imported from a link, like every other one, is kept once it has loaded, so it opens at once, online or not, and goes with a downloaded song. One Canvas is shared by all the songs of an album unless a song has its own.
- **Ahead of time**: the Canvas of the next songs are fetched while the current one plays, and, on Wi-Fi, those of your favourites and playlists.
- **In Settings**: see how much space Canvas use, choose the limit (256 MB to 2 GB) and clear them. The ones of your downloads are never removed. A small *Canvas…* pill shows while one is loading.

## New releases

- A notification when an artist you follow puts out an album, a single or an EP (Settings, on by default). Tap it to open the artist.

## Faster

- Ketvoice opens faster: its settings are read beside the screen being built, and what the first screen does not need starts right after it.

## Vice City

- The Vice City theme now has its striped setting sun behind the greeting, and the player's seek bar and the sliders fill with the sunset.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.3.0.apk` (phone), `Ketvoice-6.3.0-Lite.apk` (lighter phone app) or `Ketvoice-6.3.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Your Ketvoice account with your photo and your library on every device, a library that understands what you ask, a livelier player, a welcome for new listeners and a limited theme for each season.

## Your Ketvoice account

- **Create an account** with an email address and a password, or sign in with Discord: no code to type and no second step.
- **Your profile**: a name, a handle and a profile photo you crop yourself; your photo appears on Home, in your library, in search and in Settings.
- **Your library everywhere**: favourites, playlists, followed artists and settings follow you to every phone where you sign in, and deleting something on one device deletes it on the others.
- **Resume here**: Home offers to pick up the song you were playing on another device, at the same moment.
- Your account is private: only you can see your profile and your library, and you can delete the account and everything in it from Settings.

## A smarter library

- **Search the way you talk**: « chill French rap from the 2010s », « upbeat songs by Daft Punk »… Ketvoice reads the request on your phone and shows it as chips you can remove one by one.
- **Moods**: playlists made from your library by mood — calm, energy, party, focus, melancholy and good mood — each with its own cover, refreshable and savable as a playlist.
- **Duplicates**: copies of the same recording are found and merged in your playlists; a download is only deleted after you confirm.
- **Import playlists** from a public Spotify or Deezer link, with progress and the list of songs that were not found.

## A livelier player

- The cover drifts and zooms slowly while the music plays, with a soft light passing over it now and then.
- The background colours breathe with the bass and fade from one song to the next.
- When the song changes, the old cover steps back while the new one comes forward, and the title and artist cross-fade.
- Everything stays still with reduced motion, and is gentler in performance mode and in Ketvoice Lite.

## Welcome

- New listeners are welcomed on their first launch: choose the language, import playlists, and turn Ketmix and voice separation on or off. Updating keeps everything as it is.

## Seasonal themes

- A limited theme for every season, offered once when it begins and available in Settings → Appearance while it lasts: **Christmas** (11–31 December), **New Year** (31 December–2 January), **Valentine's Day** (7–15 February), **Spring** (20 March–20 April), **Summer** (21 June–31 August) and **Halloween** (20 October–2 November).
- The Vice City edition stays until 10 December.

## Also

- Shared song links open a new page with the large cover, a line of lyrics, the Ketogether session code and a button to open the song in Ketvoice.
- The website has a new release history page.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.2.0.apk` (phone), `Ketvoice-6.2.0-Lite.apk` (lighter phone app) or `Ketvoice-6.2.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.1.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Listen together with Ketogether, place your own mix points in the Ketmix editor, see the sung line on your lock screen, discover new music every Monday — and a limited Vice City edition for the release of GTA VI.

## Ketogether

- **Listen together**: start a session and share its code, link or QR code; everyone hears the same song at the same moment, each on their own phone.
- **A shared queue**: guests propose songs from any song's menu; the host adds them, or lets everyone add and control playback.
- Reactions, a live pill in the player and the mini-player, and signed host messages so nobody can pretend to be the host.

## Ketmix

- **The Ketmix editor**: hold the Ketmix switch, or choose *Mix point…* in a song's menu. See both songs' waveforms with their beats, bars and phrases, drag the exit and entry points (they snap to the beat), set the overlap and the style, listen, and Ketmix remembers your points for every later mix.

## Lyrics

- **On the lock screen**: the line being sung, and the next one, in a silent notification you can see without unlocking (a Live Update on Android 16).
- **Clearer**: no blur and no halo on the words any more; only a note the singer holds glows a little.
- The large player widget shows the sung line too, and all widgets are redone in the glass look.

## Discover

- **Weekly discoveries**: about thirty songs you have not heard, chosen from what you listen to, renewed every Monday — on Home and in Android Auto.
- **A better radio**: artist and song radio without repeats, mixing new songs with ones you love.
- **Monthly Replay**: your minutes, top songs, artists and albums for each month, with its playlist.
- **A richer Wrapped**: listening clock, mood, discoveries and Ketmix pages, each one shareable as a story.

## Artist and album pages

- **Artists**: a large photo that drifts slowly, Play, Shuffle and Favourite, popular songs, the latest release, the discography, similar artists and the biography.
- **Albums**: explicit, downloaded and voice-separated marks on every song, the release date and total length, and more from the artist.

## Music that keeps playing

- Voice separation and Ketmix's heavy work now run in a process of their own: if the phone stops it, the music goes on.
- **Automatic resume**: if Android stops playback by itself, Ketvoice brings the same song back at the same moment (Settings → Playback; on by default). Allow *Alarms & reminders* when Settings offers it, for a resume within a minute.

## Ketvoice Lite

- A new, lighter APK of Ketvoice: the same features and effects in an APK under half the size (about 32 MB instead of 83 MB), tuned for modest phones. It installs over the regular app and keeps your library, settings and downloads.

## Vice City edition

- To celebrate the release of GTA VI on 19 November, a welcome screen greets you after updating, until 20 November.
- **Vice City theme**: night violet, sunset pink and orange, a soft sunset glow and neon edges, in Settings → Appearance until 10 December. A matching Vice City app icon is available until then too.
- Ketvoice is not affiliated with Rockstar Games.

## Also

- The tab bar always folds into a pill as you scroll, with the mini-player docked beside it.
- Sliders, rows, empty pages and loading lists keep the iOS 27 polish of the last beta.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.1.0.apk` (phone), `Ketvoice-6.1.0-Lite.apk` (lighter phone app) or `Ketvoice-6.1.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.0.0 Beta 5

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketvoice in the car with Android Auto, music that keeps playing in the background, sliders that swell under your finger like iOS 27, and Ketmix's sign under the seek bar.

## Android Auto

- **Browse from the car**: Home (your mixes and recently played), Favourites, Playlists and Downloads, with covers, in four tabs.
- **Search**: your playlists, your library and the whole catalogue, from the car's search screen.
- **Voice**: "Hey Google, play … on Ketvoice" plays the best match first and the other results after it; a playlist's name plays that playlist, and "my favourites" shuffles them.
- Pressing play in the car picks up where you left off, or starts your favourites.
- A song chosen in the car plays exactly as on the phone: downloaded copy first, then the best stream, with the whole list queued for next and previous.

## Background playback

- **Three minutes read ahead** instead of one: a phone that cuts the network of apps in the background has to hold it off far longer before the music stops, and the radio wakes less often.
- Away from the screen and on battery, Ketmix and voice separation do only the essential, and the separation models leave memory: battery managers stop the biggest apps first.
- **Honor and Huawei phones**: Settings opens the *App launch* screen directly, with the steps that keep the music going (turn off *Manage automatically*, then turn on *Run in background*).
- The playback journal (Settings → Playback) now also notes waits for data, low memory and data saver, to find the cause of a cut at once.

## Ket 27

- **Sliders like iOS 27**: hold the seek bar, the volume, the voice slider or any setting slider and it swells and reaches out under your finger; pull past an end and it stretches like rubber, then springs back.
- **Ketmix's sign** between the times under the seek bar while two songs are mixed: two rings that merge at the hand-over.
- **The player** is back to its artwork with the controls below it; the full-screen glass player is gone.
- **Lyrics**: the glow of a sung word is much fainter, and none lingers at the end of a line.
- Rows of songs light up briefly under a touch, empty pages have a symbol and a clearer layout, and lists show placeholder rows while they load.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.5.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.5-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay. Android Auto lists an app installed outside the Play Store once *Unknown sources* is turned on in Android Auto's developer settings.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.0.0-beta.4
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.0.0 Beta 4

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix mixes like Apple Music's AutoMix, the voice slider answers at once, a new glass icon, and a finer Ket 27.

## Ketmix

- **In time, then back home**: songs whose tempos are up to 6 % apart (8 % on the DJ setting) are now blended on the beat. The incoming song plays the blend at the outgoing tempo, then glides back to its own tempo in steps too small to hear, its pitch untouched.
- **A three-band mixer**: besides the bass that changes hands on the beat, the mids of only one song are full at a time during a blend in time, and they step back further when the two keys clash.
- **Harmonic and phrased**: keys that clash are never left to rub for long, and crossfades start where a phrase of the outgoing song starts.

## The voice of a song

- **Ready before you touch it**: the song is separated as soon as its lyrics are shown, so the voice slider answers at once; the high-quality model then improves it in the background.
- **No reload**: moving the slider, or a separation arriving while the song plays, changes the voice live, without a gap or a click.
- **Cleaner**: the "s" and "t" of the voice go with it now, above 11 kHz too; Ketmix's instrumentals benefit as well.
- The lyrics follow the sound exactly while the voice is adjusted.

## Faster, better quality

- **Progressive quality that really switches**: playback starts on the first stream found, then moves to the best one (up to Hi-Res) without a gap: the two streams are aligned on their sound itself and crossfaded. On by default.

## Ket 27

- **New app icon**: the glass K in four versions (Liquid Glass, Light, Tinted, Clear); choose it in Settings with a preview of each.
- **Glass**: a transparency slider like iOS 27's, from very clear to tinted; reflections that follow how you hold the phone; the cover's colours glide across pages, buttons and glass, always readable.
- **Player**: the artwork or Canvas fills the screen behind controls in glass.
- **Lyrics that glow**: a living background in the cover's colours, and each word lights up as it is sung.
- **Home** with large mix cards, **Library and Downloads** with glass filters and cover grids.
- **Search** floats in a glass bubble at the bottom; **covers zoom** into their page and back; an optional **tab bar that shrinks** as you scroll (Settings → Appearance).

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.4.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.4-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.
