releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.0.0 Beta 3

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The voice level now works on every song.

## The voice of a song

- **The voice slider is on every song.** On the lyrics screen, beside the lyrics and above the translation button, it appears with the player's controls (never in full-screen lyrics), whatever you are listening to.
- **Touch it and Ketvoice separates the song you are hearing**, on the phone (the time depends on the phone and the song's length): a small spinner shows at the top of the slider meanwhile, and the voice follows the slider as soon as it is done. You can set the level right away; it applies when the song is ready.
- **The first time, Ketvoice offers to download the separation model** (about 39 MB, once). After that, separating needs no network for downloaded songs.
- **Once you have turned the voice down, it stays down**: each next song is separated as it starts.
- Works on downloaded songs and on most streamed songs. A few streams made of many small files cannot be read whole; download those songs to adjust their voice.
- A song separated once stays separated: Ketmix uses it for its mixes too.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.3.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.3-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.0.0-beta.2
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.0.0 Beta 2

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The redesign of Ketvoice 6: one interface, built for phones and tablets, and the voice of a song in your hands.

## One interface

- **Ket 27 is now Ketvoice's interface**, everywhere. The classic interface and its switch are gone; every page, alert, button, progress bar and message follows the same design.
- **Lyrics are shown in Cascade**, the only lyrics style: the line being sung stands forward, the others follow it in a wave.
- **The glass menu is the menu of a song.** Press and hold a song, or touch its "…" button anywhere (lists, albums, playlists, Home, the player): the song lifts off the page and its menu unfolds from it. Every other option is one touch away under **More**.

## Tablets and large windows

- **A glass sidebar** with your tabs, library sections, pinned and recent playlists and search; it folds into a narrow rail of symbols, and medium windows get the rail directly. Phones keep their tab bar.
- **A mini-player docked at the bottom** of the page, which unfolds into the player.
- **Two panes** on album, playlist and artist pages (the artwork and details stay put while the songs scroll) and in search (your query and recent searches beside the results). Shelves show more whole cards.
- **A player made for large screens**: the lyrics beside the artwork in landscape, below it in portrait, the queue as a panel beside them when there is room; foldables keep everything clear of the hinge.
- **Sheets float** as centred panels and popovers instead of covering the screen.
- **Keyboard and mouse**: shortcuts as on a computer (Space to play or pause, arrows to seek and change the volume, Ctrl F to search, Ctrl L for the lyrics, Ctrl U for the queue, Esc to go back), secondary click on songs for their menu, hover on buttons, and drag a song onto a playlist of the sidebar.

## The voice of a song

- **Voice level**: on the lyrics screen, a glass slider beside the lyrics turns the singer down, from the full song to the instrumental alone, while it plays. Drag it, or touch the microphone to take the voice out and bring it back. It appears with the player's controls, not in full-screen lyrics.
- It works on downloaded songs once they are separated whole: while the phone charges, Ketvoice separates your downloads with the separation model (Settings → Ketmix).
- **Downloads show a music symbol** on the songs whose voice and music are separated.

## Ketmix

- Downloaded songs separated whole serve every mix they take part in, so their mixes are ready at once.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.2.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.2-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay. Settings for the classic interface and the lyrics style are simply no longer used.

releases.name: Ketvoice 6.0.0-beta
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 6.0.0 Beta

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The first beta of Ketvoice 6: a far better voice separation for Ketmix. The 6.0 redesign of the interface comes in the next beta.

## Ketmix

- **A high-quality voice separation model** (Settings → Ketmix → *High-quality model*, an optional 33 MB download, UVR MDX-Net). Measured on MUSDB18-HQ, the standard test set with isolated stems, the instrumentals Ketmix keeps come out about 3 dB cleaner and the voices about 3.5 dB cleaner than with the quick model: less voice left in the instrumental when a song continues without its singer, cleaner voices over the other song's music.
- **Separation quality** setting:
  - *Automatic* (default): the quick model on battery, the high-quality one while the phone charges; songs already separated are then separated again, better, once.
  - *Always the best*: the high-quality model all the time; it is about ten times slower, so on battery Ketmix prepares one song ahead instead of three.
  - *Always quick*: the least battery.
- The quick model stays available. Each song remembers which model separated it, and is never separated twice by the same one.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-6.0.0-beta-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.11.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.11.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix gets ready from the first seconds of a song and mixes smarter; Ket 27 moves like iOS.

## Ketmix

- **Ready from the first seconds.** As soon as a song has played a few seconds, Ketmix reads, measures and separates its ending and the songs that follow — three ahead on Wi-Fi, one on mobile data. The mix is ready long before the end, even if you jump forward in the song, and everything is kept for the next time those songs play.
- **A real mix when you skip.** Press next while Ketmix is on: when the next song is prepared and loads at once, it is mixed in over a few seconds on two decks, entering where its music starts, instead of a plain fade.
- **Downloads prepared while charging** (Settings → Ketmix → *Prepare downloaded songs*): with the phone plugged in, downloaded songs are analysed and their voices separated before they are ever played.
- **Knows where the singing is.** The voice separation now also tells Ketmix where each song starts and stops singing, so songs without lyrics are no longer mixed over their last sung words, and a long instrumental ending is left earlier.
- **A voice over the other song's instrumental.** When two songs share tempo and key and the next one sings early, its voice alone comes in over the current song's instrumental, then the whole song takes over as the bass changes hands. Needs the separation model.
- **Smart queue** (Settings → Ketmix, on by default): in shuffle, the song that plays next is the one, among the next few already measured, that goes best with the current one in tempo and key. A queue you ordered yourself and a song you asked to play next never move.

## Ket 27

- **The mini-player unfolds into the player.** One spring opens and closes it: the title, the artist, play and next travel from the mini-player to their place, and a flick down closes the player from anywhere, at the speed of your finger.
- **Icons that move.** Play and pause melt into each other, the heart fills and bounces, the download arrow fills as the song arrives and its check draws itself, shuffle and repeat pulse when you toggle them.
- **Context menus and spring sheets.** Hold a song: it lifts and a glass menu unfolds from it (play next, queue, favourite, download, playlist, radio, share). Sheets rest at half height or full height, follow the finger and settle with a spring.
- **Controls with a click.** Sliders get a glass thumb and a tick at each step (one per dB on the equalizer), the volume rail swells under the finger, switches and pickers tick, pickers become inset lists.
- **More pages in the Ket 27 look**: large titles on Home, Explorer, Search, Stats; glass back button and centred titles on pushed pages; rounded glass alerts; menus that take the page's colours. Ket 27 stays an Alpha: tablet and Quest players and a few dialogs keep their previous look.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-5.11.0.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-5.11.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.10.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.10.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Real voice separation in Ketmix, music that keeps playing behind other apps, and lyrics videos with sound.

## New

- **Ketmix really separates the voices.** Turn on *Separate voices* in Settings → Ketmix and download the separation model once (39 MB, optional). During a mix the current song's voice stops, the next song carries on over its own instrumental, then its voice comes in — no two voices over each other. The separation runs on the phone (Spleeter, an open AI model), at low priority, while the next mix is being prepared. Each song is separated only once: the result is kept in a tiny file (about 1 MB per song) and every later mix reuses it at once. Settings show how many songs are separated and the space they take, and can erase them or the model; separations can also be kept for when the phone is charging. Without the model, the voice is softened as before.
- **Lyrics videos with the song's sound.** A *Song's sound in the video* switch under the video button: the part of the song your lines come from plays under them, with short fades in and out.
- **Playback log** (Settings → Playback): what stopped the music, if it ever stops — a lost network, another app taking the sound, a call, headphones unplugged, or Android closing the app (with the reason Android gives). It stays on the phone and can be shared.
- **Your phone's own battery manager** (Settings → Playback, on Xiaomi, Huawei, Honor, Oppo, OnePlus, Realme, Vivo and Samsung): one tap to the screen where Ketvoice can be allowed to start and stay active in the background, which these phones require on top of Android's setting.

## Fixed

- **Music no longer stops behind other apps when the network drops for a moment** (a tunnel, Wi-Fi to mobile data, the phone asleep). The song waits for the network and starts again where it stopped, instead of every source being tried and failing one after the other until playback gave up.

## Faster

- **Lyrics videos are created much faster**: the Canvas behind the words is read in one pass instead of searched frame by frame, and each frame draws less.
- **Canvas videos no longer decode a sound track** nobody hears, leaving more of the phone to the music.

## Install

Download `Ketvoice-5.10.0.apk` (phone) or `Ketvoice-5.10.0-Quest.apk` (Meta Quest) below and install it over your current version: your library, settings and downloads stay.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.9.2
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.9.2

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Lyrics videos to share, a performance mode that keeps the effects, and a like that no longer moves the player.

## New

- **Share lyrics as a video.** Hold a line in the lyrics, pick up to four, then *Video*: the title's Canvas blurred behind (or its cover's colours flowing), your lines in a frosted card that light up word by word in time with the song, the cover and the title under them. A story-sized MP4, with or without the Ketvoice logo. *Image* still makes the picture, which now holds up to four lines too.
- **A new performance mode** (Settings → Appearance): the effects stay visible and only what you barely notice is lightened — glass without its costly refraction, sharp lyrics instead of blurred far lines, the player's flowing colours at a quarter of the frames, images that appear without fading. Album Canvas keeps playing.

## Fixed

- **Liking a title no longer moves the player**: the heart's burst plays around the button without pushing the title, the artist and the buttons.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.9.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.9.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Your own lyrics files, an app that takes the colour of what plays, truer cover colours, Discord that stays linked, and Ketmix mixes that keep voices apart.

## New

- **Custom lyrics.** In the player's lyrics sources, *Custom* opens your files: pick a lyrics file and Ketvoice uses it for that title from then on. LRC (with word timing and several times per line), TTML, SRT, WebVTT, ASS/SSA (with karaoke timing), YRC, JSON from the usual lyrics services and plain text are read; the format is recognised from the content. Choose another source to set it aside, *Change file* or *Remove* at any time.
- **Background from the cover** (Settings → Appearance, off by default): the background of the whole app takes the colour of what is playing, as an album page does.
- **Separate vocals (experimental)** (Settings → Ketmix): during a mix the next title comes in as its instrumental and its vocals join just before it sings, while the vocals of the title playing fade before the next one starts singing — two voices never sing over each other. The separation happens in real time, so nothing is computed ahead or stored.
- **Add a whole album or several titles to a playlist**: a new button on album pages, and *Add to a playlist* in the selection of the library and of the queue. Titles already in the playlist are not added twice.

## Better

- **Cover colours.** Album, artist and player colours now come from the main hue of the cover: a colourful cover on a dark or grey ground no longer turns grey, and two colours are no longer averaged into a third one (red and blue into purple, yellow and blue into green).
- **Discord stays linked.** A linked Discord account is signed in again when the app starts and after an update, instead of asking to link again.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.9.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.9.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Wrapped, four widgets, a ten-band equalizer, lyrics in the manner of Apple Music and a player whose colours flow.

## New

- **Ketvoice Wrapped.** Replay → *Wrapped*: your year as stories — the minutes you listened, your number 1 artist and your songs on repeat, over the flowing colours of your most played cover — and a story-sized picture to share. Years are counted from this version on; until this year holds enough plays, Wrapped covers everything Ketvoice counted since you started, and says so.
- **Four home-screen widgets**: a large Liquid Glass player (blurred cover, progress and controls), *Your week*, the mix of the moment (one tap plays it) and small 2×1 controls.
- **A ten-band equalizer** from 31 Hz to 16 kHz: drag the curve itself, or pick a preset (Bass, Vocal, Night, Brilliance, Rock, Electro). On most phones the ten bands are applied exactly, with a limiter so that boosts never clip; your previous settings are carried over.
- **Normalise volume** (Settings → Playback): every title at a similar perceived loudness, adjusted slowly so that nothing pumps within a song.
- **Ketmix on skip**: with Ketmix on, skipping to the next title is a short fade instead of a hard cut.
- **Cover colour** (Settings → Appearance): the accent colour of the whole app follows the cover playing.

## Design

- **The player's colours flow.** Without a Canvas, the player's background is three blurred copies of the cover turning slowly in opposite directions, as in Apple Music.
- **Lyrics in the manner of Apple Music**: each word rises a little as it is sung, held notes glow, and the sung line breathes very slightly with the bass.
- **Shared lyrics** now lie over the blurred cover.
- **A simpler Home**: the large *For you* card and the four shortcut tiles are gone; *Your week* stays.

## Faster

- The lyrics index and the launcher icon check are read beside the first screen instead of before it, and Discord starts after the first frame.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.8.2
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.8.2

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The fix for titles that would not play in 5.8.0 and 5.8.1, and a smoother app.

## Fixed

- **Every title plays again**, downloaded or streamed. Since 5.8.0, a shortcut in the reverb stage made the sound stop with *Reading error · try again* before the first second of each title; 5.8.1 did not remove it. A new test now plays a file through Ketvoice's whole audio chain, so that this cannot come back unnoticed.
- With *Stats info* on (Settings), the player now names the error behind a title that fails.

## Smoother

- While music plays, the app no longer redraws every screen every few seconds to follow the position of the title.
- The large card at the top of Home no longer redraws five times a second while a title plays.
- All of Ketvoice's code — playback, Ketmix, every page — is now compiled when the app is installed, instead of only its start-up path: it runs at full speed from the first second. Every effect is kept.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.8.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.8.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A fix for 5.8.0, in which titles, downloaded or streamed, could stop starting and the app could stutter.

## Fixed

- **Playback and smoothness.** The optimised build introduced in 5.8.0 is withdrawn: Ketvoice is built again as in 5.7.0, with every feature of 5.8.0 kept.
- Opening a page from a cover no longer redraws the whole page at every frame of its animation.
- The search by lyrics no longer rewrites its index each time lyrics already known are shown again.

## New look

- **A new Liquid Glass app icon**: a "K" of clear, iridescent glass on black (Settings → Appearance → App icon → Liquid Glass).

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.8.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.8.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A faster app, music that keeps playing behind other apps, search by lyrics, radios, and the Apple touch on the library, pages, icons and animations.

## Faster

- **The app is now built with Android's optimiser (R8)**, which streamlines the libraries the interface is made of. Screens, scrolling and animations respond faster, with every effect kept.
- Behind other apps, Ketvoice leaves the processor to the music: the reverb no longer works sample by sample while it is off, the position of the title is read once a second instead of five times, Canvas videos wait until the app is back on screen, and Ketmix only uses what it already measured.

## Music without cuts in the background

- Many phones put a music app to sleep to save battery, which is heard as cuts. The first time music plays on such a phone, Ketvoice offers to let Android play it **without battery restrictions**; the choice is also in Settings → Playback → *Background playback*.

## New

- **Search by lyrics.** Type a few words of a song: titles whose lyrics are already on your phone are found at once, and for a sentence of three words or more the search also asks Genius, which knows the lyrics of titles you have never played.
- **Radio.** *Start radio* in a title's menu, or *Artist radio* on an artist page: a queue that never runs out, alternating the artist and artists like them, never twice the same title and never an artist you blocked.
- **Favourites offline automatically.** A title you make a favourite downloads by itself (Settings → Downloads; the Wi-Fi-only setting applies).

## Design and animations

- **Library in the manner of Apple Music** (with Ket 27): a large title, the categories in a list — Playlists, Artists, Albums, Titles, Favourites, Downloads, Local music, Replay — and *Recently added* as a grid of covers.
- **Pages that grow out of their cover.** An album or a playlist opened from its cover now grows out of it as a card whose corners straighten as it fills the screen, and folds back into it when closed.
- **Lists bounce at their ends** as on iPhone, everywhere in the app.
- **A heart that bursts** into small hearts when a title becomes a favourite in the player.
- **Living artwork.** The player's artwork pulses very slightly with the bass (Settings → Appearance).
- **A Liquid Glass app icon**: a "K" of clear glass capsules over a pink-to-blue ground (Settings → Appearance → App icon → Liquid Glass).
- **Ket 27 symbols**: the tab bar, the search button and the player's heart use new filled, rounded symbols in the manner of iOS.

## Privacy

- A search of three words or more is also sent to Genius to find titles by their lyrics. See PRIVACY.md.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.7.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.7.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix without speed effects and with a new build-up transition, translated biographies, artists you can block, and the tab bar lens of iOS.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **No more speed effects.** A title's speed never changes any more while it is heard. Before, titles at different tempos were sped up or slowed down during and after a blend, and each change could be heard as a small cut. Now two titles are only played in time when their tempos are within 2 % (discreet), 3 % (balanced) or 4 % (DJ) of each other: the next title is given that speed once, while it is still silent, keeps it to its end, and the title after it starts on its own tempo again. Titles further apart leave on a build-up, an echo or a crossing of filters.
- **Build-up, a new transition.** Over the last bars of a phrase the title thins out through a rising filter while a breath of noise swells, then the next title drops in on its first beat — no common tempo needed. Left to Ketmix, a build-up and an echo take turns; it can also be chosen as the transition style (*Build*).
- Corrections that keep two titles in time are only made while the next title cannot be heard yet, early enough to be over before it is.
- The mix journal shows the real speed the next title plays at.

## Artists

- **Block or keep an artist.** In the search, a long press on an artist's circle opens a small menu: *Block artist*, *Unblock artist*, *Add to favourites*. A blocked artist is left out of what Ketvoice proposes — Home, its mixes, the titles a search finds in the catalogue, the titles added when the queue runs out — wherever they are credited, features included; your playlists, downloads and library are not touched. Your favourite artists appear at the top of the search.
- **Biographies in your language.** An artist's biography is translated into the language of the app, with *Show original* one tap away.

## Home

- **The For you card changes.** New releases and your mixes take turns on the large card at the top of Home: the one shown the least comes first, never the same twice in a row.

## Liquid Glass

- **The tab bar lens.** Hold the selection of the tab bar, or slide along it, and it becomes a lens as on iOS: it swells, turns clear, magnifies the tab under it and follows your finger, with a tick for each tab it crosses; let go and it settles on that tab.
- With Ket 27, the thumb of a switch also becomes a clear magnifying lens while it is held.

## Privacy

- To translate a biography, its text (public catalogue text) is sent to Google Translate; the translation is kept on the device. See PRIVACY.md.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.6.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.6.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ket 27 by default with the glass of iOS 27, steadier playback behind other apps, and cleaner Ketmix blends.

## Ket 27 (Alpha)

- **On by default.** Ket 27 is now the interface Ketvoice opens with; the switch in Settings → Appearance turns it off.
- **The regular glass of iOS 27.** With Ket 27 on, every glass surface follows the material of Apple's iOS 27 design kit: a surface at 70 % of white in light mode and of near-black in dark mode — less see-through and more diffused than before —, a soft shadow below it and no inner shadow. The Clear ↔ Tinted setting moves the surface from 55 % to 85 %, like the Liquid Glass slider of iOS 27.

## Interface

- **Rows answer the finger.** Settings rows darken at once under a touch and let go slowly, as list rows do on iOS, in both interfaces.

## Playback

- **Fewer gaps behind other apps.** Ketvoice now keeps half a second of sound ahead in the audio output instead of a quarter, and Ketmix reads the next titles more slowly while Ketvoice is not on screen, so that the title playing keeps the processor it needs.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **Filters and echoes survive tempo nudges.** During a blend played in time, each small change of speed restarted the filters, the echo and the reverb of a title: a filtered title could click and an echo lost its tail. They now carry on through it.
- **Fewer, calmer tempo changes.** The common tempo of a blend moves in a few larger steps instead of many small ones, and a title that is heard is only nudged when its beats are far enough off to be heard, at most every 1.2 seconds.
- **The mix journal** shows, for blends played in time, how far apart the beats of the two titles got and how many times a speed was changed.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.5.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.5.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix plays far more titles in time, and Ket 27 (Alpha) gives Ketvoice the interface of iOS 27.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **A tempo read where the drums play.** Ketmix now also listens to 30 seconds from the body of each title and reads its intro and its ending against that tempo. An intro without drums, or an ending where only hats in triplets are left, could be counted at 3/2 or 2/3 of the real tempo — or not counted at all — which left most pairs to a filter crossing or an echo. With the balanced and maximum analysis settings they now get the title's own beat grid.
- **In time across wider tempo gaps.** Two titles are now played in time when their tempos are within 6 % (discreet), 14 % (balanced) or 18 % (DJ), instead of 5, 8 and 12 %. The common tempo slides from the outgoing title's to the incoming one's during the blend, so each title is only stretched while it is the quiet one, with its pitch kept. A pair such as 138 into 122 BPM is now a blend on the beat with the bass changing hands, not a crossing of filters.
- **The mix journal** also shows the tempo read from the body of each title.

## Ket 27 (Alpha)

A new switch in Settings → Appearance turns the interface towards iOS 27. It is an alpha: the pages below are done, others still keep the previous style.

- **System colours.** The grouped background and white cells of iOS in light mode, pure black and dark grey cells in dark mode, and the label and separator colours of the system.
- **Typography.** Inter, the open typeface closest to San Francisco, with the iOS text styles: 34 pt bold large titles, 17 pt body, 13 pt footnotes.
- **Settings as an inset grouped list.** 26 pt rounded groups, symbols on coloured tiles, headers in sentence case, a large title on the root page and a uniform bar with the page's title once inside a category.
- **Controls.** The 63 × 28 switch of iOS 27, green when on, with a wide capsule thumb; alerts with 34 pt corners.
- **Tab bar.** 62 pt high, the selected tab tinted with your accent colour.
- **Glass.** Liquid 27 is used everywhere while Ket 27 is on.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.4.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.4.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix transitions that keep their effects, last notes that ring on, and intros that rise under the last words.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **Effects instead of a plain fade.** Ketmix now gives both players a moment to have their audio processing ready before it chooses a transition, and keeps the next title silent until its effects are live. Filtered, layered and echoed transitions are played where a plain volume fade was often used instead.
- **A last note rings on.** A title that ends on a last note at full level is no longer simply joined to the next one: the next title still starts right after that note, on the beat when there is one, and the last beat rings on in an echo for four beats, played out past the end of the title. The echo takes its length from the tempo even when the tempo was not read with enough confidence to mix in time. The discreet setting keeps the plain join.
- **Intros rise under the last words.** When the next title does not sing for a while, it now comes up under the last sung words of the outgoing one — for up to 6 seconds (balanced) or 10 seconds (DJ) — while the outgoing voice steps back, instead of being crossed in 2.5 seconds once the singing is over. Its own voice still arrives after the crossing.
- **A more detailed mix journal.** Each transition now also shows where the outgoing title's sound ends and how (hard, fading or ringing), where the mix started in both titles, whether it rang on past the end, and whether both players' effects were in use.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.4.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.4.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Longer, tempo-matched Ketmix blends that start under the last sung bars; your accent colour everywhere; a new shelf of recent titles.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **Longer blends, more often in time.** Blends now run up to 16 bars (64 beats, about 30 seconds at 128 BPM), and two titles are played in time when their tempos are within 5 % (discreet), 8 % (balanced) or 12 % (DJ) — the tempos meet half-way, so each title is only stretched by about half of that.
- **Under the last words.** In the balanced and DJ settings, a blend may start under the last two (balanced) or four (DJ) sung bars of the outgoing title: its voice steps back — the centre of the stereo image, where a lead vocal sits, is lowered between 220 Hz and 4.5 kHz while the instruments carry on — instead of the mix waiting for the very end. A title that ends on a last note at full level still keeps its ending whole.
- **Mix journal.** Settings → Playback → Ketmix now lists the last transitions — what was played or why nothing was, the tempos and keys measured, how sure the analysis was, and whether a plain fade had to be used — with *Copy the journal* to send it when a mix sounds wrong.

## Colours

- **Your accent colour is respected everywhere.** With *Cover colours* on, only album pages, artist pages and the player take their colours from the artwork; the rest of the app keeps the accent you chose.
- **Album pages take the colour their artwork is mostly made of**, not its most vivid detail (a black-and-white cover with a small gold detail now gives a neutral page), and follow the cover as soon as a Canvas is switched off. Light pages stay light under a dark cover.

## Home

- **Recent titles as a shelf of large covers**, each lifted by a shadow of its own colour, with a play button and the bars of the title playing; a long press opens a title's menu. The layout button switches to a grid of covers.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.3.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.3.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix mixes on the phrase and loops a title into itself; Liquid Glass forms, bends and settles more naturally; a queue you can edit by the handful.

## Ketmix (beta)

- **Mixes start on a phrase.** Ketmix now finds where the music turns a page — the bar where a part comes in or drops out, every eight bars — and starts the next title there, as a DJ would. Echoes leave on the last phrase boundary before the end.
- **Better bars.** When the bass does not tell the bars apart, the first beat of a bar is found where the most new sound comes in from one beat to the next.
- **Layered blends.** In a blend the incoming title now arrives highs first, then mids, and its bass last, on the swap: one bass line at a time, all the way through.
- **Titles on repeat are mixed too.** With *Mix a title on repeat too* (on by default), a repeated title blends into its own start on the beat instead of starting again after a gap. Its overlap is kept short, so the title never colours itself.
- **Choose the style.** Settings → Playback → Ketmix → *Transition style*: Automatic, Matched to the tempo, Echo, Filters or Fade. Singing is never covered, whatever the style, and Ketmix falls back to another style when the chosen one does not suit the two titles.
- **See the mix.** While two titles play together, an animated strip above the progress bar shows the outgoing title fading over the incoming one, the playhead, the moment the bass changes hands, and the measured tempo and key.
- **Feel the swap.** *Vibrate on the bass swap* (off by default) gives a light vibration when the bass passes to the next title, while the app is on screen.

## Liquid Glass

- **A softer bezel.** In the Liquid 27 style, the edge of the glass is now a squircle rather than a circular arc: the bend leaves the flat centre gently and rises sharply at the rim, without a visible ring.
- **True Fresnel.** Edges reflect more the more edge-on they are (Schlick's approximation).
- **Glass that forms.** Glass now materialises by bending the light in over half a second instead of simply appearing.
- **Calmer motion.** A released control settles with one small overshoot instead of wobbling.
- **Switches become lenses.** A switch's thumb widens into a clear lens while the finger is on it, then settles back.
- **Readable edges.** Where content scrolls under the status bar or the floating bar, the page colour rises over it with an eased curve, in every glass style.

## Queue and shuffle

- **Select several titles.** Long-press a title in the queue (or tap *Select*), tick more, then *Play next* or *Remove* them at once. Both can be undone.
- **Shuffle with fewer repeats** (on by default): titles heard recently are kept for later and two titles by the same artist do not follow each other when it can be avoided.

## Night

- In the dark theme, pages coloured by a cover or a Canvas keep their hue but never go above a dim level, so a bright cover does not light up the screen at night.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.2.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Ketmix (beta): transitions that are more than a fade, a new dark theme and a new Home.

## Ketmix (beta), the new name of Automix

- **More than a fade.** Ketmix now chooses between six ways of going from one title to the
  next, from what it measured of the two:
  - *Matched to the tempo* — both titles in time, the bass handed over on a beat. The two
    tempos now meet during the mix: each title is only stretched while it is the quiet one,
    and the incoming title ends at its own tempo. After the bass swap the outgoing title
    thins out, rising into the air or sinking, in turn.
  - *Echo out* — when two tempos cannot be shared, the last beat is caught in an echo, the
    title is cut on the bar and the next one starts on that beat.
  - *Filter crossing* — an ending that fades or rings out is crossed by spectrum rather than
    by level: one title thins out while the other opens up.
  - *Dissolve* — a title without a beat dissolves into its own reverberation while the next
    one rises under it.
  - *Cut on the beat* — a last note is never covered; the first beat of the next title lands
    on the beat that follows it.
  - A plain crossfade is only left for when nothing finer can be played.
- **Keys.** Ketmix reads the key of each title. Two keys that clash are not left to overlap
  for long: the mix is shorter and thinner. The status line shows what was measured, for
  example `124 → 128 BPM · 8A → 9A`.
- **Songs come first.** Tempos must now be within 4 %, 6 % or 8 % (discreet, balanced, DJ)
  instead of 4 %, 8 % and 12 %. Balanced leaves out 16 seconds of an instrumental ending at
  most (25 before), DJ 45 seconds (90 before); discreet never leaves anything out and does
  without echoes. Two transitions in a row do not sound alike.
- **Three analysis settings.** Settings → Playback → Ketmix → *Title analysis* sets how much of
  the phone's processor goes into listening to titles before a mix: *Light* (30 seconds per
  title, tempo and levels), *Balanced* (45 seconds and the key, the default) or *Maximum*
  (75 seconds, the key, and a check that the tempo holds).
- **The switch moved.** In the queue, Ketmix is now the first button of the bar under the
  transport, left of shuffle, repeat and autoplay. Its status line sits above the progress
  bar; nothing floats over the list any more.

## A new dark theme

- A neutral near-black instead of the blue-grey one, three steps of surface above it, softer
  separators and calmer secondary text.
- Pages are lit from above by a soft glow of the accent colour that stays in place while the
  content scrolls.

## A new Home

- The page opens on a large card (a paused title with how far it had got, a fresh release or
  the mix of the hour) with a glow of its own artwork's colour.
- Shortcuts are tiles that say how much is behind them; recent titles are tiles to start
  again from (a long press opens a title's menu), or large covers with the toggle.
- *Your week* shows the seven days as bars, today in the accent colour.

## Lyrics

- The three dots before the first line fill one after the other without steps, breathe while
  they wait, then swell and vanish as the line arrives.

## Albums

- An album page takes its colour from the Canvas while one plays at its top, and from the
  cover as soon as there is none.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.1.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.1.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Automix that tells you what it is doing, mixes albums too, and artist signatures that show up.

## Automix

- **It mixes albums too.** Albums played in order are no longer left alone: a new setting,
  *Mix albums too* (on by default), lets Automix mix them as well. An album whose titles run
  straight into each other, with no gap at all, is still left as it is.
- **It says why it is not mixing.** A line next to the Automix button in the queue, and in
  Settings → Playback → Automix, shows what Automix is doing: preparing the next title, the
  mix coming up in so many seconds and how it will be done, a mix in progress, or why there
  is none (repeat, sleep timer, bit-perfect output, last title of the queue…).
- **The next title is loaded early.** Preparation starts two and a half minutes before the end
  of a title, so the next one is resolved and read well before any mix begins; a title that
  cannot be found is tried again instead of being given up at once.
- **Stronger mixes.** Balanced mixes now run up to 16 seconds and can start up to 25 seconds
  into an instrumental ending; DJ mixes go up to 32 seconds and start as soon as the singing is
  over; crossfades are longer (8 s balanced, 12 s DJ).
- **A mix is never planned over the body of a title.** When there are no lyrics to say where
  the singing stops, the mix waits for the outro.

## Artists

- **Signatures show up again.** Signatures from the public signature archive are now asked
  for alongside the artwork service instead of after it: when that service is busy (it often
  answers "temporarily unavailable"), the signature is still shown. Files named after the
  artist with a possessive or a number ("Eminem's signature", "Travis Scott signature 01")
  are recognised too.

releases.name: Ketvoice 5.0.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 5.0.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Automix: titles flow into each other like a mix.

## Automix

- **Turn it on from the queue or from Settings.** A new button at the bottom left of the
  queue (two overlapping rings) switches Automix on and off; Settings → Automix has the
  same switch. It is off until you turn it on.
- **A real mix, not only a fade.** Towards the end of a title, the next one is brought in
  at the same tempo (its speed follows the outgoing title, its pitch is kept), beats
  aligned, and the bass passes from one title to the other on a beat. Once the outgoing
  title is gone, the new one glides back to its own tempo.
- **Lyrics are respected.** Synchronised lyrics tell where the singing stops and starts:
  the mix waits for the end of the last sung line, and a transition is shortened rather
  than leaving two voices singing over each other.
- **The right transition for each pair.** A beat mix when the tempos are close; a plain
  crossfade when they are too far apart or when there is no steady beat; and when a title
  ends on a last note at full level, that note is left alone and only the silence after
  it is removed.
- **Some listening is never mixed.** Albums played in order, a repeated title, the sleep
  timer and bit-perfect output keep their titles exactly as they are.
- **Three intensities.** Discreet (short transitions, the title plays to its end),
  Balanced, and DJ (longer mixes that start as soon as the singing is over).
- **You see it happen.** A "Mixing" badge breathes with the beat over the artwork, the two
  covers dissolve into each other, a second fine line runs above the progress bar, and
  the mini-player shows the same dissolve.
- **On the device.** The tempo, the beats and the shape of each title's start and end
  are measured on the device and kept, so a title is only measured once.

## Look

- **One capsule for a page's actions.** On album and artist pages, the actions at the top
  sit side by side in a single capsule of glass instead of separate bubbles; the album's
  Download and Refresh share one too.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.17.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.17.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Smoother lyrics, a navigation bar that comes back when you need it, and glass that
catches the light.

## Lyrics

- **Share a moment works again.** After a long-press on lyrics, the Share button now
  sits beside Cancel; before, Cancel took the whole row and hid it.
- **Sung lines stay white.** In the Ketvoice and Cascade styles, lines already sung keep
  full brightness; only the lines still to come are dimmed.
- **A smoother Cascade.** The lines below glide into place one after another on a soft
  ease-out, without the jump and overshoot of before.

## Navigation

- **The bar comes back on a small scroll up.** On Home, Explore and Library, the floating
  bar and mini-player fold when you scroll down and unfold as soon as you scroll back up a
  little, wherever you are on the page.
- **Pages push like on iOS.** A new page slides in from the edge on a spring while the
  page underneath recedes and dims; going back reverses it.

## Look

- **Liquid Glass catches the light.** Buttons and bars gain a broad, soft highlight on
  the bevel facing the light and a light Fresnel edge, closer to the glass of iOS.
- **A tighter album page.** Title, artist and details sit closer together, and track
  rows are more compact, so more of the album fits on screen.
- **Artist signatures.** With artist signatures enabled in Settings, an artist without
  an authenticated signature can now show one from the public signature archive
  (Wikimedia Commons and a CC0 archive), matched to the exact artist name.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.16.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.16.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Curated artwork from Ketvoice, everywhere you look.

## Artwork

- **Curated covers, Canvas and artist photos.** When Ketvoice gives a title, an album
  or an artist a refreshed cover, Canvas or photo, it now appears across the app: the
  player and mini-player, lists, search, Home, album and artist pages, the lock screen
  and the widget. They arrive without an app update and are kept for offline use.
- An album's artwork also applies to each of its titles, and a title's Canvas follows
  its album when the title has none of its own.
- Artist pages fit a wide photo to its real shape instead of a square crop.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.16.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.16.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A Home that knows you a little better, a more polished player, and moments to share.

## Home

- **For you.** A large card at the top changes with what you were doing: a paused
  title to pick up where you left off, a new release from an artist you play, or the
  mix that suits the hour (your morning, your afternoon, your evening mix, for the night).
- **New from your artists.** The latest albums and singles of the artists you play
  most, from the public catalogue.
- **Your week.** Listening time, plays, artist and title of the last seven days, kept
  on the device. It appears once there is a week to tell.
- **Shelves that learn.** The shelves you open most move up; the ones you never open
  move down. The first personal shelf keeps its place, and nothing moves while you browse.
- **Editorial titles.** Section titles are larger, and a chevron shows when a section
  opens a full page (Recent, Pinned, catalogue albums).

## Player

- Paused, the artwork steps back with a small bounce; playing, it comes forward again.
- The progress bar swells under the finger and settles back when released.
- The colour background behind the player moves more slowly and reacts more gently.
- The mini-player shows a fine progress line in the accent colour, and its cover plays
  the title's Canvas when there is one.

## Lyrics

- **Cascade style** in Settings → Appearance → Lyrics style: the sung line alone stands
  forward, the others step back and follow it in a wave. The Ketvoice style stays the
  default.
- **Share a moment.** Long-press one or two lines to make a vertical card for a story:
  the lines, the cover and its colours, shared with a link that opens the title in
  Ketvoice. The title menu also has **Share a moment**, with the line being sung.

## Library

- Playlists and albums show as a grid of large covers in their own views.

## Validation

Host tests: 642 mobile and 641 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.15.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.15.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The album page takes the effect of the artist page.

## Album page

- **The cover leads.** The cover, or its Canvas, fills the top of the page from edge to
  edge and dissolves into the page without a line.
- **The page takes its colour from the cover.** The dominant colour of the cover tints
  the whole page: a pastel of it on a light theme, a deep shade on a dark one.
- **Sized with care.** The artwork is the full square of the cover when the window
  allows it, and never more than 46 % of the window height nor 420 dp, so the title
  and the Play button stay on the first screen.
- **Never a band of the cover.** On a window much wider than the artwork is tall, the
  cover is shown whole, centred over a soft enlarged copy of itself, instead of being
  cut to a strip.
- The name, the artist, the facts and the Play and Shuffle pair are centred under the
  artwork. A wide pane keeps the artwork beside the text.

The tint follows the **album colours** setting, as on the artist page.

## Validation

Host tests: 619 mobile and 618 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

# Ketvoice 4.14.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

The artist page, shown the way it should be.

## Artist page

- **The portrait leads again.** It fills the top of the page from edge to edge instead
  of floating in a circle.
- **The page takes its colour from the portrait.** The dominant colour of the photo
  tints the whole page: a pastel of it on a light theme, a deep shade on a dark one.
  The colour settles in once the photo is read.
- **No line where the photo ends.** The portrait dissolves into that same colour, so
  photo and page read as one surface.
- The name, the listeners and the Play and Shuffle pair are centred under the portrait.

The tint follows the existing **album colours** setting: with it off, the page keeps
its plain background. Album, playlist and Downloads keep the layout of 4.14.0.

## Validation

Host tests: 615 mobile and 614 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.14.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.14.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

One layout for album, playlist, artist and Downloads, and the rest of the interface
brought in line with it.

## One collection page

Album, playlist, artist and Downloads now share the same header:

- the colours of the cover, blurred, from edge to edge;
- the artwork floating over them as a square with depth (a circle for an artist, a
  mosaic of your latest covers for Downloads);
- the name, the artist and one line of facts, centred;
- **Play** and **Shuffle** as a pair, then the secondary actions.

On a wide or short window the artwork sits beside the text. The album no longer opens
on a full-width picture.

## A title bar that follows you

Once the header has scrolled away, the bar at the top shows the name of the page in a
glass capsule and a small Play button. Album, playlist and Downloads have it; the
artist page already kept its name and quick actions.

## Liquid 27: buttons of one piece

- **Play and Shuffle are one body of glass.** In the Liquid 27 style, pressing either
  one pulls a bridge of liquid between them; they part again when the finger lifts.
- **Menus grow out of what opened them.** The menu of a title, and the other sheets,
  now expand from the place you touched instead of sliding up from nowhere.
- **A sliding lens on selectors.** Titles / Albums / Artists in Downloads and Local
  music, and All / Sources / Library in Search, select with a lens of glass that
  slides from one choice to the next.

## The menu of a title

Five round glass buttons lead the menu: favourite, play next, add to queue, download
and share. The list below keeps the rest.

## One row for a title

Catalogue and mix pages, artist pages, Local music and Replay now draw a title with
the same row: cover with its download state, the format badge of a saved file,
animated bars while it plays, and the menu button. Swiping a row uncovers a capsule of
tinted glass instead of a flat band.

## Page opening

When a page is opened from a card, its artwork continues the movement: it starts at
the size of that card and settles into its place.

## Validation

Host tests: 613 mobile and 612 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.13.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.13.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

One set of glass buttons for every collection, cover colours behind the headers, and a
navigation bar that takes a little more time to split.

## Glass buttons

- **Two buttons, everywhere.** The main action of a page is a **prominent** capsule
  tinted with the accent colour; the other actions are plain glass capsules of the
  same height. Album, playlist, artist, Downloads, Library, Local music and Replay now
  share this pair instead of five different pills.
- **Liquid 27 press.** In the Liquid 27 style a glass button swells evenly under the
  finger, its rim light turns towards the touch, and it settles with a small bounce
  when released. This follows the documented behaviour of interactive Liquid Glass;
  Apple does not publish its exact values, so it is a close reproduction. The other
  glass styles keep their press.
- The round glass buttons of the app (back, share, download, quick actions) get the
  same Liquid 27 press.

## Collection pages

- **Cover colours behind the header.** Playlist, artist and Downloads headers carry a
  soft glow taken from their cover. The glow is a layer of its own, so the glass
  buttons placed on it refract the artwork.
- **Playlist.** Play and Shuffle now lead as a pair, like on an album; reordering is a
  quieter third button. The cover gains depth.
- **Album.** Play is the prominent glass button, and the title that is playing shows
  animated bars in the track list.
- **Artist.** The portrait's colours continue under the name and the actions.
- **Downloads.** The summary card shows your three latest covers, and its storage bar
  is easier to read.

## Navigation bar

- The morph of the navigation bar, where Home, the mini-player and Search merge and
  split like droplets, is 3 % slower so it can be seen.

## Validation

Host tests: 608 mobile and 607 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.12.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.12.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

Skip tracks from anywhere, a queue you can see and shape, and four screens brought up to date.

## Playback

- **Next and Previous outside the app.** The media notification, the lock screen,
  headset and Bluetooth buttons and the other system media controls can now skip to
  the next or the previous title. Until now they could only play and pause.
- **Shuffle you can see.** Turning shuffle on reorders the queue itself: the current
  title stays, every other title is shuffled, and the queue shows exactly what plays
  next. Turning it off puts the queue back in its original order. The Shuffle buttons
  of albums, playlists and mixes start on a random title.
- **A real Previous.** It returns to the title you actually came from. After the first
  three seconds it restarts the current title, as before.
- **Repeat the queue.** The repeat control now cycles through off, queue and title.
- **The next title is ready before the end.** In the last 25 seconds of a title, the
  stream of the next one is resolved, or resolved again if it was resolved too long
  ago, so the change of title does not wait for the network.
- **Sleep timer on phones.** In the title menu: 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes with a short
  fade-out, or **At the end of the song**. It was only available on Quest.
- **Swipe to change title** on the mini-player and on the artwork of the player.

## Queue

- Reordering is live: the other rows move out of the way while you drag.
- Swipe a title aside, or tap ✕, to remove it, with **Undo**.
- **Clear** the queue, with Undo, and **Save** it as a playlist.
- On tablets and Quest, shuffle, repeat and autoplay are now inside the queue panel.

## One set of gestures in every list

Album, catalogue and mix pages, artist pages, Library, Downloads, playlists, Replay,
Local music and Search now behave the same way:

- swipe a title to **play it next** or **add it to the queue**, with an icon, a tick
  when releasing would act, and a spring back;
- long-press a title to open its menu;
- the title that is playing shows animated bars.

## Replay

- The time you really spent listening.
- Tapping an artist opens their page, or a search for their name. It used to open an
  empty search.
- Play, shuffle or save your most played titles as a playlist.

## Local music

- The screen now asks for the audio permission, explains why, and points to the app
  settings if it was refused. The permission was never requested, so the whole-device
  library looked empty.
- Search, sorting by title, artist, album or duration, **Titles, Albums and Artists**
  views, and Play and Shuffle buttons.

## Search

- An **Albums** shelf from the public catalogue.
- **Library** now searches downloads, playlists, local files and the titles you have
  played, and finds playlists by name. It only searched downloads.
- Results no longer blank at every letter typed.

## Explorer

- Trending songs, albums and artists from the catalogue chart, above the genres.

## Fixes

- "Play next", "Sleep timer", "Repeat song" and "plays counted" were mistranslated in
  the ten languages other than French.
- Repeat on a queue of a single title keeps repeating instead of stopping after the
  second play.

## Not included

Gapless playback and crossfade are not part of this release: the audio engine still
holds one title at a time.

## Validation

Host tests: 603 mobile and 602 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.11.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.11.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A more personal Home, mixes made from your listening, and a redesigned Downloads screen.

## Home

- **A greeting, not a slogan.** The title follows the time of day.
- **Shortcuts to what you have.** Shuffle play, Favourites, Offline and History appear
  only when there is something behind them.
- **A little different at each launch.** The first personal shelf always leads; the
  album row and the other shelves take turns from one launch to the next, and nothing
  moves while you browse.

## Your mixes

After ten plays, Home proposes up to four mixes built from the listening history kept
on the device:

- **{Artist} Mix** — your tracks by an artist you play a lot, then their essentials.
- **In the style of {Artist}** — tracks by similar artists from the public catalogue.
- **On repeat** — what you play the most.
- **Rediscover** — tracks you played before and have not heard recently.

Your most played artist always keeps a mix; the others rotate at each launch and stay
put while the app is open. Any mix can be kept with **Save as playlist**, under its
name in your language. Artist and style mixes need a connection when
opened; On repeat and Rediscover work offline.

## Downloads

- A summary card: titles, size, total play time, the lossless share of your storage,
  free space on the device, and the offline capsule.
- **Titles, Albums or Artists** in one segmented control, with a new Artists view.
- **Sort** by most recent, title, artist or size.
- Each title shows its real stored format as a badge (lossless stands out), its size,
  and small marks for saved lyrics and Canvas.
- Transfer-state filters only appear while something is being transferred.

## Validation

Host tests: 544 mobile and 543 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.10.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.10.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A design release: motion, Liquid Glass, formats and accessibility.

## Motion

- **Shared artwork.** Opening the player no longer just unmasks it: the artwork
  grows out of the mini-player cover and the controls rise into place, all on the
  one timeline that already drives the reveal, the drag-to-dismiss and the close.
- **Predictive back (Android 14+).** Holding the system back gesture shrinks the
  current page under the finger and slides it away from the swiped edge; in the
  player, it pulls the player toward the mini-player. Releasing commits, sliding
  back cancels.
- **Compact glass title.** When Listen Now, Explorer or Library is scrolled, its
  large title is echoed by a small glass capsule under the status bar, in step with
  the collapsing bottom chrome.
- **Haptics.** A light tick on glass buttons, tab changes, the released seek bar and
  a new favourite. One switch in Appearance; never on Quest.
- **Startup profile.** A baseline profile for Ketvoice's own startup and first-scroll
  code is now bundled and installed for sideloaded builds.

## Liquid Glass

- **Droplet fusion (Liquid 27).** Home, the mini-player and Search are now one glass
  body. At rest they are separate; while the chrome collapses or expands they pull
  liquid bridges and merge like droplets, then split again. Other styles and
  fallbacks keep three separate panels.
- **Droplet tab lens.** The selection lens leaves with its leading edge first and
  gathers its trailing edge afterwards, so it stretches between two tabs like a drop.
- **Cover-tinted glass.** The dominant colour of the playing cover lightly tints the
  optical glass (Clair, Dépoli and Liquid 27). The legibility stage runs after the
  tint, so labels keep their contrast. Optional.
- **Animated player background.** A slow mesh of the cover's colours drifts behind
  the player and breathes with the low end of the music. It is static with reduced
  motion and on Quest, and off in performance mode. Optional.

## Formats

- **Home-screen widget.** Now playing with cover, title and transport, in three
  responsive sizes, as a frosted rounded card. A widget cannot refract what is
  behind it, so it is frosted, not optical glass.
- **Tabletop posture.** On a flip-style phone half-opened on a table, the artwork
  and lyrics stay above the hinge and the controls below it.
- **Notification and lock screen** use the same enriched cover as the app.

## Accessibility and continuity

- Section titles are announced as headings, the play button reports its state, and
  the mini-player announces the new title when the track changes.
- Reduced motion now also follows the system *transition* animation scale.
- After Android reclaims the app in the background, Ketvoice reopens on the page and
  back stack you left, instead of the home tab.

## Validation

Host tests: 521 mobile and 520 Quest tests pass, with lint and the UI text audit.
The Liquid 27 fusion shader and the mesh shader are compiled and evaluated by host
render tests, and the fused chrome is exercised by a host interaction test.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.9.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.9.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Liquid 27 — a fourth glass style

**Settings → Appearance → Glass preview** now offers **Liquid 27** next to Clair,
Dépoli and Opaque. It is a separate material (its own AGSL shader), so the three
existing styles render exactly as before.

It is modelled on the publicly described 2026 Liquid Glass refinements. Apple's
renderer is not public, so this is a close reproduction of the described and
observable behaviour, not a pixel-identical copy. No Apple fonts, symbols or
wallpapers are used.

- **Continuous corners.** Cards and sheets use a superellipse corner that stays
  inside the shape's clip. Capsules and circles stay true capsules.
- **Uniform refraction.** A convex lens of constant strength all around the edge
  (the normal is computed numerically, so corners do not bend harder than straight
  edges), with a slight magnification of the whole body.
- **Clear ↔ Tinted.** The existing transparency slider drives the material: almost
  no blur when clear, frosted and milkier when tinted. Choosing Liquid 27 for the
  first time starts the slider at its midpoint, the reference default; a value
  you set yourself is kept.
- **Defined borders, no drop shadow.** A thin lit rim faces the light, a softer
  bounce sits on the opposite edge, and there are no inner or drop shadows.
- **Lighter dark material** and **luminance-adaptive milk**: the backdrop under each
  control is measured (five taps) so the glass adapts to the content behind it.
- **Highlights follow tilt.** The light direction follows the gravity sensor at UI
  rate, ignores sub-degree jitter and rests at the top-left default with reduced
  motion, on Quest and with the other styles.
- **Touch glow.** Pressing a glass control spreads light from the finger and
  increases the lens pressure. Pointers are observed, never consumed, so every
  control keeps its own gestures.
- **Scroll-edge fade.** Content fades under the status bar and the floating chrome,
  inside the captured layer, so the glass refracts the faded content.

Tilt and touch values are read in the draw phase only: they redraw the glass layer
without recomposing the panel.

### Fallbacks

| Situation | Liquid 27 renders as |
| --- | --- |
| Android 13+ | Liquid 27 AGSL shader |
| Android 12, low-RAM device, reduced motion | Library blur and lens with the Liquid 27 border, no shadow |
| Glass disabled, performance mode, captured panel | Static material with the Liquid 27 border, no shadow |

### Not included

The liquid merging of separate glass elements (for example Home, mini-player and
Search joining like droplets during the collapse animation) needs every element in
one shader pass. It is not part of this release.

## Discord

- The Social SDK only delivers status, authorization, log and presence results from
  `discordpp::RunCallbacks()`. The bridge never called it, so no callback was ever
  delivered: presence confirmations, errors and the linked account's Ready state
  were never observed. A 50 ms main-thread pump now runs while a client exists. It
  does not hold the bridge mutex, because callbacks re-enter Kotlin.
- CI can now build Discord-enabled APKs without committing the SDK: a private AAR
  URL in a secret, its SHA-256 pinned in a repository variable, and a check that the
  release APKs contain `libdiscordbridge.so`.
- The OAuth User-Agent now reports the real app version.

## Fixes

- **Ignorer les silences** could never be turned on: the value travelled in the
  command extras while the service read the arguments, then saved `false`.
- **Privacy:** the website's "Listening now" receives the title, artist and cover
  only after you turn on **Partager le titre en cours sur le site** (Playback). The
  listener count itself stays anonymous.
- **Server:** the listener heartbeat is rate-limited, requires the app key, accepts
  only a well-formed client id, strips control and bidirectional characters, and
  keeps a cover only when it is a plain public HTTPS URL. `SECURITY.md` now
  describes the real `verify_jwt` configuration of `ketvoice-api`.
- **Storage:** the lyrics (64 MB), artwork (768 MB) and Canvas (512 MB) caches are
  now bounded, least recently used first. Covers and Canvas files that downloads use
  are never deleted.
- **Translations:** the Discord and System language strings added in 4.8.1–4.8.2
  are translated into all ten other languages, so the UI text audit that CI runs
  passes again. The artist-page accessibility label is now translated too.
- **Settings:** "Downloads on Wi-Fi only" moved from Appearance to Downloads.
- **CI:** the keystore generation workflow no longer prints the keystore in the job
  log; it is only in a one-day artifact.
- **Docs:** the Quest guide points to the latest release instead of 2.11.0.

## Validation

The signed APKs were built by GitHub Actions (run 43507175910) with the Discord
Social SDK, whose SHA-256 is pinned. Release builds, debug and release unit tests
for both flavors (487 mobile and 486 Quest host tests in the debug variants), the
UI text audit, lint, the signature pin and the Discord bridge packaging check
passed. The Liquid 27 AGSL shader is compiled and evaluated by a host render test.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.8.2

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord presence without account linking

- Discord Rich Presence on Android is now published through the **installed Discord app over RPC**, which is the path Discord documents for presence without authentication (Android, Social SDK 1.10+). It needs neither an OAuth token nor a `Ready` gateway connection.
- The Discord panel now offers **Afficher via l'app Discord** as the primary action. Ketvoice creates a bare SDK client that only knows the application ID and sends the activity whenever a track plays. The Discord app must be installed, open and signed in.
- Each presence update reports its result: success clears the error, and a refusal shows the SDK message under the action.
- Account linking remains available under **Lier mon compte Discord (avancé)** for account features, but it is no longer required for the listening status. The previous gateway loop was bounded, and it no longer restarts every time the app returns to the foreground.
- The Discord activity keeps the **Listening** type and its status line now shows the track title instead of only the application name.
- Diagnostics report the mode (`app-discord-rpc` or `compte`), whether the last presence update succeeded and its error, plus the last SDK log line.

## Language and previous work

- The 4.8.1 device-language behaviour is retained: Ketvoice starts in the phone language when supported, offers an explicit **System language** entry and clears a previously pinned per-app locale.
- All 4.8.0 playback, search, backup, lyric, Home and restricted offline DASH behaviour is retained.

## Validation limits

No phone or Quest was connected for this build. JVM/Robolectric tests, lint, signatures and checksums do **not** prove that the installed Discord app accepts the RPC presence, that Discord renders it on another client, or that the language switch is visible on a physical device. The panel now returns the exact SDK result, so a refusal is diagnosable instead of silent. Discord never shows your own presence buttons to you; verify from another account or device.

For update compatibility these APKs use the existing public Android debug signing identity, not a private production signing key. Never uninstall an existing installation to resolve a signature conflict without backing up its data.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.8.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.8.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Device language by default

- On first launch Ketvoice now starts in the device language whenever one of its eleven interface languages matches it (Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, English or French). An unsupported device language falls back to English.
- The per-app locale is aligned with that choice: while no language has been chosen explicitly, any locale pinned by an older installation is cleared, so changing the phone language later is picked up without reinstalling.
- Settings → Language contains an explicit **System language** entry, so a manual choice can be reverted instead of being permanent.
- Choosing a language still overrides the device language and is remembered.

## Discord linking and presence

- A successful token exchange could still leave the panel on "waiting for the Discord app" forever, because the SDK callbacks were awaited without any deadline. The connection now has a bounded deadline and reports "account linked, presence inactive" instead of spinning.
- The same bounded deadline covers restored sessions and the SDK-owned exchange path.
- When the presence connection drops or never becomes ready, Ketvoice retries with backoff (15 s, 45 s, 90 s) instead of freezing the panel, and re-sends the current track as soon as the SDK reports ready.
- The WebView reads the authorization code from the bridge page URL once it loads, so a custom-scheme navigation blocked by the WebView no longer loses the code. A **Terminer** action and an explicit message replace the silent stall.
- `DiscordCallbackActivity` initialises the SDK engine context before completing the authorization, which a cold start previously skipped.
- Rich presence is declared as **Listening** instead of Playing, matching a music player.
- The account state and the presence state are shown separately, with an amber indicator and a **Vérifier la présence maintenant** action when the account is linked but Discord is not ready. The diagnostic panel reports whether the SDK considers the session authenticated.

## Compatibility and validation limits

The signed Mobile and Quest APKs include the existing Discord integration. All 4.8.0 playback, search, backup, lyric, Home and restricted offline DASH behaviour is retained. Eleven interface languages remain available. Group listening remains deferred.

No phone or Quest was connected for this build. JVM/Robolectric tests, lint, signatures and checksums do **not** prove the real Discord authorization round-trip, Discord-side presence rendering, device-language switching on a physical phone, audible playback or physical Quest behaviour. The Discord fixes remove known stuck states and add visible diagnostics; a real owner-session check is still required, and Discord does not display your own presence buttons to you.

For update compatibility these APKs use the existing public Android debug signing identity, not a private production signing key. Never uninstall an existing installation to resolve a signature conflict without backing up its data.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.8.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.8.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Playback and source choice

- Ordered network resolution follows the configured source priority; existing downloads and suitable cached audio remain available. Progressive mode starts an available source and may upgrade it later. When lossless is prioritized online, a lossy streaming cache is held as a fallback rather than silently taking precedence.
- After restarting the app, the last saved queue, duplicate entries, position and playback modes are restored paused. Pressing Play resolves the selected track; the app does not automatically start audio.
- Search displays results as providers answer. Confident recording matches are grouped and offer provider buttons; explicit source choices are tried first while respecting disabled sources and allowing fallback.
- Optional audio statistics show the selected decoder's format and known provider, with an HTTP status when applicable. Provider labels are not proof of bit-perfect output or of source provenance.

## Personal library and lyrics

- Export a versioned personal backup and preview it before importing. Existing playlists are not replaced; favorites and history merge. Saved non-sensitive settings replace the corresponding settings on this device. An interrupted import can leave already-merged additions in place and reports an error.
- Accounts, credentials, custom-source configurations, sensitive consent settings, artwork and audio files are excluded. A recognized public Spotify playlist URL is kept without its query string. Local media permissions may need to be granted again on another device. Per-track lyric offsets are included as hashed identifiers.
- Adjust lyric timing per track in the lyrics source sheet; the adjustment applies to synchronized lines, word highlights, translated lines and lyric seeking without modifying the provider's timings.
- Home uses available local listening history and favorites to favor familiar artists and reduce recent repeats. Existing optional YouTube Music personalization is retained.

## Restricted offline DASH

- A separate non-evicting download cache supports finite, single-period, single-representation, unprotected FLAC DASH using the stable Ketvoice Lossless proxy when the source explicitly declares `allowDownloads`. Downloaded ranges are checked before an item is shown as ready. Playback of these downloads uses a read-only offline data source; clearing the streaming cache does not delete them.
- The current Ketvoice Lossless manifest does **not** declare download permission. Its DASH downloads remain disabled until the source operator explicitly grants permission and the manifest is refreshed. Other DASH layouts and protected streams are not supported; no DRM is bypassed. A paused partial download with expired segment URLs may need to be cancelled and retried. Cached manifests can contain temporary segment URLs in app-private storage; they are not included in personal backups or logs.

## Compatibility and validation limits

The signed Mobile and Quest APKs include the existing Discord integration. Local files, normal downloads, streaming cache, Canvas, karaoke, Bit-Perfect settings, the restored player/navigation and the Quest landscape 2D layout are retained. Eleven interface languages remain available. Group listening remains deferred.

The owner requested publication with Discord after being informed that no phone or Quest was connected. JVM/Robolectric tests, synthetic offline fixtures, lint, signatures and checksums do **not** prove audible playback, real DASH decoding, system-picker behavior, real Discord authorization, USB bit-exact output, GPU rendering or physical Quest behavior. No fixed startup time or frame rate is claimed. The Lossless keep-alive remains best effort while the app process is alive and can be deferred by Android.

For update compatibility these APKs use the existing public Android debug signing identity, not a private production signing key. Never uninstall an existing installation to resolve a signature conflict without backing up its data.
