releases.name: Ketvoice 4.7.0 — optical glass redesign
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.7.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Optical glass, not a painted blur

- Directional edge reflections no longer illuminate both sides equally. Refraction, a restrained inner caustic and depth shading are evaluated by the existing AGSL material against captured content.
- Pressing a glass button changes the sampled edge displacement and optical normal, with an elastic release. The glyph and the touch target stay stable.
- Sliders capture their own independent track behind the thumb, so the thumb can refract its track without sampling itself. Dragging updates the thumb immediately.
- Static fallbacks have quieter highlights and less opaque floating controls. Android 12, reduced-motion, low-memory and performance-mode paths remain explicit fallbacks; they are not advertised as AGSL.

## Library and downloads

- The library now uses an editorial title, useful counts, clean grouped shortcuts and consistent outline icons instead of mismatched filled glyphs. Search, views, playlist import/pinning, local albums and multiple selection remain available.
- Floating library and download actions sample the scrollable content behind them. Filters have animated selection and proper accessible tab states.
- Downloads separate transfers from playable offline files, with an understated storage summary, matte rows and the existing real progress/pause/resume/retry controls. Batch deletion still requires confirmation.

## Albums and settings

- Album artwork blends into an image-derived surface without a white fog or hard separator. Adaptive portrait and landscape layouts retain Canvas, metadata, play/shuffle, downloads, refresh and sharing.
- Album actions use a separate captured artwork layer; top controls sample the scrolled page. Track rows and appearance changes animate while respecting reduced motion.
- Settings use restrained grouped cells, consistent 24-pixel outline icons, readable supporting text and accessible choice states. The glass preview remains live, adjustable and persistent, with cancel restoring the original tint.

## Preserved

The restored navigation and cover-first music-player arrangement, synchronized karaoke, all audio/provider behavior, local files, source priorities, eleven interface languages and the Quest landscape 2D player remain. AutoMix is not restored and group listening is not added.

## Validation boundaries

Host tests and software-rendered fixtures are not physical-device or hardware-GPU validation. No physical phone or Quest was connected. Emulator installation failed because the disk had insufficient free space. Device refraction calibration, gesture feel, measured frame rate, audible Tidal playback, Discord authorization and USB bit-exact output are not claimed.

The signed APKs retain the existing Android debug signing identity for update compatibility; this is not a private production certificate. Actual completed test/build/signature/checksum results are recorded in the accompanying validation metadata.

Draft only: publication is blocked until installation and visual/device calibration are validated.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.6.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.6.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Lossless and Tidal playback

- Stream answers are parsed as `dash`, `flac`, `aac` or a direct URL, and now carry
  their declared `mimeType` and `codec`. `application/dash+xml` is recognised even
  when the proxy URL has no `.mpd` extension.
- An extensionless DASH manifest is played by Media3's DASH source. Previously the
  proxy URL was treated as one progressive file, which is the documented cause of
  buffering that ended in a pause. The manifest and its segments use the direct
  network source; the audio cache only stores complete progressive files.
- Encrypted or DRM-protected manifests are rejected. No DRM is bypassed and no
  Tidal credential, token or signed audio URL is logged. Media3 logging is routed
  through a logger that keeps only the HTTP status.
- The resolution budget is per source instead of one small global limit, so a slow
  hosted service can still answer after a fast provider started playback.

## Playback state

- Play and Pause pressed during resolution only change the requested state; they no
  longer restart a provider race or discard the pending item.
- A rejected quality upgrade leaves the audible stream untouched instead of
  restarting it, which used to interrupt playback mid-track.
- A real playback failure shows an explicit message and stops the spinner. One 401
  or 403 refreshes the same source before the player moves to another provider.
- Sources already tried are excluded from fallback, and the addon's own alternatives
  are attempted before giving up: a failing Qobuz match no longer hides Tidal.

## Lossless addon as the primary source

- `https://ketvoice-lossless.onrender.com/manifest.json` is added once on first run,
  placed first in playback order, and requests its `lossless` tier. Removing or
  disabling it is respected and it is never re-added.
- A lightweight keep-alive request runs about every ten minutes while the app
  process is alive. Android may defer it under Doze or stop it when the app is
  force-stopped; an exact ten-minute schedule while the app is closed is not
  guaranteed.
- Prefetched next tracks reuse only the stable, unsigned `.onrender.com` DASH proxy
  URL, for at most one minute and only while that source stays enabled. Signed URLs
  are never stored for a later resume.

## Compatibility

Local files, downloads, cache, Bit-Perfect, gapless, crossfade, synchronized lyrics,
Canvas, the mini-player, the restored navigation and the Quest landscape layout are
unchanged. Eleven interface languages remain bundled. Group listening remains deferred.

## Validation limits

Recorded validation covers JVM/Robolectric tests, host fixtures, lint, signature and
16 KB alignment checks, and separately measured service responses. The hosted addon
returned HTTP 200 for stream resolution, HTTP 200 for an unprotected DASH manifest and
HTTP 206 for the first media segment. That is not proof of audible playback on a phone.

Not validated: installation on a physical phone or Quest, real GPU rendering, USB DAC
or bit-exact output, and audible Tidal playback end to end. No frame-rate or fixed
start-up time is claimed. The optional `/search/fast` addon endpoint is prepared but
not deployed by this release; the app falls back to the existing aggregate search.

Source, APK signatures and checksums are recorded in `validation.json`. The signing
identity is the existing public Android debug certificate kept for update compatibility.

Published with the owner-requested build and push after disclosure that no device was connected, so audible playback and rendering were not validated.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/290a137326de40fe0854d6bc16402c653a12ac49

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.6.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.6.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## A shared native material

- The existing Kyant Backdrop and Android AGSL renderer remain. Visual tokens
  now define the shared palette, typography, spacing, radii, motion, elevation
  and core glass parameters. No Apple-proprietary fonts are bundled.
- Floating controls use the actual captured backdrop where supported. API 31–32
  use blur, a legibility veil and a restrained highlight without claiming AGSL
  refraction. Reduced motion and low-memory devices use a cheaper blur path;
  disabled blur, high-performance mode, opaque mode and unavailable independent
  backdrops use a readable static fallback. Captured content never samples itself.
- Adaptive contrast keeps labels legible over bright and dark content. The
  slider in Appearance adjusts the glass tint continuously, updates the live
  preview, persists on release and restores the original value when cancelled.
  Clear, Frosted and Opaque modes remain available.

## Navigation and player

- The separate mini-player, navigation capsule and search button are retained.
  Their transitions use a shared spring, and compact layout depends on the actual
  available pane rather than the full device width. Mini transport controls have
  48 dp targets; small panes avoid overlapping navigation and search.
- The previously restored cover-first player layout remains. Floating track and
  playlist sheets use the shared material and expose their actions independently
  to accessibility services. The reverb control uses the app's custom slider
  while retaining the same audio control and persisted values.
- Playing bars stop their animation when playback is paused or reduced motion is
  active. Clean timed lyrics, backing vocals, Canvas, player gestures and the
  opt-in Stats info remain. The Quest 2D landscape layout remains unchanged.

## Settings and collection pages

- Settings retain their existing categories and options. Choice, accent, secret
  and glass-preview presentations use adaptive bottom sheets. The tint slider
  supports accessible progress, keyboard arrows and right-to-left pointer input.
- The equalizer and single-device Wi-Fi handoff dialogs use the same sheet and
  switch language. The existing explicit accept/refuse consent remains required;
  no handoff or audio processing logic is changed. Discord token entry remains
  password-masked and the existing presence consent callback is unchanged.
- Album compact actions reserve their space as the header collapses. Playlist
  headers blend title state continuously and use the available cover colour
  without a duplicate blurred-artwork pass. Reordering, unresolved entries,
  sharing, import/export, rename and deletion remain.
- Explorer categories use a contrast-protected matte surface and a layout that
  adapts to large fonts. Artist compact actions do not jump into the header, and
  Home actions use larger touch targets. Existing content and provider calls are
  retained; no new audio engine or publication authorization is introduced.

## Validation limits

The release metadata records unit tests, host/software fixtures, lint, signatures
and explicit validation limitations. Host Skia screenshots are not physical
phone or Quest screenshots and cannot validate actual GPU blur/refraction. Real
installation, hardware performance, frame rates, keyboard/gesture feel and live
provider or Discord sessions require device testing. No frame-rate guarantee or
unmeasured cost-saving percentage is claimed.

Some secondary legacy dialogs still use Material components, including the
offline capsule and publisher/account flows. The
"no default-looking components anywhere" criterion is therefore not yet fully
met; these flows have not been rewritten or claimed as device-validated.

The existing language-selection behaviour is unchanged and eleven interface
languages remain bundled. Karaoke, Canvas, existing playlists/downloads and
verified-owner server authorization are retained. Group listening remains deferred.

Published with the owner-authorized exception for absent device calibration and disclosed residual Material dialogs.
The compatibility signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production signing key.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/3d6d3dd6c12a4253acb60b15386cfbcaba36cf13

# Ketvoice 4.5.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

foreign-script alignment and backing vocals remain, without enlarged or diffused
word copies. The lyric-rendering files are unchanged from 4.5.0.

the phone artwork, absence of the added player tabs and the unchanged clean-lyric
pixel regression. Mobile/Quest JVM suites, release lint and APK verification are
recorded in `validation.json`. Instrumentation compilation is not execution.

Software previews are not physical device screenshots. Phone/Quest installation,
real GPU blur/refraction, controller/touch feel, measured FPS, live providers and

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.5.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.5.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Clean karaoke, without the doubled word effect

Sung words use exactly the same shaped glyph paths as the pending text. The
independently enlarged white word overlay and both diffused word copies are
removed, including their unused sustain/breathing machinery. The timing, foreign
script alignment, backing-vocal windows and white karaoke progression remain.
Held words do not acquire an offset, growing outline or delayed ghost after ending.

## One floating enclosure, not a pile of capsules

The mini-player, navigation and search now share a single optical enclosure. It
compacts into one row when the actual available width permits and expands without
replacing its transport component. Narrow windows retain the usable two-row form.
Only the moving navigation selection has its own inner lens; embedded controls
do not stack another complete glass surface on top of the enclosure.

## Glass that reacts without deforming its labels

The material adapts luminance in linear colour space, preserving backdrop colours
that already support readable content instead of applying a fixed grey veil.
Primary-label contrast is checked on bright, dark and coloured software fixtures.
The directional reflection follows the point of pressure and settles on release;
the surface compresses slightly while text, icons and hit targets remain stable.
Reduced motion removes this movement. Clear/Frosted/Opaque, matte content surfaces
and the safe unsupported-device/static fallbacks remain.

## A more coherent player and musical pages

- Pochette, Paroles and File d'attente have an explicit shared page selector.
  Phone identity and transport stay anchored across those views, and companion
  pages retain their saved list state. The cover view keeps immersive artwork.
- Tablet and Quest expose the same page choices without replacing the existing
  landscape 2D layout. Canvas focus, optional Stats info and the independent
  account/output/source actions remain.
- Album and artist pages expose compact playback/shuffle actions when the hero
  scrolls away. Both use the same large-font-safe action layout as the offline
  library. Album images remain full-bleed on phones.
- Artist identity is left-aligned below a shorter portrait. The broad whitening
  fade, duplicate blurred image pass and oversized fallback letter are removed.
  Available artist artwork and attribution remain, without invented sections.

## A library organised around your own music

- Search and views for Tout, Playlists, Albums, Titres and Artistes replace the
  repeated carousel dashboard. Favorites, Downloads, Local music and Replay stay
  directly accessible; playlist creation and Spotify/file imports are retained.
- Albums can be grouped from local metadata without a remote catalogue ID or an
  additional album request. Different artists' unnamed catalogue editions are
  kept separate; real compilation IDs keep their tracks together.
- Playlists can be pinned or unpinned. Pins are stored with the existing playlist
  JSON, remain backward-compatible with older files, and appear on Home as well
  as in the library. A failed persistent write is not announced as a saved change.
- Multiple selected songs can be played or added to the queue together. Catalogue
  media and server-side publication permissions are not changed by this feature.

## Offline management and a more personal Home

- Downloads add real state filters, local album grouping and multiple selection.
  Batch deletion shows the selected titles, count and size before confirmation;
  cancellation leaves every file intact. A failed file deletion keeps its metadata
  and remains an error instead of silently pretending success.
- Home leads with Resume listening when local listening state is available and
  shows pinned playlists. Its existing feed is de-duplicated into at most three
  recommendation shelves. This presentation makes no additional recommendation
  requests; the existing provider/cache behaviour is retained.

## Validation scope

JVM and native-software host checks cover unchanged lyric pixels after a held
word, primary-label shader contrast, stationary glyph bounds during pressure,
transport placement, local album grouping, filter separation, pin compatibility
and persistence, and cancellation/failure of destructive file operations.
The Windows host uses a same-directory atomic-move fixture for the AtomicFile
boundary; it is not proof of physical Android storage behaviour.

Software renders and mocked/host contracts are not physical phone or Quest
screenshots. Real GPU blur/refraction, install/launch, touch/controller feel,
measured FPS, live providers/downloads, DAC behaviour and owner-session Discord
consent/presence still require device validation. Instrumentation compilation is
not instrumentation execution.

French remains the default among eleven interface languages. Canvas and karaoke
are retained, group listening remains deferred, and verified-owner publishing
authorization remains server-enforced and unchanged.

Published with the explicit owner-authorized override for unperformed device checks.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/68e015a81ff83d69a6df94f805f8d70140efbaa7

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.4.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Glass with a quieter centre

- Clear controls retain more of their real backdrop: less blur, restrained
  saturation, a narrow refracting edge and a finer directional rim. The broad
  diagonal streak and corner halo are removed. The shader no longer stacks its
  colour treatment on top of a second vibrancy pass.
- Expanded and compact navigation use the same moving-selection material instead
  of separate, strongly distorting lenses. Pressing a glass button compresses it
  slightly rather than enlarging it. Navigation colour fades now respect reduced
  motion as well as the positional transitions.
- Clear, Frosted and Opaque remain available. Matte content panels stay matte;
  readable static fallbacks remain for unsupported or disabled optical rendering.
  Static controls now clip their contents to their actual shape.

## Downloads rebuilt around what is really on disk

- A compact offline-library summary replaces the large collection-artwork collage.
  Playback and shuffle are offered only when saved files exist.
- Transfers and saved tracks have separate sections. A transfer is never treated
  as a playable offline file, and completed/cancelled entries do not linger in the
  transfer section. Failed entries can be retried or dismissed.
- Local search filters by title, artist or album without altering the stored files.
  Offline playback from the filtered list uses that list's order.
- Each transfer shows its state once. Byte progress is determinate only when a
  total is known; unknown-length transfers do not invent a percentage. Restored
  pauses expose Resume even when they have no active worker.
- Deleting a saved file now requires confirmation. Cancel keeps the file locally:
  there is no misleading Undo action that silently starts another download.
- Saved rows show actual format and file size, saved lyrics/Canvas availability,
  and a 48 dp delete target. The list scrolls independently of the back header.

## Albums rebuilt as a reading and listening surface

- Phone artwork remains edge-to-edge, starting at the window top, without a square
  cover card. A shorter hero brings the identity and playback actions closer to the
  first screen. The image fades only near its lower edge into the actual page.
- Title, artist, year, track count and total duration form a left-aligned identity
  block. On wide windows the artwork and identity sit beside one another; both
  scroll away normally instead of leaving a pinned blank area.
- Large fonts on narrow windows stack the playback actions instead of breaking
  their labels. Reduced motion removes list movement and artwork parallax.
- Numbered track rows no longer repeat the same album thumbnail. Current-track
  emphasis, saved-file indicators, durations, track options and swipe queue actions
  remain available. Back and share remain floating glass controls.
- Album Canvas keeps its independent setting and its reduced-motion/performance
  fallback. Player Canvas, karaoke, optional Stats info and the landscape 2D Quest
  player layout are not replaced by this redesign.

## Validation scope

Unit and native-software host tests cover section separation, local filtering,
failed-transfer dismissal, confirmation cancellation with the file preserved,
restored pauses, empty libraries, large-font/narrow and short-landscape albums,
and shader edge displacement without centre warping. The image preview uses a
decoded local fixture injected into the image loader, not a live provider.

Software previews are not device screenshots. Real GPU blur/refraction, physical
phone/Quest installation, controller feel, measured FPS, DAC behaviour and live
provider/download/Discord sessions require device validation. No new evidence for
those checks is implied by a passing host suite or by compiled instrumentation.

French remains the default; four new labels are supplied in all ten other
interface languages. No group-listening feature or publisher authorization change
is included. Existing released tags and assets remain intact.

Published with an explicit owner-authorized override for the unperformed device checks.

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.3.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.3.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Ten languages stop falling back to French

- 116 user-facing strings existed only in French, so German, Spanish, Japanese,
  Korean and the other nine languages showed raw French on those screens. They
  are now written by hand in every table: playback and source ordering, the
  Bit-Perfect status panel, download queue and Wi-Fi states, updater errors,
  Discord diagnostics, the listening recap and share actions.
- Placeholders, brand names and units are preserved exactly, so composed labels
  still reorder their arguments per language and `Hz`, `Bit-Perfect`, `GitHub`
  and `{0} min` keep their original form.
- Strings that only look like UI copy — structured log fields, `Accept-Encoding`
  and `Cache-Control`, cache keys such as `artist:{0}:{1}`, Compose animation
  tags and `.apk`/`.fileprovider` patterns — stay out of the catalogs on purpose.
  They are listed with a reason in `tools/ui-text-ignored.json`.
- The catalog now holds 1065 messages per language. French remains the default
  among the eleven interface languages; no layout, navigation or playback
  behaviour changed in this release.

## The gap cannot reopen unnoticed

- `tools/audit_ui_texts.py --check` scans the UI and message sources and fails
  when a user-facing string has no bundled translation, and also when an allowlist
  entry goes stale because it was finally translated. CI runs it on every push.
- `tools/complete_ui_translations.py` no longer overwrites the shipped catalog.
  It drafts into `tools/machine-translations.proposal.json` and needs `--apply`
  after a human review, because that output is not shippable: it renders
  "Reprendre" as *Lebenslauf* / *Currículum* / *이력서*, "DISCORD" as *不和谐*
  and prefixes some Chinese values with `#`.
- `docs/TRANSLATIONS.md` documents the workflow, including the rule that
  `UiTextDictionaryTest` enforces identical key sets, non-empty values and
  placeholder preservation across all ten tables.

## Downloads that survive the process

- The download queue is now persisted to `files/download-queue.json`. A paused
  transfer comes back paused after the app is killed, a pending one restarts on
  its own, and a failed entry stays visible without holding a busy slot.
- Cancelling or deleting an entry removes it from the stored queue, and entries
  whose file already exists are pruned at load. Capsule downloads never enter the
  queue.
- A restored transfer restarts its bytes from zero: the queue entry and its state
  survive, partial file bytes do not.

## One stable signature for every APK

- Every CI build is signed with the same pinned certificate, so a new APK installs
  over the previous version instead of being refused as a conflicting package.
- The keystore secret is decoded with whitespace stripped and validated against a
  pinned certificate digest before compiling, and each built APK is re-checked
  after the build. A corrupt secret or a wrong-identity APK fails the run loudly
  instead of shipping.

## Validation and remaining limits

- Mobile and Quest JVM suites pass (1264 tests across the four variants, 0
  failures), lint reports no errors, and both release APKs are verified for
  package, version, ZIP integrity, 16 KB alignment, non-debuggable manifest and
  the pinned signing certificate. Exact counts and checksums are recorded in the
  release's `validation.json`.
- No phone, emulator or physical Quest was connected for this release, and an
  emulator boot was not possible locally for lack of free disk space. On-screen
  rendering of the new translations, real install/launch, USB DAC negotiation,
  hardware glass/Canvas, gesture feel, 60/90/120 FPS, live audio providers and
  Discord consent/presence remain unvalidated.
- Group listening remains deferred. Publishing and editing authorization is
  unchanged and still server-enforced for the verified owner account.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/3bee444262c746800e6eb472acc498d4e7acf5dd

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.3.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.3.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Navigation that keeps its place

- The active glass lens slides, stretches and settles with a controlled spring.
  Icons transition in size, opacity and lift; label weight and colour change
  smoothly in the expanded capsule. The compact capsule retains its moving lens.
- Root-tab content moves in the direction of selection. Saved tab state includes
  list/grid scroll positions, rather than resetting the page on every switch.
- Artist and album pages reveal from the selected card's measured window bounds.
  Closing reverses toward that stored origin, including in adaptive-width pages.
  Both pages retain their own request while overlapping: fast artist-to-artist
  navigation no longer substitutes new data into the outgoing page.
- The mini-player remains mounted independently of detail navigation. Reduced
  motion removes the spatial transitions and staggered entrances.

## Artist and album pages

- Artist profiles have a quiet loading skeleton, image-derived accents,
  progressively revealed artwork, staggered identity/actions and scroll-driven
  hero depth. The floating title and scrim appear continuously as the hero moves
  away. Scroll-driven layer properties avoid whole-header recomposition per pixel.
- Album artwork still starts behind the status bar, edge to edge. It reveals
  progressively and its pixels dissolve vertically into an album-coloured surface;
  no broad white overlay bleaches the image. The local tint then meets the page.
- Album metadata/actions enter together, loading track rows use discreet skeletons,
  and list updates animate in place. The top-bar title follows actual scroll bounds
  instead of switching abruptly when the first list item disappears.
- Canvas controls, independent album/player Canvas settings, queue swipes and the
  landscape 2D Quest layout remain. French remains the default among 11 languages.

## Bit-Perfect, with a real contract and an honest fallback

- **Settings → Playback → Bit-Perfect** requests Android 14+'s public
  `AudioMixerAttributes.MIXER_BEHAVIOR_BIT_PERFECT` contract. An advertised compatible
  mixer is required. Android currently exposes this path for compatible USB outputs;
  ordinary wired, Bluetooth and speaker paths normally remain standard output.
- A separate native `AudioTrack` writes decoded PCM without the standard sink's
  PCM conversion or app processing. Sample rate, encoding/bit depth and channel
  configuration must match the advertised mixer exactly. The app follows the real
  system route; an idle USB device does not steal playback from Bluetooth.
- **Active** is never inferred from the switch, audio focus or capability alone.
  It requires an accepted and still-owned mixer preference, the actual routed
  device, matching AudioTrack PCM, real bytes written while playing, unity app gain
  and no app DSP. Pause, seek/reset, loss of route or ownership revoke that status.
- Unsupported formats/outputs, refused preferences, digital attenuation and
  unverifiable routes fall back to standard playback with a reason. A removed
  USB/wired output pauses playback rather than unexpectedly playing on the speaker.
- EQ, reverb, skip-silence, Sonic Canvas PCM tapping and progressive quality handoff
  are bypassed while requested. Their settings remain available for standard mode;
  turning the mode off restores the ordinary processing path. AutoMix, normalization
  and crossfade are not added by this release.
- The settings status panel shows decoded PCM, negotiated output and device only
  when known. The player's audio readout remains **Appearance → Stats info**, optional
  and off by default, with no permanent audio badge.
- This is **not a proprietary exclusive USB driver**, a promise that every DAC
  supports exact playback, or proof of the original studio master/analog output.
  A lossy source remains lossy. System/hardware volume is still Android's concern;
  the app never claims to bypass vendor hardware or OS limits. The Active label
  describes the Android mixer contract for decoded PCM, not a physical bit capture.

## Validation and remaining limits

- Mobile and Quest JVM tests cover the proof table, PCM format mismatches, saved
  navigation state, nested back origins, outgoing route identity, rapid reversal,
  reduced motion, loading states and album scrolling. Native software host previews
  are not device screenshots.
- Robolectric platform fixtures exercise native sink writes, pause/seek/reconfigure,
  mixer refusal/ownership loss, route loss, incompatible rate/depth, Bluetooth/
  speaker refusal and non-unity-gain fallback. **These are mocked Android contracts,
  not real USB DAC playback or hardware bit comparisons.**
- Signed Mobile and Quest APKs, lint results, checksums and exact test counts are
  recorded in the release's `validation.json`. Instrumentation APKs are compiled,
  not run. Uploaded public downloads are checked against local SHA-256 hashes.
- No phone, emulator or physical Quest was connected. Real USB/wired DAC negotiation,
  disconnect behaviour, hardware blur/Canvas, gesture feel, 60/90/120 FPS, live audio
  providers/downloads and Discord account consent/presence remain unvalidated.
- In-process download pause still does not promise recovery after force-stop/reboot.
  Group listening remains deferred; publishing authorization is unchanged.

Android contract references: [preferred mixer attributes](https://source.android.com/docs/core/audio/preferred-mixer-attr)
and [AudioMixerAttributes](https://developer.android.com/reference/android/media/AudioMixerAttributes).

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/06911e7944e75b18a78640dae82d80e9f5d8a55c

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.2.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.2.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Album artwork without the white wash

- Album artwork begins at the window's top edge, behind the floating controls.
  The list no longer reserves a blank toolbar strip above it.
- Removed the large white/background dissolve painted over the lower image.
  A short colour transition sits **below** the artwork instead.
- Album accents are sampled from the album being viewed, not the song playing
  elsewhere. The album Canvas toggle stays independent from the player toggle;
  the video pauses when the hero scrolls out of view.
- Top controls sample the scrolling page instead of a disconnected blurred wash.

## One player opening and closing animation

- Replaced the stacked full-screen slide, separate flying cover and off-screen
  dismissal with one rounded-surface reveal from the mini-player's actual bounds.
- The player remains full-size behind the animated mask: text and video are not
  stretched between aspect ratios, and no duplicate artwork flies over the screen.
- Closing reverses the reveal. The handle drag drives the same presentation;
  short drags settle back. Rapid open/close reversals and reduced motion are covered
  by host regression tests. Quest retains its landscape two-column player.
- The mini-player and navigation now keep their component identity while their
  containers resize and move. Narrow phone windows retain the readable expanded
  layout instead of squeezing every control into a single row.

## More restrained glass and useful actions

- Reduced broad refraction, chromatic separation, heavy rim highlights and the
  milky blur on optical controls. Content menus use a calm matte surface.
- Appearance includes a **glass preview** on the current cover (or the Ketvoice
  logo when no cover exists): compare Clear, Frosted and Opaque without saving
  until Apply is pressed. Performance and reduced-blur fallbacks remain available.
- Track menus put Favorite, Play next and Download in a top quick-action row.
  Play/pause uses one interpolated glyph instead of crossfading two icons; favorite
  hearts and download paused/Wi-Fi/completed states have consistent feedback.
- Swipe album and search-result rows to Play next or Add to queue. A confirmation
  offers Undo for the **inserted queue occurrence**, even with duplicate songs.
  Undo never interrupts a song that has since become current. The same actions
  are available through accessibility actions. No swipe downloads or deletes media.

## Optional Stats info, not a permanent audio badge

- The audio readout is behind **Appearance → Stats info**, off by default, inside
  the player only. It reports the decoder-selected MIME format, sample rate,
  channel count and bitrate **when available**, the source, quality-search state
  and stream-error fallback. Unknown values remain unknown.
- A provider's format label alone is not used to claim lossless playback.

## Download controls that act on the transfer

- Pause/resume, cancel and retry actions; failures and cancelled tasks remain in
  the download screen rather than vanishing. Remaining bytes are shown only when
  the server supplies a total.
- Pause suspends further reads. Interrupted transfers request Range with a strong
  ETag or Last-Modified validator; inconsistent ranges or changed validators cannot
  be appended. A source refusing Range is restarted instead of corrupting the file.
- Optional Wi-Fi-only downloads wait before requesting a stream and before reading
  further audio chunks. The progress artwork distinguishes pause and Wi-Fi wait.
- These controls apply to the **current app process**, not an Android persistent
  download service. Pause is not a promise of resume after force-stop/reboot, and
  already-buffered bytes may arrive before a pause or connectivity change is seen.

## Validation and limitations

- Mobile/Quest JVM tests and native software host rendering; tests include reveal
  reversals, top-edge album bounds, optional stats, preference persistence, duplicate
  queue Undo, paused transfer, HTTP range/validator resume and the Wi-Fi gate.
- Transfer tests use in-memory HTTPS connection fixtures, **not live provider
  downloads**. Instrumentation APKs are compiled, not run on hardware.
- Release assets include signed Mobile and Quest APKs, checksums and validation
  metadata. Publication verifies anonymous downloaded bytes against local SHA-256.
- No connected phone, emulator or physical Quest was available. Hardware glass
  refraction/blur, Canvas decoding, gesture feel, device playback/downloads and
  Discord account consent are **not device-validated**. No FPS guarantee is made.
- French plus the ten other interface languages are retained; new interface copy
  includes translations for all ten non-French languages. No group listening or
  publisher-authorization changes are included. Existing playback-speed changes
  and upstream signing tooling are preserved.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/0b52bb4d2d3174f0bf39a2b4b0158ef51fe97868

releases.name: Ketvoice 4.0.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 4.0.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Album page: full-bleed artwork, Canvas or cover

- The square artwork card is gone. The album visual now runs **edge to edge**: no
  side margins, no rounded rectangle, and the **album colour washes the top of
  the page** before fading into the background.
- A new **Apparence → « Canvas sur les pages d'album »** switch shows the album
  Canvas in that full-width area when one exists, and the cover otherwise. It is
  **independent from the player's Canvas setting**, so disabling one keeps the
  other.
- The Canvas is resolved for the album's first track and respects reduced motion
  and high-performance mode (falls back to the cover). The title, artist, year,
  track count, duration and the Écouter / Aléatoire buttons stay below the visual.

## Icons and launch animation

- **Themed icon**: every launcher variant (default, glass, dark, classic and
  round) now has an Android 13+ **monochrome layer**, so Ketvoice follows the
  wallpaper palette when the system is set to themed icons.
- **Animated splash**: Android 12+ uses a matching system splash, then the
  in-app mark springs in with the wordmark before fading into the app. Reduced
  motion shows the final frame immediately.
- The icon-variant setting keeps working: the chosen icon is applied at launch
  and the splash always matches the light icon canvas.

## Build and packaging fixes

- **Duplicate imports in `app/build.gradle.kts`** (introduced by the signing
  commit) made `main` fail to configure. They are removed, so the repository
  builds again.
- **CI signing guard**: the v3.19.0 tag published APKs signed with a throwaway
  debug key (`CN=Android Debug`), which Android rejects as a package conflict.
  The workflow now attaches release APKs **only when the stable
  `KETVOICE_KEYSTORE_B64` secret is available**, and it no longer overwrites
  existing assets.

## Discord

- The account panel gains a **Diagnostic Discord** section showing link/presence
  state, the last SDK line, the redirect and the scope, with **Copier le journal**
  and **Relancer la connexion**. That journal is what identifies the remaining
  failure (callback not received, token exchange error, or presence start).
- The PKCE exchange, persisted pending state and callback parsing from 3.17
  remain in place; a live check against Discord's token endpoint still confirms
  the client id, redirect and request shape.

## Validation

- Android JVM and native host tests, including a new regression test that the
  album visual starts at 0 px and reaches the full window width, plus a screenshot.
- Signed Mobile and Quest builds with the stable certificate, lint with zero
  errors, credential scan with zero findings, and public download hashes verified
  after publication.
- **Not validated on a physical phone/Quest**: the Canvas decoding inside the
  hero, the Discord consent with a real account, and the final visual animation
  feel. Host rendering cannot decode video or evaluate blur.

## From the 4.0 proposal list

- **Dynamic cover colour**: kept — the palette is sampled from the artwork and
  drives accents, the album hero wash and the player chrome.
- **Cover → player transition**: kept — the artwork flies between the mini-player
  and the player, with reduced-motion fallback.
- **Morphing mini-player**: kept — the chrome condenses while scrolling and
  returns to the full presentation when you scroll back.
- **Download manager**: per-track progress percentages, the artwork progress
  ring, active downloads in the list and the global progress bar are all live.
- **Adaptive icon + animated splash**: new in this release (above).

Still future work, not part of the requested five: pause/resume/priority queues
for downloads, a fully custom icon pack, unified search tabs and smart playlists.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.19.0 — dynamic accent, recap, CI
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.19.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A feature pass on top of the 3.18.0 design system. Still code-only — CI now
builds the APKs for you (see below), so this tag can produce signed artifacts
automatically.

## Dynamic colour that follows the music

- **Theme now breathes with the now-playing artwork.** A new cover-palette
  extractor samples a downscaled bitmap, quantises it into colour buckets and
  picks the most vivid colours that also stay legible as an accent — then feeds
  them into the whole UI as the accent colour. It is cached per artwork URL so
  switching tracks never stutters, and it is opt-in via the existing **Album
  colours** setting.
- Colours are clamped into a legible band (not too dark, not too bright) so text
  and icons on the accent always read.

## "Ton récap" — listening stats

- New **Ton récap** screen (Wrapped-style): total time listened, number of
  plays, unique artists, the most-replayed track, top artists and top tracks —
  all derived from the listening history already stored on the device.
- **100% offline**: nothing leaves the phone. A shareable one-line recap is
  available for the OS share sheet.
- Stats are recomputed incrementally whenever a track is recorded, so the screen
  opens instantly.

## Accessibility & polish

- The stats cards use the shared design tokens (elevation, contrast-aware text),
  so they respect light/dark and large windows automatically.

## CI: APKs are built automatically

- Added a **GitHub Actions** workflow (`.github/workflows/android.yml`) that, on
  every push and on version tags, compiles the app, runs the unit test suite,
  lints, uploads the APKs as build artifacts, and **attaches them to the GitHub
  Release when a `v*` tag is pushed**.
- This means the 3.18.0 gap ("no APK in the release") is now filled by CI: tag a
  version and the workflow produces the mobile + quest release APKs and attaches
  them.

## Validation

Changes are additive (new screen, new palette object, CI file, version bump). The
Gradle build and on-device checks are delegated to the new CI workflow; they were
not run in the environment where this commit was authored (no JDK / Android SDK).

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.18.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.18.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

A design-system pass that consolidates the premium look into shared, reusable
primitives. No behaviour changes to playback, sources, Discord or publications.

## Shadows & reflections

- **One elevation ladder** now drives every glass shadow, so surfaces read at
  consistent depths: content card 1 dp → round button 4 dp → floating pill and
  navigation 8 dp → bottom sheet 16 dp. Dark mode deepens the shadow alpha
  (×1.35) so frosted panels still detach from a near-black page.
- **Static glass gets a real drop shadow.** When Liquid Glass is disabled or a
  panel is captured, it used to render with no outer shadow and read as a flat
  painted rectangle. It now casts a diffuse, theme-aware lift.
- **Shader reflections improved (Android 13+ / AGSL).** A new diagonal specular
  band sweeps the light from the top-left toward the centre — the glass now
  reads as a tilted slab instead of a flat vertical sheen — and a faint bounce
  halo at the bottom-right mimics light passing *through* the block. The
  existing Fresnel rim, lens-edge refraction with chromatic dispersion,
  thickness shadow and caustic are unchanged.

## Coherent animations

- All durations, curves, springs and elevations now live in a single
  `Motion` object. A named scale (`FAST` 150 · `NORMAL` 250 · `MEDIUM` 350 ·
  `SLOW` 500 · `EPILOGUE` 700 ms), four easing curves, three named springs and
  a six-step elevation ladder replace scattered magic numbers.
- The historical API (`FADE`, `PRESS`, `duration()`, `pressSpring()`,
  `reduced`) is preserved, so every existing call site keeps working unchanged.
- Reduce-motion (system setting or in-app toggle) still collapses everything to
  instant.

## Automatic contrast

- New contrast helpers choose ink and tint from the real backdrop luminance, so
  labels drawn over album art stay readable in light and dark themes. Includes a
  WCAG contrast-ratio check (4.5:1 threshold), a blend helper that preserves
  alpha, and an `adaptSurface` that nudges the glass tone away from the backdrop
  so material and content never dissolve into each other.

## Screen adaptation

- Material3-style window tiers (Compact / Medium / Expanded / Wide) on top of the
  existing rail logic. Tracks now flow into **three columns** on large windows,
  long text columns cap at 720 dp, page gutters scale 16 → 32 dp, and short
  landscape windows get a smaller bottom pad so the chrome no longer crowds the
  content.

## Dark & light

- Elevation alpha is split per theme, ink adapts automatically over artwork, and
  the static glass base stays role-aware (sheets denser than pills).

## Validation

This version was committed as a design-system change **without an APK**. Compilation
was not run where it was authored (no JDK / Android SDK in that environment). The
changes are additive with defaults and were reviewed statically, but a Gradle build
and on-device check remain required before any store/publication step.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.17.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.17.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

- The new collection header (liked songs, recently played, all tracks) now **scrolls with the list** instead of staying pinned above it, exactly like the playlist and album pages. The title bar keeps only the back action, so small screens recover the space.
- Everything else is unchanged from 3.17.0: edge-free artist hero with real refresh and share, playlist/album share links, playlist-style collections and downloads, persisted Discord PKCE state with a direct token exchange, progressive playback fallback and two-track prefetch.

Validation: the full suite (299 debug / 254 release tests per variant), lint with zero errors, credential scan with zero findings, signed Mobile and Quest APKs, and public download hashes verified after publication. The Discord token endpoint was exercised live with an invalid code (`HTTP 400 invalid_grant`), which validates the client id, redirect and request shape without logging in an account. Real consent with your Discord account and physical-device playback remain untested here.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.17.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.17.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Artist page

- The hero artwork now uses an **intelligent full-bleed scale**: it always covers the whole header (slight overscan plus side feathers), so the visible vertical "end of image" lines are gone. Portrait and wide banners are handled by the same crop instead of a fitted portrait with flat bands.
- The refresh button now performs a **real reload**: it drops the cached artist page and the cached portrait/background/signature for that artist, then fetches the current server version. A new **share** button sits next to it and produces a real link (the artist's YouTube Music channel when the id is known, otherwise its artist search page).

## Playlists and collections

- **Playlists** have a share action that produces a stable Ketvoice link with the playlist name and track count. **Albums** now share their own YouTube Music page when it exists, and playlists/collections use the Ketvoice landing page.
- **Liked songs, recently played, all tracks and downloads** now use the same presentation as a playlist/album: blurred ambience, large artwork or a 2×2 mosaic, title, count and duration, then the same **Écouter / Aléatoire** actions plus **Partager** and **Actualiser**. Downloads keep their progress bar, per-track actions and "prepare an offline capsule" entry.

## Discord — root cause fixed

- The OAuth callback was only handled in memory. If Android recreated Ketvoice while the browser/WebView was in front, the pending state and PKCE verifier were lost, so the redirect returned to an app that silently ignored it: "authorized, back in the app, still not connected".
- The pending authorization is now **persisted** (state + verifier, five-minute validity, erased on handling) and recovered in the callback.
- Ketvoice now performs the **authorization-code exchange itself** with PKCE on a worker thread (no client secret), saves the encrypted refresh token, feeds the access token to the SDK and marks the account linked even if the presence client cannot start; the SDK exchange remains the fallback. Callback parsing accepts the HTTPS bridge, the `discord-<id>` scheme and `ketvoice://discord`, with a strict state check.

## Progressive playback

- The quality switch already restarts at the same position when the media session refuses the internal command; the next two queue items are still prefetched after playback starts, and failed sources are tried in order without a pre-request that could burn a one-shot URL.

## Validation

- Automated (299 debug / 254 release tests per variant): PKCE S256 against the RFC 7636 vector, authorization URL contents, public-client exchange form, token/error parsing, all accepted and forged callback forms, share-link builders, artist-cache invalidation, and the collection hero rendering (screenshot + actions).
- Live Discord check: a deliberately invalid code sent to `https://discord.com/api/oauth2/token` with the app's client id and redirect returned **HTTP 400 `invalid_grant` — Invalid "code"**, which proves the endpoint, client id, redirect and request shape are correct without logging in an account.
- **Not validated**: the real Discord consent with your account, and playback/downloads on a physical phone. No emulator was used.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.16.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.16.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Playback and downloads fixed

- **Root cause removed**: 3.15/3.16 sent an extra HTTP request to verify each stream *before* handing it to the player. Some CDN URLs are single-use or rate-limited per token, so that pre-request consumed the stream and left ExoPlayer buffering forever; downloads then reported "Aucun flux lisible". No pre-request is made any more: the provider URL goes straight to playback, and the downloader validates the bytes it actually writes.
- **Every enabled source is tried in cascade for downloads**, best quality first, instead of a single candidate. If the best URL fails, the next one is attempted before reporting an error.
- **The previous custom-source path is kept as a last resort** for both playback and downloads, so a manifest that worked before cannot be blocked by the new resolver.
- **No endless spinner**: playback resolution has a 25-second budget and always clears the spinner. Failures now say what happened ("Flux lent · réessayez", "Lecture impossible", "Aucune source activée · ouvrez Sources").
- If every source is disabled in the new Sources switches, the app says so instead of loading forever.
- Custom sources are initialised with the player, so their order and switches are available from the first track.
- Verification is now advisory only and cannot reject a stream for a CDN 403/429, an empty probe read or an unknown container. Only 401/404/410/451 (expired/gone) or an HTML/JSON error body counts as "unavailable".

## Validation

- 288 debug / 244 release JVM tests per variant, including a new decision-table test proving that 403/429/500/empty answers keep the stream while 410/404 and HTML/JSON pages reject it.
- Live diagnostic on the real API: `/stream?source=um` resolves and its URL returns MP3 bytes; YouTube adaptive resolves as AAC.
- **Not validated here**: playback and downloads on your phone/Quest. This build specifically restores the direct provider path, so if a source worked before 3.15 it should work again; the new logs/labels tell us which stage fails if not.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.16.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.16.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Playlist

- The cover, title and controls scroll with the track list again, exactly like the album page. The header no longer stays pinned on screen, and it no longer reserves a faded empty block: scrolling shows tracks immediately under the top bar, and returning to the top restores the same artwork.

## Discord

- The unusable native "connect through the installed Discord app" path is gone. **Se connecter avec Discord** now always opens Ketvoice's own WebView OAuth window, which is the only account path offered. The panel states that no Discord password is requested or stored.

## Artist cache

- Artist pages (portrait, background, bio, listener count, tracks, albums, related artists) are cached on disk for 24 h, plus an access-ordered in-memory LRU; a cached artist renders immediately while a refresh happens in the background.
- Signatures, HD photos and backgrounds are persisted too, with HTTPS re-validation when read back. Failed lookups are cached for 5 minutes instead of being retried on every open, and broker timeouts drop from 10/18 s to 6/10 s.

## Downloads

- **Qualité de téléchargement** now has three honest modes: **FLAC · sans perte** (waits for lossless, then falls back), **Haute qualité** (keeps the best *actually available* compressed stream — AAC/Opus usually beat the 128 kb/s MP3 instead of silently downloading it), and **Rapide** (first readable source).
- Selection is based on the detected audio bytes and declared bitrate, not on which provider answered first. A completed source list is not made to wait for the full timeout, and quality modes query all sources in parallel even when progressive playback is disabled.

## Streaming

- Progressive playback now has a fallback: if the media session refuses the quality-switch command, the same track restarts at the current position on the better URL instead of silently staying on MP3.
- Playback starts on the first verified audio byte (no 30-second wait), ExoPlayer keeps filling its buffer, and the **next two queue tracks** are resolved and written into the audio cache in the background. This prefetch runs on unmetered networks, and on metered networks only when progressive quality is enabled.
- Playback and download each have their **own order and their own enable/disable switches** in Sources. The screen has a Lecture / Téléchargement selector; the list order is the priority order for that mode.

## Validation

- 285 debug / 241 release JVM and native-host tests per variant: playlist scrolls away without a blank area and restores identical pixels, separate playback/download orders, quality-aware download pick, cache round-trips for artist pages and artwork, HTTPS refusal on restored artwork, plus the existing glow and resolver suites.
- **Not validated here**: physical phone or Quest playback, the visible blur of the sustained lyric halo, real network downloads, WebView Discord consent end-to-end. Host rendering cannot evaluate `RenderEffect` blur, so that part remains device-only.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/2221ae3823c3ac40c8ebe77d4c3e786cf40d8445

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.15.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.15.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Lyrics — Apple Music sustained glow

- The sustained halo now starts after **820 ms** of continuously sung audio (was 870 ms). It is driven by the playback clock, so a 2 s word stays dark at 819 ms and lights only when the note is really held; 500 ms rap syllables stay completely clean.
- The glow is a **real blurred copy of the word's glyphs at two diffusion scales** (4–9 dp and 12–25 dp), drawn behind the letters. Because the blur acts on glyph alpha, light spreads outside the letters instead of a hard outline, `TextShadow` or a static blur.
- Fade in is ~300 ms, the hold keeps a subtle 2.6 s breathing cycle, and the exit fades over ~375 ms; the halo stays lit for the whole real word duration, then disappears. The sung fill also stops scaling (1.025×) so letters no longer drift.
- Only words declared at least 820 ms compose a glow node at all: unsung lines cost nothing, and the existing reduced-motion and high-performance switches skip the effect.

## Streaming and downloads

- Streaming and downloads now share **one persisted source priority** that includes the built-in sources: Ketvoice API MP3, Ketvoice API lossless, YouTube adaptive audio, then each custom manifest. Drag the handle in **Sources**; the order is stored on the device and applies to both playback and downloads.
- **Progressive off** (default): sources are tried strictly in that order and the first one that returns real audio bytes is used — no waiting for a better provider. **Progressive on**: sources are queried in parallel (4 at a time), the first validated stream starts immediately, and a better-ranked stream is prepared and swapped in without stopping playback.
- A resolved URL is no longer trusted blindly: a bounded HTTPS probe (with redirect and range checks) reads the first audio bytes and detects the real container (FLAC, MP3, AAC, Opus, WAV) before playback or download. A JSON error page or an expired provider is skipped instead of being handed to the player.
- Reads are now cancellable: when a source wins, the losing requests close their sockets instead of running to completion. The Ketvoice API and YouTube JSON calls, custom manifests and stream endpoints all use this path.
- Downloads start transferring as soon as the first verified source wins; the remaining sources are not awaited first. A second download request for the same track joins the running job instead of being rejected.

## Validation

- **277 debug and 233 release JVM tests** per variant cover the 820 ms envelope, 300/375 ms ramps, whole-word hold, breathing, diffusion growth, ordered-mode first-source stop, progressive-mode early start, failing/hanging sources, cancellation and source-order reconciliation, plus the glow node appearing only for held words.
- Live read-only checks: Ketvoice API search returned 40 tracks for "Lose Yourself Eminem"; `/stream?source=um` returned a **206 `audio/mpeg`** URL whose first 4 KB are real MP3 audio. `/stream?source=last` (lossless) still fails upstream — the ordered resolver skips it and continues.
- **Not validated**: physical phone or Quest playback, audible halo on hardware, download over a real network policy, and Discord. The host renderer used for screenshots does not implement `RenderEffect` blur, so the halo's blur intensity is a device-only result; the host test asserts that limitation instead of faking it.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/cda8c8fffb89605f9edec4d9db9574db9bc965de

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.14.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Playlist correction

- Remove the leftover scroll-driven opacity from the fixed playlist header. The artwork, title and controls now remain visible rather than fading into an empty reserved area.
- Use a compact, side-by-side header in short windows, leaving room for the track list on landscape Mobile and Quest.
- Correct track-reordering indices after the header was moved out of the list, keep the dragged row's index current, and serialize pending moves.

## Ketvoice Studio

- Add an overview with anonymous active-listening counts, provider inventory and the owner's published album count. These are not identified user accounts or fabricated health checks.
- Search actual tracks, albums and artists from the same YouTube Music catalogue used by Android, plus Ketvoice API tracks and publications. Open album/artist tracks with native catalogue identifiers. Provider outages are reported without inventing results; catalogue presence does not guarantee stream availability.
- Inspect all 30 registered service integrations by category. Ten public JSON adapters support enable/disable and compatible HTTPS base overrides; two streaming brokers have app-side activation switches. Authentication, private-key brokers, SDKs and update trust anchors remain protected and explain why code deployment is required.
- New app builds fetch the validated configuration at startup and every five minutes, retaining the last valid cached rules if offline. Public adapter changes apply to fresh requests, not already cached media. No user credentials are forwarded to replacement endpoints.
- Keep owner-only import metadata/audio/cover/Canvas editing and album Canvas management. General-catalog media cannot be replaced; authorized lyric versions can still be published. Artist names on owned publications can be changed in the track editor; general artist profiles are consultable, not remotely overwritten.
- Preserve edited API drafts when filtering, detect conflicting saves from another computer, persist refreshed remembered-session tokens, and explain local token storage accurately. Improve narrow-screen navigation and keyboard focus visibility.
- Correct the managed-manifest description: Studio stores their management order, but the current broker does not automatically consume them. Add a manifest on each device to use it immediately; integrated public adapters use the separate, connected configuration panel.

## Validation scope

- Android JVM and native host-render tests include fixed-header coordinates/pixels after scrolling, short landscape layout and a real drag gesture. They are software-host checks, not physical phone or Quest validation.
- Deno tests exercise normalization, protected endpoints, verified-owner checks, invalid configuration and concurrent-save conflicts.
- Browser checks exercise the dashboard with intercepted, mocked authentication/API responses, including saving/filtering settings, catalogue-to-lyrics actions, session refresh, logout and desktop/mobile layout. They do not constitute a real owner session.
- Direct live catalogue requests verify real upstream search and album browsing. Signed Mobile and Quest builds, lint, credential scanning and downloaded release hashes are checked before publication.
- Physical installation/playback, real owner uploads/settings changes, Discord OAuth/presence and restored upstream lossless access remain unvalidated. The glow threshold remains **870 ms**; group listening is not added.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.13.9

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Artist pages, Apple Music-inspired

- **HD artwork** is resolved by MusicBrainz identity through Fanart.tv:
  `artistthumb` portraits, `artistbackground` and `musicbanner`, validated on the
  server and cached for 12 hours. The app uses the portrait when available and a
  background as ambience, with a 220 ms crossfade and no blank flash.
- The hero fades into the page with a long gradient and keeps the name, the
  signature and the actions readable; square portraits fill the frame instead of
  being cropped to a random band.
- **Authentic signatures** are looked up through Wikidata `P109` (resolved from the
  exact MusicBrainz `wikidata` relation) and rendered from Wikimedia Commons. If
  none exists, a transparent Fanart logo is used. If neither is reliable, the
  premium typographic name is kept — no invented signature.
- New settings: **Photos d'artiste HD** (on by default, public artwork only) and
  **Signatures et logos d'artistes** (still opt-in, because the artist name is sent
  to the broker).
- Verified live: Eminem and Juice WRLD return HD portraits; Juice WRLD returns his
  Wikidata signature. Artists without provider artwork keep the YouTube photo.

## Lyric glow, rebuilt

- Activation is now adaptive at **1.05 s**: rap syllables and ordinary words never
  glow, held notes do. The glow follows the note's real timestamps (pause, seek and
  speed included), never a timer.
- Appearance: diffuse low-alpha white halo plus a subtle inner light, with a
  left-to-right luminous sweep and a light organic drift. No contour, no neon
  outline, no opaque halo.
- Held notes grow smoothly to **1.07×** around their own centre, then settle back.
  Only held notes pay for the extra draws; everything else stays a single fill draw.

## Discord

- The OAuth2 redirect is now the HTTPS bridge page
  `https://ketvoice.netlify.app/discord.html`. Register **that** URL in the Discord
  Developer Portal: it forwards the code to `ketvoice://discord` (and the in-app
  WebView now also completes directly on the HTTPS URL). This removes the custom
  scheme requirement that the portal was missing.
- Presence still opens the Discord app and connects; the SDK log line is shown when
  it fails. Note that launching Discord alone does not create a presence: the
  session must reach Ready, which the OAuth link makes reliable.

## Validation

- Unit tests, release builds, lint and the credential scan run before publication.
  No phone or emulator is available here: the artist crop, the glow feel, the OAuth
  return and the presence are **not hardware-validated**. The artwork broker was
  verified live against Eminem and Juice WRLD.

# Ketvoice 3.13.7

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Lyric glow, Apple-Music style

- There is no permanent halo anymore. The sung text is a plain white fill; only a

  `discord-1566454532890820668:/authorize/callback`. Your Developer Portal had no
  redirect configured, which is exactly why the account-link page could never
  come back to Ketvoice. Presence through the app and the pasted OAuth2 token do
  not need that redirect; the token section remains the fallback.

- Unit tests, release builds and lint run for both variants. No phone, Quest or
  accelerated emulator was available: opening Discord, the presence connection,

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.13.6

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord, moved and diagnosable

- The Discord panel now lives in **Settings → Compte** instead of the profile
  overlay, next to YouTube Music.
- Presence through the installed Discord app is still the default. A connection
  attempt that never reaches Ready now times out with an explicit message instead
  of leaving the panel spinning, and the last SDK log line is shown under the
  error so a silent failure becomes readable.
- An optional **OAuth2 token** connection was added (advanced section). It only
  accepts a bearer token issued for the Ketvoice Discord application; regular
  Discord user tokens are rejected by the SDK. A rejected token is discarded
  instead of being restored on every launch. The older OAuth2 account-link flow
  remains available in that same advanced section.

## Lyrics

- The glow is back to the older soft halo, but only on the active lead line at
  low intensity. Only notes held for at least 850 ms get the real bloom and a
  thicker contour; ordinary words, syllables and other lines stay clean.
- Word highlights are now aligned against the rendered line before being drawn.
  Foreign-language providers that segment CJK text differently, add spaces or
  ship mismatched word tokens no longer light the wrong glyphs; if the mapping is
  impossible the whole line is highlighted as one segment.

## Artist pages

- The hero uses a blurred copy of the photo as ambience, so wide banners no
  longer sit between two flat bands, and portraits fill the frame without an
  arbitrary face crop.
- Artist avatars in search and related artists get a hairline ring and an initial
  fallback instead of an empty grey disc.

## Artist logos

- The broker now paces MusicBrainz to one request per second instead of failing
  the whole lookup with a 429, raises the minute budget and recovers faster after
  an upstream rate limit. Back-to-back logo lookups work again.

## Ketvoice Studio

- The edit form has a **Canvas de l'album (MP4)** field. One upload can be applied
  to every title of the album; the app downloads and plays that video instead of
  resolving a Canvas from the provider. A new `canvas_path` column and the
  deployed `ketvoice-content` function implement it, and the album picker shows
  whether an album already has a Canvas.

## Validation

- Unit tests, release builds and lint run for both variants. No phone, Quest or
  accelerated emulator was available: the Discord connection, the new glow, the
  hero framing and the album Canvas playback are **not hardware-validated**.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.13.5

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Lyrics

- The glow is back to a word-level effect: only sustained notes bloom, reinforced
  by a thin contour on the sung glyphs. Ordinary lyric lines no longer carry a
  permanent halo.
- Backing vocals now derive their window from the parent line when the provider
  gives no word timings, so a back stays visible for its real duration instead of
  flashing for a few hundred milliseconds. The row still appears only 200 ms before
  the back and collapses after it, and a long back can finish after the next line.
- The translated line is revealed with an eased sweep and a per-glyph opacity ramp
  at the boundary, removing the visible step-by-step jumps.

## Fullscreen Canvas

- The title, artist and duration/scrub row are **always visible** in fullscreen.
- Tapping the artwork returns to the normal player; the scrub bar keeps its own
  gestures and never triggers the exit.

## Higher-quality audio

- When the requested quality is Lossless or High, Ketvoice now prefers YouTube's
  best adaptive audio over the broker's 128 kb/s MP3, and labels the real codec and
  bitrate. Downloads try YouTube after lossless and before the broker MP3.
- The third-party lossless provider is still expired, so true FLAC is not restored.
  The app no longer presents 128 kb/s as high quality without saying so.

## Discord

- The presence mode is unchanged: it uses the installed Discord app and now offers
  an **Open the Discord app** shortcut so the prerequisite is explicit. Account
  linking remains optional. This path is still **not device-validated** here and
  the exact failure message matters for the next step.

## Validation

- Unit tests, release builds and lint run for both variants. No phone, Quest or
  accelerated emulator was available, so the lyric timing, fullscreen gestures and
  audio quality are not hardware-validated.

# Ketvoice 3.13.4

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord: presence without the OAuth loop

- The primary action is now **Enable Discord presence**: Ketvoice connects to the

- An unfinished line keeps filling while the next line begins, and a long back is
  allowed to finish after the following line has started. Nothing is cut off when
  paragraphs overlap.
- The karaoke glow was reworked: a permanent soft halo on the active line, a wider
  bloom on sustained words and a softer glow on the line that is finishing.

## Equalizer

- The equalizer dialog now draws a smooth glowing response curve of the five band
  gains, with the device's real bands and the reset action added in 3.13.2.

## Validation

- Unit tests, release builds and lint run for both variants.
- **Not device-validated**: presence through the local Discord app, the lyric
  overlap and the new glow need an owner check on a physical phone. The third-party
  lossless provider remains expired; MP3 fallback from 3.13.3 is unchanged.

# Ketvoice 3.13.3

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord: authorization inside Ketvoice

- The Discord consent page now opens in a WebView owned by Ketvoice. When it
  redirects to `discord-1566454532890820668:/authorize/callback`, the app
  intercepts the URL **before Android has to resolve it** and exchanges the code.
  This is the step browsers and the Discord app silently drop, which is why the
  panel never connected.
- No new redirect has to be registered in the Discord portal: the existing mobile
  redirect is used.
- Returning to Ketvoice without a code still cancels after 8 seconds, and the
  three-minute absolute timeout remains.
- A static `discord.html` bridge (`ketvoice://discord?...`) is deployed on the
  website as an additional path if a browser flow is ever needed.

## High quality that degrades honestly

- Lossless streams are probed before playback. A 4xx response (expired provider)
  hides lossless for 15 minutes instead of starting a dead stream, and the player
  uses the working MP3 immediately instead of waiting.
- Lossless is no longer allowed to delay playback: the first second and a half is
  reserved for it, then the fast MP3 starts and a later upgrade can still replace
  it when a real lossless stream arrives.
- Downloads retry the fast MP3 explicitly after the resolved candidates fail,
  before the YouTube fallback, and keep the actual downloaded format in their
  metadata.
- Settings explains that playback and downloads fall back to the fastest MP3 when
  the lossless source is unavailable.

## Validation

- Unit tests, release builds and lint run for both variants.
- **Not device-validated**: the WebView consent, the token exchange and the audited
  lossless fallback must be confirmed on the owner's phone. The third-party
  lossless provider itself is still expired; this release cannot renew it.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/6c028aaebc7326a40215c29cbf63a760262dcb8e

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.13.2

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord linking

- Returning to Ketvoice without an authorization code now cancels the pending
  link after **8 seconds** instead of leaving "Connecting to Discord…" forever.
- Authorization opens the **Discord app first**, which reuses the signed-in
  session and delivers the redirect as an intent (custom-scheme navigation inside
  a browser or the Discord web view can hang). The browser remains the fallback
  when the Discord app is unavailable.
- The 3-minute absolute timeout, local `state` validation and the explicit
  `invalid_client` hint remain.

## Equalizer

- The equalizer is back in the track's three-dot menu, next to Reverb.
- The dialog now lists the device's real native bands and their centre
  frequencies, and adds a **Reset** action that returns every band to 0 dB.
- Presets and per-band sliders keep driving the real audio session through the
  native effect.

## Reverb

- Rebuilt as a proper Freeverb-style room: eight damped parallel combs and four
  all-pass diffusers per channel, stereo spread, an 18 ms pre-delay and a DC
  blocker.
- Three controls in the track menu: **Intensity**, **Room size** and **Damping**,
  with a **Reset** preset (35 % / 50 % / 35 %). Settings persist across restarts.
- The wet path is smoother and longer without the sub-bass rumble of the previous
  single-feedback design.

## Validation

- Host unit tests cover the reverb tail/stereo isolation and the payload rules;
  the equalizer and reverb UI are compiled and linted.
- **Not device-validated**: no phone, Quest or accelerated emulator is available
  here, so the Discord return tick, the authorization hand-off and the audible
  reverb/equalizer changes must be confirmed on the owner's phone.

# Ketvoice 3.13.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord linking fixed

- The authorization redirect is now received by Ketvoice's own exported activity.
  The SDK helper could return without calling back when the Discord app handed the
  user back to Ketvoice, which left the panel stuck on "Connecting to Discord…".
- Ketvoice runs the OAuth2 + PKCE flow in a browser tab and passes the returned
  code to the SDK for the token exchange. `state` is generated and checked locally;
  the code challenge uses S256 and only the verifier stays in memory.
- A three-minute timeout now clears the busy state instead of spinning forever,
  with explicit messages for a canceled authorization, an invalid response, a
  timeout and `invalid_client` (which points at the portal's **Client public**
  setting).
- Presence still appears only after linking, while a track is actually playing,
  and is cleared on pause, stop, unlink or opt-out. No password, user token or
  self-bot is involved.

## Language default

- Ketvoice now starts in the user's system language when it is one of the eleven
  supported languages, and in English otherwise. French is no longer forced for
  new installs.
- Picking a language in Settings is remembered as an explicit choice; clearing the
  app data returns to the system language.

## Validation

- Unit tests cover the PKCE challenge against the RFC 7636 example, verifier and
  state generation, the authorization URL and the presence payload rules.
- The 3.13.0 Discord runtime is unchanged apart from the redirect receiver.
- **Still not device-validated here**: no phone, Quest or accelerated emulator is
  available in this environment. The browser redirect, token exchange and presence
  must be confirmed on the owner's phone with a second Discord account.
