# Ketvoice 3.13.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Discord account linking

- Link a real Discord account from the account panel using the official Discord
  Social SDK and the registered Ketvoice application
  (`1566454532890820668`). The OAuth2 redirect
  `discord-1566454532890820668:/authorize/callback` returns the authorization
  code straight to Ketvoice.
- Authorization uses PKCE with an SDK-generated state value. Ketvoice never asks
  for a Discord password, never stores a user token and never approximates a
  "linked" badge.
- The seven-day access token is renewed from the non-expiring refresh token, which
  is kept encrypted by an Android Keystore AES-GCM key and can be deleted at any
  time with **Unlink my Discord account**.

## Live listening presence

- Once linked and enabled, Discord shows the track title, the artist, the cover
  when it is a public HTTPS image, and an elapsed-time counter aligned with the
  current playback position.
- Two buttons: **Download ketvoice** → `https://ketvoice.netlify.app/` and
  **Listen now** → the track's public listen page. Expiring media URLs and local
  file paths are never published.
- Presence is opt-in, appears only while a track is actually playing, and is
  cleared on pause, stop, unlink or opt-out.

## Packaging and limits

- The Discord Social SDK is owner-supplied and is **not** redistributed through
  Git. Builds without `app/libs/discord/discord_partner_sdk.aar` still compile and
  simply hide the Discord panel; the published APK includes the arm64 runtime.
- The SDK adds about 9 MB of native libraries to the phone APK. Voice chat,
  microphone permissions and the SDK's foreground service are not included.
- **Not validated on hardware.** No phone, Quest or accelerated emulator was
  available here, so the real OAuth redirect, the Discord-side presence and both
  buttons were not observed. Discord also does not display your own buttons to
  you, so confirmation needs a second account.
- Canvas, reverb and the rest of 3.12.1 are unchanged.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.12.1
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.12.1

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Canvas framing

- Restore the banner-era normal Canvas framing. The clip now fills the whole
  artwork region edge to edge instead of being letterboxed, so the wide side
  bands reported after 3.12.0 are gone.
- Keep the blurred cover ambience behind the player, the shared dissolve between
  tracks and the same artwork-region geometry. Fullscreen remains reserved for
  verified portrait 9:16 clips and Quest stays a landscape 2D window.
- Remove the extra blurred cover drawn inside the artwork square: it duplicated
  the scene ambience and made the video look inset.

## Reverb

- Route audio through decoded PCM even when the device advertises encoded
  passthrough or offload. Those paths bypass every Media3 audio processor, which
  is why Reverb could be enabled without being heard on some phones.
- Deepen the room: longer damped tail, stronger wet mix and a DC blocker so the
  feedback network does not build sub-bass rumble that eats headroom.
- Apply Reverb changes through a MediaSession custom command in addition to the
  in-process setting, and show whether the audio stream is actually being
  processed while the slider is open.
- Keep multichannel passthrough intact: the reverb only accepts mono and stereo,
  so surround formats are not silently refused.

## Liquid glass

- Give the navigation bar and the player's two-tab pill a dedicated optical glass
  material: lower frosting, stronger edge refraction and a thinner tint, so the
  sampled page reads through instead of a matte slab.
- Sample the player footer from its own backdrop layer, so the navigation pill
  refracts the scene instead of the footer that contains it.

## Discord

- The Ketvoice Discord application is registered (Application ID
  `1566454532890820668`). The redirect to declare in OAuth2 is
  `discord-1566454532890820668:/authorize/callback`.
- Account linking and live listening presence are still **not shipped**. The
  official Android Social SDK is distributed only through the signed-in Discord
  developer portal, so its activation, terms and AAR/header download cannot be
  completed from this repository. No linked state, fake presence or non-functional
  button is included.

## Validation limits

- Unit tests, release assembly, lint and synthetic audio fixtures are not
  physical listening, hardware video decoding, GPU performance, real Discord
  linking or signed owner-session tests. No phone, Quest or accelerated emulator
  was available in this environment; the reported checks are the ones that ran.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/e30f565dc4aef4859f21ef64d0ab6c077621f333

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.12.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.12.0

![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

## Player and Canvas

- Restore the legacy normal Canvas scene: full artwork-region sizing, FIT video
  and the shared bottom dissolve, without the smaller rounded inset video.
- Restrict fullscreen eligibility to verified portrait 9:16 clips. Square,
  landscape and other portrait formats cannot enter it; Quest stays landscape 2D.
- Give three-dot action sheets real sampled liquid glass, with separate backdrop
  layers to avoid self-sampling. Keep readable opaque fallback sheets when glass
  is unavailable or disabled in performance/accessibility settings.
- Add a real adjustable Reverb effect to the track menu. Damped stereo room
  processing runs in Media3's PCM audio path, with smoothed control changes and
  an off-by-default setting that survives restart.

## Sources and downloads

- Add optional Progressive quality under Playback. Start with the first resolved
  stream and prepare a higher-quality decoder independently in the background.
  Switch only after readiness, duration compatibility and position alignment;
  timeouts, errors, seeks and track changes retain/cancel the candidate safely.
  This is a same-track quality upgrade, not an automatic mix between songs.
- Correct custom download endpoints that return JSON metadata rather than audio,
  retain distinct download URLs and preserve alternative source candidates.
- Accept valid initial HTTP 206 responses starting at byte zero while continuing
  to reject wrong ranges, partial files and non-audio downloads.
- Show live circular download progress on Home recent, carousel and featured
  artwork, and on artist/playlist track rows.

## Profiles and artwork

- Add opt-in Fanart.tv artist logos with automatic MusicBrainz resolution,
  original colors/transparency, attribution and normal-name fallback. The provider
  credential is stored only on the server, never in the app or APK.
- Refine playlist artwork sizing, background glow, collapsed titles, contrast,
  duration, shuffle access and current-track highlighting. Keep unresolved tracks
  and editing/reordering available. Add album explicit-content identification.
- Preserve French defaults, all eleven interface languages, reduced motion,
  karaoke, owner-only publication permissions and automatic release/update banners.

## Known external blockers and validation limits

- Live checks found the configured lossless provider returning HTTP 410 with an
  expired-access indication. Its broker currently answers 404 for those streams.
  This release cannot renew third-party access; it does not claim restored FLAC
  availability. Two sampled MP3 streams returned valid HTTP 206 audio data.
- Discord linking/presence is **not included**: the official Android SDK supports
  it, but a registered Ketvoice Discord application with Social SDK access and
  callback configuration is still required. No linked account or live presence is
  simulated. The requested download/listen buttons remain pending that setup.
- Host tests and synthetic audio fixtures are not physical listening, hardware
  video-decoder, GPU-performance, signed owner-session or real APK-upgrade tests.
  The supplied validation metadata distinguishes executed checks from pending ones.
- Android's installation confirmation remains required for app updates.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/80d0cd8330722b0c7c7dae65602da7999bdc3841

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.11.0
releases.body:
![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.11.0 — smoother playback and artist portraits

**versionCode 56** — signed Mobile and Quest packages with the existing update certificate.

## Readable menus and a calmer dark theme

Dark player action sheets now keep their own dark surface when opened above a
light page. Titles and actions no longer disappear as white text on a white
panel. Rounded sheets respect system-bar space. The dark palette uses charcoal
surfaces, clearer elevation and brighter secondary text, with explicit Material
surface and outline colors. Normal Canvas clips remain fully fitted, now with
rounded video edges rather than a hard rectangular cutoff. Their original
frames are not cropped or faded to hide the problem.

## Continuous player transitions

Canvas fullscreen entry/exit crossfades, and its controls fade and slide rather
than disappearing abruptly. Tap the image to hide or reveal the controls; Close
or Android Back exits fullscreen. Controls hide after inactivity during playback
and remain available when paused. Seeking does not dismiss the Canvas.

Lyrics transport controls stay mounted through their exit animation, return
smoothly, and share a moving viewport boundary with the expanded lyrics. Sheet
entry and track-menu dismissal also transition smoothly. Reduced-motion settings
remain respected and do not disable karaoke synchronization.

## Portrait-led artist profiles and optional signatures

Artist profiles feature a larger portrait, a long fade into the page and a
centered identity area, without replacing Ketvoice navigation. Wide catalogue
banners remain fitted rather than arbitrarily zoomed. Long names stay readable.
Settings → Appearance adds an opt-in artist-signature switch, disabled by default
including for upgrades from the old unused setting. Artist names are sent to the
signature service only while this option is enabled. Known public-domain assets
retain source attribution; missing, rejected or unavailable images fall back to
the normal name. SVG decoding and raster ink/white-paper handling are supported.

## Native 120 Hz request on supported phones

Settings → Appearance adds a separate 120 Hz option. It selects a native mode
reported by the current display at the same resolution, including fractional
120 Hz panel clocks. It does not pretend that 60/90 Hz hardware supports 120 Hz.
The window preference is restored when disabled, paused, disposed or in battery
saver. The current display refresh rate and request status are shown separately.
Android may cap the rate; this is not a guarantee of 120 rendered frames per
second and can use more battery. Quest retains its platform-managed refresh rate.

## Timed backing vocals and automatic updates

Timed backing vocals are fully hidden before their own native timing window,
fade out when it ends or the next lead line starts, and keep measured space to
avoid scroll jumps. Line-only lyrics use their parent line's active interval;
untimed text does not invent word timings. AutoMix remains absent from playback,
settings and interface; only upgrade cleanup of retired data remains.

The automatic update popup remains enabled with release notes and a trusted
repository banner when the release includes one. There is no required manual
check on a functioning updater. Android still requires installation permission
and confirmation; silent APK installation is not supported. Older builds with
the previously broken updater may still need a one-time GitHub install.

## Validation and limitations

Validation metadata records JVM and host Android/Skia checks, UI clock/state
fixtures, live signature metadata checks, lint, APK identity/signature/alignment,
credential scans and public download checksums. Signature image availability is
external; the asset host returned HTTP 429 during a live check, so that is not
reported as a successful in-app live image download. Local SVG/raster fixtures
verify renderer behavior, not an owner session.

No physical phone, physical Quest or emulator validation is claimed. Real GPU
transitions, sustained 120 Hz/FPS, battery consumption, actual install-permission
return, APK upgrade installation and signed-app live downloads remain untested.
The website is synchronized from the pushed checkout and real public release
feed; local browser checks are distinguished from production-host deployment.
Concurrent local `MainActivity.kt` work is excluded. No group listening is added.

Source commit: https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/d474a136d378390fbbb3ef6552d18cc0ba29f104

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.10.1
releases.body:
![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.10.1 — reliable in-app update checks

**versionCode 55** — signed Mobile and Quest packages with the existing update certificate.

## Automatic checks restored

Update checks now run when the app returns to the foreground and every fifteen
minutes while it remains active. An available release is persisted, so closing
and reopening the app during the check interval no longer loses the update.
Failed requests do not suppress retries. A freshly installed app version always
checks again. Stable builds select the newest installable stable release and
keep Mobile and Quest packages separate.

## Manual checks and installer retry

Settings → About now includes Check for updates, with visible checking,
up-to-date and failure feedback. Manual checks can reopen a skipped version.
The update badge no longer cancels its own asynchronous request.

After granting Android's install-apps permission, the verified APK is reused to
continue installation. Launching or cancelling the system installer no longer
leaves the button permanently at 100%. The dialog keeps a retry action and a
GitHub fallback. Android still requires the owner's installation confirmation;
this is not silent installation and does not bypass platform permissions.

## Verified update packages

Downloads follow HTTPS-only GitHub asset redirects, require the exact release
size, and check GitHub's SHA-256 digest when supplied. Partial or rejected
downloads are never handed to the installer. The APK must have the installed
package name and signing certificate, a higher versionCode, the advertised
versionName and a supported Android minimum version. Cached APKs are checked
again before installation. Six new interface messages are translated into all
ten non-French dictionaries; French remains the default.

## Install

Install the Mobile APK on a phone/tablet or the Quest APK in the landscape 2D
window. If an older build's updater cannot discover this fix, download this
version once from GitHub; subsequent checks use the corrected updater.
Checksums and validation metadata accompany both signed APKs.

## Validation and limitations

The release metadata records JVM, host Android/Skia, mocked transfer/installer
checks, lint, signature, alignment and credential-scan results. Public release
downloads are compared with local SHA-256 hashes. Host tests cover selection,
cache/relaunch, clock changes, retry, digest/size rejection, partial-file cleanup
and reusable installer UI; they are not actual package-manager installations.

No phone, emulator or physical Quest is used. Real install-permission return,
upgrade installation, owner-session and in-app live download validation remain
not performed. The website's English notes/download feed is synchronized;
production-host deployment is distinguished from local browser verification.
AutoMix remains removed; no backend, Apple or group-listening work is added.
Parallel local `MainActivity.kt` work remains outside this release.

Sources : https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/1ea43a8b436deb7697c7e02be59d9fde37a24a97

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.10.0
releases.body:
![Ketvoice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/main/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.10.0 — Canvas framing fix and simpler playback

**versionCode 54** — signed Mobile and Quest packages, using the existing update certificate.

## Normal Canvas framing fixed

The regular player no longer applies the artwork fade mask or dark lower
overlay to Canvas video. Clips have their own unobscured viewport between the
header and track information, stay centered with their full proportions, and
do not run underneath the title. Static artwork keeps its existing dissolve.
The compatible-clip fullscreen mode remains available.

## AutoMix completely removed

The dual-deck engine, beat analysis, transition commands, background preparation,
overlay and settings have been removed. Playback uses one audio player again.
Upgrades remove the retired settings and analysis cache without deleting songs,
artwork or playlists. Equalizer, Sonic Canvas, shuffle, repeat, seeking,
skip-silence, downloads and single-device Wi-Fi handoff remain.

## Website and release presentation synchronized

The website removes the retired feature from its current descriptions, shows
the canonical Ketvoice banner, and refreshes stable release notes and Mobile /
Quest downloads from GitHub. New changelogs and release notes are in English.
Historical releases and their assets remain unchanged.

## Install

Download the Mobile APK for Android phones/tablets or the Quest APK for the
landscape 2D Quest window. Both update existing installations without clearing
the library. Checksums and validation metadata accompany the APKs.

## Validation and limitations

Exact JVM, host Android/Skia, lint, APK signature, alignment and credential-scan
results are recorded in `validation.json`. Public release downloads are
compared with local SHA-256 values. The Canvas regression uses a synthetic
frame to verify that bottom pixels stay visible; it does not validate a real
video decoder or hardware GPU. Website checks distinguish local browser tests
from any live deployment verification.

No phone, emulator or physical Quest is used. Final APK installation/launch,
real Canvas playback, owner-session and in-app live downloads are not claimed.
No backend authorization, Apple sources or group listening is changed. The
parallel local `MainActivity.kt` work is preserved outside this release.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.9.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.9.0 — Canvas moins zoomés et finitions du lecteur

- Verre des contrôles : liseré défini en dp, reflet opposé, ombre d'épaisseur
  et caustique de bord. Les grandes surfaces restent mates ; les replis Android
  12/12L et les options d'effets réduits sont conservés.
- Haut des pages artiste et album : photo complète, fondu plus progressif,
  hiérarchie des noms et métadonnées, boutons Lecture / Aléatoire en pilule.
  L'album affiche aussi la durée totale connue, traduite.
- Canvas contenu dans le lecteur, sans recadrage forcé ; les marges montrent
  une extension floutée de la pochette, désactivable avec les effets réduits.
  La profondeur de pochette ne grossit plus les vidéos.
- Appui sur un Canvas compatible : clip sur toute la fenêtre, seulement titre,
  artiste et barre de temps, avec une sortie par appui, croix ou Retour.
  Les proportions sont lues localement hors du thread UI ; le mode n'est pas
  proposé si plus de 15 % de l'image serait coupée, si les métadonnées sont
  inconnues, si le Canvas est exclu/désactivé, ou après une erreur de décodage.
  La barre de temps ne déclenche pas le geste de sortie. La fenêtre Quest
  reste 2D et paysage ; les clips verticaux ne sont pas grossis pour la remplir.
- Apparition des paroles en cascade courte et fondu ease-out plus long ;
  transitions de couleur et de flou adoucies, sans changer la taille ou la
  graisse des lignes. Suppression de deux défilements initiaux concurrents.
  Backs séparés, karaoké et mouvements réduits conservés.
- Libellés Canvas, musique locale, états des paroles, bibliothèque et durée d'album complétés dans les dix
  dictionnaires traduits ; français par défaut, onze langues au total.

## Validation et limites

Les résultats exacts des tests JVM, tests hôtes Android/Skia, lint, signature,
alignement, scan de credentials et SHA-256 sont joints dans `validation.json`.
Les téléchargements publics de la release sont comparés aux fichiers locaux.

Les aperçus et interactions hôtes sont **des simulations sur PC**, sans AVD,
téléphone ou Quest physique. Le test du chrome Canvas utilise une image
statique : il ne valide pas le décodeur vidéo. Le rendu GPU réel, la fluidité
sur appareil, la lecture d'un vrai Canvas, l'installation/lancement final,
la session propriétaire et le téléchargement dans l'app restent non testés.
Les tests instrumentés sont compilés, pas exécutés sur appareil.

Aucun changement de backend, d'autorisation de publication, d'écoute de groupe
ou de sources Apple. La modification parallèle locale de `MainActivity.kt`
reste hors de cette livraison.

Sources : https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/commit/b366ca7d03eb0ab2dea43ea507366ca6e924ebfa

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.8.0
releases.body:
# 💎 Ketvoice v3.8.0 #  ![Ketvoice 3.7.1](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.6.1/ketvoice-banner.png)

**More refined glass. Smarter settings. A cleaner experience.**

Ketvoice 3.8.0 introduces a more realistic Liquid Glass system, a redesigned Settings experience, and major interface refinements across Android and Quest.

### ✨ NEXT-GENERATION LIQUID GLASS

- **PrismalAGSL Integration:** Adapted MIT-licensed optical techniques for realistic lens profiles, background refraction, and directional reflections.
- **Real Background Refraction:** Glass controls interact with the actual content underneath them.
- **Smarter Glass Placement:** Premium glass effects are now focused on navigation and interactive controls, while large content panels retain a clean matte finish.
- **Optimized Animations:** Improved responsiveness with support for reduced-motion preferences.
- **Better Compatibility:** Full AGSL effects require Android 13 (API 33)+, with graceful fallbacks for Android 12/12L and lightweight modes.

### ⚙️ COMPLETELY REDESIGNED SETTINGS

- **New Settings Home:** Organized categories for faster, more intuitive navigation.
- **Dedicated Settings Pages:** Cleaner layouts with better spacing and readability.
- **Improved Switches:** Entire setting rows are now interactive and accessible.
- **Advanced Customization:** Visual refinement options now have their own dedicated page.
- **All Features Preserved:** AutoMix, music sources, local music, publishing, and existing settings remain functional.

### 🔎 SEARCH & NAVIGATION REFINEMENTS

- Redesigned compact search bar with single-line text and placeholder.
- Better search layout across phones, tablets, and large screens.
- Preserved clear button and keyboard search actions.
- Fixed wrapping issues in search categories and navigation labels.
- Improved compact navigation to prevent overlapping controls on smaller screens.

### 🌍 ACCESSIBILITY & PLATFORM SUPPORT

- All 11 languages remain supported, with French as the default.
- Newly introduced Settings categories are translated.
- Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
- Quest retains its 2D landscape experience.

### 🛠️ VALIDATION & TRANSPARENCY

- Build verification, JVM tests, Android/Skia host tests, lint, APK signing, alignment, credential scanning, and SHA-256 results are documented in `validation.json`.
- Release downloads are checked against local artifacts.
- ⚠️ PC previews and host-based tests do not replace physical-device or real GPU performance testing.
- Final APK installation, launch, end-to-end testing, in-app downloads, authenticated sessions, and physical Quest testing have not been verified.
- Instrumented tests were compiled but not executed on a device.

---

**🎧 Less clutter. More immersion. Pure Ketvoice.**

🌐 **[[Website](https://ketvoice.netlify.app/)](https://ketvoice.netlify.app/)**

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.7.0
releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.7.0

**versionCode 50** — installs over 3.6.3 and every earlier build (same signing certificate).

## Liquid Glass, rebuilt

The AGSL shader was reworked edge to edge: the lens refraction now rises on a smooth smoothstep profile (no visible step where the lens starts), dispersion is softer, a permanent hairline contour keeps every panel defined on light and dark backgrounds, and a sub-pixel dither kills gradient banding on large panels. Presets are rebalanced — less milky tint, deeper blur — so the glass reads as optical material instead of white plastic.

The **glass-off mode was rebuilt too**: instead of a flat opaque paint, disabled panels now get a premium frosted surface — translucent body tinted by what is behind, diagonal light gradient, hairline rim catching the top-left light, dark hairline on the opposite edge and a specular veil on the upper third.

## Bigger bottom bar, and the whole chrome collapses together

The tab capsule is now 60 dp tall (52 dp collapsed) with larger icons and labels, and the mini-player pill grew to match. When you scroll down, the change is no longer limited to the tabs: the mini player condenses (artwork + transport, no text) and joins the navigation row, with Home and Search interposed beside it — one slim floating row. Scroll back up and everything returns to the full layout.

## The player closes progressively

Closing the full player is no longer instant: drag the artwork, the title bar or the handle and the whole screen follows your finger, fading and growing a top sheet corner as it goes. Release low (or flick) and it slides out; release high and it springs back. Back button and handle tap animate out the same way. On tablets and Quest, the previous behavior is unchanged.

## Held-word highlight in karaoke lyrics

On word-by-word and syllable lines, when the song lingers on a word (long word, end of phrase, or an instrumental hold), that word now grows by 9 % with a soft white glow, easing in after it is sung and easing out when the next word starts. Reduced-motion keeps it off.

## Lyrics tracking is smooth again

Every visible lyric line used to recompose on each position tick (200 ms) because the ad-lib window read the position stream, and each arriving translation invalidated the whole list. Position is now only read by the active line, and translations land in a per-line granular map — the scroll and the translated reveal follow the song without the stutter.

## Artist page — the photo is back, and it never leaves

3.6.3 replaced the artist photo with an animated canvas; the photo is restored as the permanent hero: displayed whole (fit, never cropped) over a blurred extension of itself, with the extended progressive blur band under the status bar — the same material as the player. No fade on scroll, no swap: the photo stays at its place, with the name, listeners, Listen and Queue actions on top of it. Artist pages that expose no immersive header no longer fail entirely (responsive-header fallback), and related-artist avatars fall back to a person icon instead of an empty circle.

## Album page — redesigned

The cover is now the page: large, centered (216 dp), with a canvas video when one exists for the album's first track, over a full-bleed blurred backdrop. Title, artist, release year and track count are centered beneath it, above two actions — **Listen** and **Share**.

## Share links that open the app

The share button in the player (lyrics header and ⋯ menu) and on the album page builds a real link now: `listen.html` is served from the project's GitHub Pages. A friend with Ketvoice installed is switched automatically to the app via an `intent://` URL and playback of the shared track starts; without the app, the page shows the track and a Download button pointing to the releases page. The app registers `ketvoice://listen` and the matching https path, resolves shared tracks (known locally → imported publications → search by title/artist, with a YouTube videoId fallback) and opens shared albums directly.

## Native volume control

The volume slider in the player and the audio-output sheet now drives the real system media volume (`AudioManager` STREAM_MUSIC) instead of an in-app multiplier: same steps as the hardware buttons, same value as the system, and hardware volume changes move the slider live. The icon follows the level (muted / low / high).

## Settings no longer crash on open

Opening Settings could crash the app when the audio-cache snapshot threw inside composition (a corrupted or locked cache left `SimpleCache` unusable). Cache init, size queries and trimming are now failure-proof: a broken cache degrades to "no cache" instead of killing the screen.

## Fully translated

The new interface strings (share, shared-playback confirmation, album actions) were added to the bundled catalogs — 827 strings per language across the 11 interface languages, French first.

## Install

1. Download `Ketvoice-3.7.0.apk` (phones/tablets) or `Ketvoice-3.7.0-Quest.apk` (Quest).
2. Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
3. Install over any previous Ketvoice build; the signing certificate is unchanged.

releases.body:
# Ketvoice 3.6.3

**versionCode 49** — installs over 3.6.2 and every earlier build (same signing certificate).

## Artist page — the hero now owns the whole top of the screen

The banner followed the aspect ratio of the artist photo and topped out around 320–560 dp, leaving dead space at the sides. It now takes 58% of the screen height (clamped between 400 and 720 dp) and runs edge to edge, so the animated canvas truly fills the top of the page.

## Artist page — title, artist name and actions live inside the cover

The name and monthly listeners sat under the banner, and playback was only reachable from a separate button above the track list. The cover now carries the artist name, the "Artist · YouTube Music" label, the listener count, plus two actions directly on top of it: **Listen** (plays the artist's tracks) and **Queue** (opens the player queue). Both labels already exist in `translations.json`, so all supported languages are covered.

## Artist page — songs were missing

On many artists the popular-tracks list stayed empty, because the parser only kept YouTube Music rows typed `ATV`/`OMV` while the popular section usually exposes another type. That filter no longer applies, so every track of the page is returned.

## Artist page — animated canvas instead of the blurred cover

The top of the page used to be a full-bleed blurred copy of the artist photo. It is now filled by `SonicCanvas`, the same animated canvas used by the player, layered under a soft vertical gradient that keeps the artist name readable. It fades out over the first 520 px of scrolling, so it introduces the page instead of remaining permanent.

## Playlist page — the header scrolls away

The playlist cover, title, description and "Listen" button used to be siblings placed above the track list, so they stayed pinned forever. They are now the first item of the list itself and fade out as they scroll off, while the floating back button stays reachable at all times.

## Install

1. Download `Ketvoice-3.6.3.apk` (phones/tablets) or `Ketvoice-3.6.3-Quest.apk` (Quest).
2. Verify the download against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
3. Install over any previous Ketvoice build; the signing certificate is unchanged.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.6.1
releases.body:
![Ketvoice 3.6.1](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.6.1/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.6.1

**versionCode 47** — installs over 3.6.0 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## Real AGSL Liquid Glass

- **The glass is now a shader.** Every dynamic glass panel (navigation dock, mini-player, search lens, action sheets) runs through a single AGSL RuntimeShader that computes the material per pixel on the GPU: rounded-rect SDF lens refraction at the edges, chromatic dispersion (red bends less than blue), saturation and brightness of the transmitted background, light-side rim, shadowed opposite edge and a top sheen. No more stacked white brushes — the previous lens()/surface-brush pipeline remains only as a pre-Android-13 fallback.
- The Compose-drawn border and lib highlight are dropped when the shader runs, so there is exactly one edge, drawn by the shader itself.

## Artist page photo

- **No more over-zoomed photos.** The photo is shown in its entirety (fit) over a blurred extension of itself — same treatment as the player's cover.
- **Progressive blur bands, top and bottom, limited and smooth.** A dedicated AGSL shader blends the sharp photo with a pre-computed blur using smoothstep masks of bounded extent (120 dp top / 210 dp bottom): the blur fades continuously, there is no visible seam, the middle of the photo stays perfectly sharp, and the same bands darken gently for the status bar and the artist name. The sharp photo also fades softly into the blur at its own left/right edges.

## Real listening-time counter

- **"Votre expérience d'écoute" now counts real listening time.** The old card estimated minutes as plays × track duration (so skipping a track still "counted" its full length, in whole-minute jumps). The player now accumulates the actual played position deltas (≈5 values/second while playing, seeks and skips excluded), persists them continuously and flushes on service shutdown. The card shows minutes below an hour and switches to "X h MM · temps d'écoute" beyond.

## Known limits

- Checked by build and unit tests (145 passing, including a new listening-delta test). The AGSL shaders require Android 13+ and were validated by compilation and code review only — no device screenshot was possible in this environment; the pre-13 fallback path is unchanged.

releases.name: Ketvoice 3.6.0
releases.body:
![Ketvoice 3.6.0](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.6.0/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.6.0

**versionCode 46** — installs over 3.5.3 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## Liquid Glass

- **Real optical glass, not white plastic.** The floating chrome (mini-player, tabs, search lens) samples what is actually behind it: the milk tint is near-invisible, saturation is richer, and the lens refraction bends the background at the edges like the reference video.
- **Bottom sheets are real glass too.** The playlist action sheet used to fall back to a static opaque panel; it now renders at the root of the app, above everything, and refracts the live content behind it.
- **Nothing covers an open sheet anymore.** Opening the playlist menu hides the mini-player and the bottom bar, so every option ("Exporter (.m3u)" included) stays reachable.
- **Slimmer capsules.** The mini-player pill (50 dp) and the tab bar (53 dp) are tighter, with reduced margins, matching the reference proportions.

## Player

- **Per-track Canvas exclusion.** The ••• menu of the player can exclude a track from video Canvas ("Exclure ce morceau du Canvas"). Excluded tracks show the static cover only; the same menu re-enables Canvas. Exclusions survive restarts. The entry is only visible when video Canvas is enabled in settings.

## Lyrics

- **Backs and ad-libs.** Text in parentheses on synced word/syllable lyrics expands in with the same animation as translations and disappears the moment the next line starts.
- **Intro dots.** The three dots sit on the left edge of the screen with slightly tightened spacing. The word-by-word fill keeps its smooth-step glide.

## Local music

- **Choose your folder.** Settings gains a "Musique locale" section: pick a folder (SAF, persistent permission) or keep scanning the whole device via MediaStore. MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, M4A, OGG, OPUS, WMA, AIFF and ALAC are handled.
- **Embedded metadata first.** Tags and embedded cover art are read from the files; a missing "Artist" is deduced from "Artist - Title" file names, and an online match is only applied when the title matches exactly — original metadata is never replaced by a guess.
- **Local tracks in playlists, fixed.** Local files kept their playlist entry broken (the stream URI was stripped on save), so they would not play from a playlist. They now play normally.

## Playlists

- **Premium "Add to playlist" sheet.** A glass bottom sheet lists your playlists with their real artwork, an availability count and a create button, replacing the old plain dialog.
- **Real covers, no more generic art.** Playlists show their true covers; imported Spotify playlists get the classic 2×2 mosaic with a small official Spotify badge. The "KETVOICE M" placeholder is gone.

## Album & artist pages

- **Immersive album header.** Blur derived from the album artwork, gradients that dissolve into the page, the title next to the cover with artist and release year, and a well-placed Play button.
- **Duplicate cover bug fixed.** The persistent 4-image grid that repeated the same album cover is gone (the mosaic remains only as a fallback when no real cover exists).
- **Artist page.** Back and refresh now float over the hero photo, which starts under the status bar.

## Website — Listening Now

- **It actually works now.** The counter endpoint was wired to the live backend; the card now also shows the most-listened track right now: title, artist and cover with a live pulse.
- **Refresh every 10 s without reloading**, pauses when the tab is hidden, never overlaps requests, backs off after repeated failures, and handles the no-music and offline cases.

## Known limits

- Checked by build and unit tests (144 passing) plus a live smoke test of the deployed backend (count + now-playing payload verified). Not yet checked on a physical device or Quest: the slimmer chrome metrics and the SAF folder scan deserve a quick pass on hardware.

# Ketvoice 3.5.2

**versionCode 44** — installs over 3.5.1 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## Lyrics

- **Plain intro dots.** The three-dot intro is now three solid white dots. No halo, no ripple, no drift, no bounce. Each dot simply goes from dim to fully opaque as the intro runs out.
- **Blurred cover behind the lyrics.** The lyrics page no longer uses a flat colour. It shows the same blurred album cover as the player.
- **Translation keeps following.** The translated line used to track the song for one line and then stop. Its clock now restarts every time a line becomes the active one.

## Known limits

- Checked by build and unit tests (144 passing). Not yet checked on a device: the blurred background may need a darker overlay on very bright covers, and the translation fix comes from reading the code, not from reproducing the bug.

![Ketvoice 3.5.1](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.5.1/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.5.1

**versionCode 43** — installs over 3.5.0 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## Lyrics

- **Reworked three-dot intro.** Each dot pops in with a springy bounce and a single ripple when it lights up, lit dots get a soft halo, and the group drifts gently. Drift, ripple and halo are turned off with "reduce motion".
- **All three dots now light before the first line.** They light progressively during the wait (one at 25%, two at 50%, all three at 75% of the intro). Before, the third dot could never light up while the intro was still visible.

## Liquid Glass

- **More defined edges.** A thin dark edge now sits under the light rim of glass surfaces, for separation and depth.
- **Brighter highlights.** The specular highlight and inner sheen are stronger.
- **Lighter dark-mode glass.** The dark tint is a dark grey-blue instead of pure black.
- These changes follow public descriptions of the iOS 27 look (defined edges, lighter dark glass, brighter highlights). It is an approximation built with Jetpack Compose, not Apple's renderer.

## Known limits

- The glass and intro-dot changes were checked by build and unit tests (144 passing), not on a device yet.
- Update download and install were not re-tested end to end for this release.

releases.body:
![Ketvoice 3.5.0](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.5.0/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.5.0

**versionCode 42** — installs over 3.4.3 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## Lyrics

- **One clean layer per line.** The duplicated, fully blurred copy of the active line that appeared above the lyrics is gone. Only the sharp text remains, and neighbouring lines still fade out progressively.
- **Uniform lines.** Every lyric line now uses the same size and weight, so the text no longer jumps when the active line changes. Only the colour marks the active line.
- **Ghost lines fixed.** French credit lines such as "Paroles : …", "Compositeur : …" or "Mixé par …" are no longer shown as lyrics, and lines returned twice by a source (same timestamp and same text) are shown once.

## Artist page

- **Better framing.** The header photo follows the real aspect ratio of the artwork (height kept between 320 and 460 dp) and is anchored to the top, so faces are no longer cropped out of portrait pictures.
- **Smoother photos.** Artist photos fade in once loaded.
- **Similar artists.** Circles without a photo show the artist's initial instead of an empty disc.

## Interface

- **Liquid press feedback on the player controls.** A fast, firm spring when pressed and a small bounce when released, instead of a linear scale. With "reduce motion" enabled the change is instant.
- **Official Spotify icon** (green `#1DB954` disc with the three black arcs) in the Spotify import.

## In-app updates

- **A stable release replaces its own beta.** Before, `3.5.0` was treated as equal to `3.5.0-BETA`, so beta testers were never offered the final version. The comparison now ranks a stable build above its pre-release.
- **Pre-release aware check.** The check looks at the 10 latest releases (stable and beta) and offers the first one that is newer than the installed build and was not skipped or dismissed.
- **Home badge.** Choosing "Later" keeps a green update badge next to the profile avatar; tapping it reopens the update popup.
- **Right APK only.** The updater only offers the APK that matches your build (phone or Quest). If a release has no matching APK, no update is offered instead of a wrong one.
- Seven unit tests now cover the version comparison.

## Known limits

- Lyrics and artist-page changes were checked by build, unit tests and analysis of screenshots, not on every device and screen size.
- The update download and install flow itself was not re-tested end to end on a device for this release.

![Ketvoice 3.4.2](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v3.4.2/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 3.4.2

**versionCode 39** — installs over 3.4.1 and every earlier build (signing certificate unchanged).

## In-app update — now fully working

- **Automatic update check** on app launch (throttled to at most every 6 hours, always instant when opening the update screen manually).
- **Update banner front and centre**: when a new version is found, the release banner image is shown at the top of the update dialog, with the full English changelog below.
- **Robust download** with network timeouts and automatic retry, saved to the app's private storage.
- **Reliable install flow**: the installer session is tracked with a status receiver — if Android asks for user confirmation the correct dialog is launched; if "install unknown apps" permission is missing you get a clear error plus a direct shortcut to the system settings page.
- **Skip this version**: don't want an update? Skip it — Ketvoice stops auto-prompting for that version (you can still install it manually anytime).

# Ketvoice 3.4.0

**versionCode 37** — s'installe par-dessus la 3.3.1 et toutes les versions précédentes (certificat de signature inchangé).

## Mise à jour intégrée

L'application vérifie désormais elle-même la dernière release GitHub au lancement.

- **Pop-up, pas un écran plein** : une fenêtre compacte qui laisse le lecteur visible derrière.
- **Bannière de release** en tête, puis le nom de la version et sa date.
- **Changelog défilable** dans un cadre à hauteur limitée — les notes longues ne poussent plus les boutons hors de l'écran.
- **Deux boutons** : `Plus tard` et `Télécharger`.
- `Télécharger` récupère l'APK, affiche la progression réelle, puis ouvre l'installeur Android. Aucun passage par le navigateur.
- Un seul rappel par version : `Plus tard` mémorise le tag refusé, la pop-up ne réapparaît pas pour cette release.
- Vérification limitée à une fois toutes les 6 heures, pour ne pas marteler l'API.
- L'APK téléchargé est supprimé du cache avant chaque nouvelle tentative, et sa taille est contrôlée : un fichier tronqué est refusé plutôt qu'installé.

Nouvelle permission : `REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES`. Android demandera une fois d'autoriser Ketvoice à installer des applications ; l'app ouvre directement le bon écran de réglages si l'autorisation manque.

## Paroles traduites

- La traduction utilise maintenant **la typographie des paroles** — même graisse (Black), même interlettrage serré. La taille reste 16 sp : la hiérarchie entre ligne chantée et traduction est préservée.
- **Révélation synchronisée** : le texte traduit se dévoile au rythme de la ligne, proportionnellement à son avancement temporel. Une traduction ne peut pas s'aligner syllabe par syllabe sur l'original — les langues ne découpent pas les mots aux mêmes endroits — donc la progression est répartie sur la durée réelle de la ligne plutôt que plaquée sur un découpage faux.
- Les lignes inactives gardent une traduction atténuée et immédiatement lisible.

## Traductions de l'interface

- **120 nouvelles entrées** ajoutées aux 10 langues (en, hi, ja, zh, ru, it, es, de, pt, ko), soit **821 clés par langue**.

# Ketvoice 3.3.1

**versionCode 36** — installs over v3.3.0 and every previous release (same signing certificate).

## Liquid Glass v2

The glass material was rebuilt from scratch (`Glass.kt`, ~173 lines reworked). Five parameters that were previously declared but never read are now actually consumed by the shader path — `bevel`, `falloff`, `dispersion`, `tint` and `grain` — so every glass surface in the app reacts to them instead of silently ignoring them.

- **Light model**: added a directional `HighlightStyle`, plus separate `Shadow` and `InnerShadow` layers, so glass edges now catch light from a defined direction instead of a flat uniform sheen.
- **Tint**: switched to a three-stop gradient rather than a single flat colour, giving a much closer match to the reference material.
- **Shapes**: `pill`, `circle` and `sheet` are now genuinely distinct surfaces, each with its own edge treatment, instead of sharing one rounded-rectangle approximation.

## Lyrics

- Top and bottom **fade mask** on the lyrics list, so lines dissolve as they leave the viewport rather than being hard-clipped.
- **Halo on the active line**, making the current line readable at a glance while the rest stays recessive.

## Artist page

Three separate bugs fixed in `ArtistScreen.kt`:

- Silent return when a `UC` id was passed in — the screen exited instead of rendering.
- The player overlay was masking the artist overlay, so the page appeared not to open.
- Name-to-id fallback now uses exact matching, so clicking an artist without a known id resolves correctly.

## Player

- Tapping the artist name in the player opens the artist page **even when the track carries no `artistId`**.
- AutoMix restored — it had been broken by a merge artifact.
- Removed three Android haptic-feedback calls that fired on unrelated interactions.

## Backend / Studio (carried over from `main`)

- Studio album inheritance and automatic audio duration detection.
- `ketvoice-content` edge function updated alongside the Studio deployment.
- New QA tooling: `qa_studio_albums.mjs`, `test-studio-albums.mjs`, `check-studio-page-live.mjs`.
- Admin panel and validation schema updated.

**versionCode 33** — installs over both the 3.0.x line (v3.0.5–v3.0.7) and the 3.0.0-Beta line. Same signing certificate as every previous release; no uninstall needed.

This release reunifies the two parallel lines: the playlist/navigation/Replay work from 3.0.0-Beta4 and the later 3.0.x maintenance are combined in a single Android codebase. The iOS port directory and its build workflow are removed from the repository.

## 🎵 Playlists, redesigned

# Ketvoice 3.0.6 — AutoMix (BETA)

**Mobile/tablet and Quest · versionCode 31**

- Enable AutoMix in Settings → Playback. It remains disabled by default. When
  enabled, a dedicated AutoMix tab offers automatic or custom maximum crossfade
  (1–30 seconds) and Low, Medium, Standard or High analysis performance.
- The player pre-resolves the next stream and prepares a second ExoPlayer before
  the end of the current song. Two independent audio streams overlap with a
  gain-limited crossfade, without pausing the outgoing deck. Pausing, seeking,
  changing tracks or disabling AutoMix cancels the transition. Manually skipping
  to an already prepared next song uses a short fade where possible.
- Bounded local/remote PCM samples are analyzed off the UI thread to estimate
  tempo, energy and mid-band vocal risk. If tempo estimates are confident and
  compatible, beat phases can align without changing playback speed. Analyses
  are cached on disk; when analysis fails, a plain equal-power fade is used.
- The full-screen player shows an unobtrusive AutoMix indicator, overlapping
  covers and transition progress; reduced-motion mode avoids decorative motion.
  Mobile, tablet and Quest retain their existing player layouts.
- The owner Studio sign-in redirect from 3.0.5 is also included. Links requested
  by the Android app still target the Android app.

This beta uses spectral heuristics, not vocal stem separation or time-stretching.
Some songs with unavailable duration, expiring streams, unsupported codecs or
late network responses use ordinary next-track playback. Unit tests and
packaging checks are not physical audio validation. On-device playback,
headphone focus changes and Quest output require owner verification.

# Ketvoice 3.0.0-Beta3 — rebuilt APKs

**App version: 3.0.0-Beta3 · versionCode 25 · release tag: v3.0.0-Beta3-rebuild.1**

## Why a rebuild?

The originally published mobile Beta3 APK downloads with the advertised SHA-256
(`e5e8db6981d84fd1f8323d4af388946cbc72e66b1368af4c6d68a6e30eb125bc`) and
passes ZIP CRC checks, but **does not pass Android signature verification**:
`apksigner verify` reports `Missing META-INF/MANIFEST.MF`. An intact ZIP is not
necessarily an installable APK. This rebuild fixes the packaging, not merely
the download link. The original release/tag/assets remain untouched.

## Changes retained and fixes

- Rebuilt from the recent Beta3 sources, including the artist banner, local
  music page, glass back buttons, tablet swipe-to-close, image-cache purge and
  drag feedback on the seek bar. This is not a recompile of 2.12.0.
- `assembleMobileRelease` / `assembleQuestRelease` now sign their outputs using
  the existing external Android Debug development keystore, or an explicitly
  configured external signing identity. No key or password is added to Git.
- The release gate rejects unsigned, truncated, misaligned, debuggable,
  wrong-version and wrong-certificate APKs. It checks ZIP CRC, `apksigner`,
  16 KB ZIP alignment, manifest version/SDKs and SHA-256, then verifies uploaded
  bytes by downloading them before publication.
- Captured main-screen content cannot sample its own backdrop anymore. Sibling
  chrome still uses Liquid Glass. This hardens Beta3's existing back-button fix
  against further RenderThread render-recursion crashes.
- Artist/catalog optional artwork errors do not crash/hide a usable page;
  cancellation is rethrown instead of swallowed, and catalog loading failures
  reach the existing retry state.
- Local music now asks for audio permission on Android 13+ and legacy storage
  permission on Android 12/12L. A denied permission is explained, not reported as
  an empty library. Returning from app settings rescans with current permission.
- Local file read failures have a retry state, the final rows clear the floating
  navigation, and the local/catalog covers are actual 2×2 mosaics rather than four
  vertical strips. New permission messages are bundled in all 11 UI languages.

## Installation

- **Phones/tablets:** `Ketvoice-3.0.0-Beta3-rebuild.1.apk` (Android 12+, target 36).
- **Quest:** `Ketvoice-3.0.0-Beta3-rebuild.1-Quest.apk` (minimum SDK 32, target 34).
- Keep your installed app/data: install the new APK as an update. The package
  name and existing development certificate are preserved, and versionCode is
  increased from 24 to 25. Do not uninstall merely to work around a failed
  download. Copies signed by a different key cannot be updated with this key.
- This remains a development-signed **prerelease**, not a Play/Meta Store build.

## Validation and limits

- 117 JVM tests and 19 Android Compose tests pass **per flavor**, with no
  failures/errors/skips. The new rendered tests exercise capture isolation,
  repeated artist/settings/catalog/local screens and denied audio permission.
- Eight Python release-gate tests pass (SDK commands mocked in those unit tests).
- Release lint: 0 errors, 142 warnings and 8 hints per flavor; warnings are not
  advertised as fixed bugs.
- Both actual release APKs pass ZIP CRC, signature/certificate, manifest and
  16 KB ZIP-alignment checks. Both install as updates and launch on an Android 15
  emulator with no app crash in the inspected crash log. The mobile release's
  audio permission request/accept/rescan flow was also exercised.
- Credential scan: 1,175 source/archive entries, 0 findings (pattern scan; no
  claim of a new audit of server secrets).

See the accompanying `validation.json` and `SHA256SUMS.txt` for exact results,
certificate, source commit and file hashes. Tests cover the existing playlist,
player, translation and Quest checks, hardware-rendered glass captures, repeated
overlay rendering and missing local-audio permission. Release APK installation
and launch checks are separate from debug instrumentation tests.

No claim is made that every possible bug is eliminated. No owner-session upload,
full live Spotify/provider playback/download, Android 12 physical device or
physical Quest 3/3S test is claimed. The attached phone is not used for testing.
No backend schema/auth change or Ketogether feature is included.

# Ketvoice 2.12.0 — playlists, Spotify import & selected design finishes

**Mobile/tablet and Quest — versionCode 21**

## Playlists on your device

Library → **Playlists** now offers **Créer une playlist** and **Importer depuis Spotify** side by side.

- Create, rename and delete a playlist. Deletion removes only the playlist; songs and downloads stay.
- Add a song from its menu → **Ajouter à une playlist**. A new playlist created from that sheet already contains the song.
- Reorder with **Monter** / **Descendre**, remove a title, then play the whole list or a single row.
- Playlists are stored locally in an atomic JSON file (bounded to 100 lists and 500 entries each). Nothing is uploaded, and a corrupt file is reported instead of being silently replaced.
- Stored entries keep the song identity, not expiring stream URLs. If a list was imported from Spotify, titles that were not found remain visible and can be resolved by hand.

## Spotify import

Paste a **public** Spotify playlist link (`open.spotify.com/playlist/…` or `spotify:playlist:…`), load the public preview, then match the visible titles against the Ketvoice catalog.

- Ketvoice reads the same public preview page a browser sees; it does not sign in to Spotify, does not use Spotify cookies and never downloads Spotify audio or its 30-second previews.
- Spotify does not guarantee that this public preview lists every track. Ketvoice displays the number of visible titles, states that the list may be incomplete, and requires an explicit confirmation before creating the playlist.
- Each title is matched on normalized title, main artist, official-catalog verification and duration tolerance. Results show **Disponible** or **Non retrouvé**; unresolved titles are never presented as playable.
- The import cover is an original Ketvoice composition tinted by the playlist colour, optionally using the public artwork URL as a dimmed background. It is not an official Spotify logo.

## Selected design finishes (D1–D8)

Every retained finish has its own switch in **Réglages → Design Ketvoice**, so a single element can be reverted without losing playlists, downloads or settings.

- **D1 Signature Ketvoice** — compact wordmark header, deeper night background, calmer card surfaces.
- **D2 Accueil éditorial** — one featured card (“À l'affiche”) above the shelves; the featured title is not repeated in its shelf.
- **D3 Cartes de collections** — collection cards show a 2×2 artwork mosaic and a real category icon.
- **D4 Typographie harmonisée** — heavier weights pull back to ExtraBold and unset line heights get a 1.30 reading ratio.
- **D5 Menus unifiés** — dialogs share one readable surface, corner radius and hairline border.
- **D7 Éditeur visuel des imports** — the publisher sees current vs replacement artwork, filename, format, size and duration before submitting.

D6 was not implemented.

- French remains the source language and the default; the same 11 interface languages are offered.

- Brand names (Ketvoice, Spotify, YouTube Music, LRCLIB, LRC, TTML, FLAC, MP3) stay untranslated. User content (titles, artists, lyrics, playlist names) is never translated.
- The chosen language is also applied to native Android surfaces (file picker, permission and system dialogs), not just Compose text.

## Validation

- **117 JVM tests** per flavor (mobile and Quest), zero failures, including playlist rules, Spotify link/preview parsing, unmatched-title handling, and translation parity.

# Ketvoice 2.11.0 — imported media edits, Sonic Canvas & offline capsules

**Mobile/tablet and Quest · versionCode 20**

## Edit imported songs

As the verified publisher, open an imported song's menu → **Modifier l'audio ou la pochette**. Replace its audio, artwork, or both. Other catalog songs cannot be edited. Audio stays limited to 25 MB and artwork to 4 MB; rights confirmation remains mandatory.

The server verifies the confirmed publishing mailbox and record ownership, rejects spoofed fields, and detects concurrent edits. New versioned Storage paths avoid stale CDN content. Track IDs and lyrics are preserved; check lyric synchronization after changing a recording. Old server media is retained rather than automatically deleted.

The online player checks the current imported revision and uses revision-specific stream-cache keys. Existing offline downloads remain unchanged and must be explicitly downloaded again for updated audio.

## Canvas controls

- **Activer les Canvas vidéo** disables video playback and future Canvas video downloads, including explicit song downloads. Saved videos are not deleted.
- **Sonic Canvas** is independent and **off by default**. It uses coarse low/mid/high energy from actual decoded playback PCM to drive artwork-coloured background gradients. No microphone, audio recording or network telemetry is used.
- Pause, backgrounding and reduced motion stop reactive analysis. Unsupported output paths remain static; no fake beat or voice-detection animation is generated. Physical-device timing/performance is not guaranteed.

## Offline capsules

Downloads → **Préparer une capsule hors ligne**. Choose duration and a file budget, optionally include real home selections, inspect the preview and deselect unwanted songs before preparing.

Favorites are prioritized, then known listening/catalog choices. Downloads are sequential and never evict or replace existing files. Audio, available lyric sidecars and small independent artwork files are bounded by the capsule budget, excluding shared playback/image cache. No Canvas videos are fetched for a capsule. Duration/size estimates and unavailable sources can leave a partial selection; only actual saved files are shown ready. Keep Ketvoice open during preparation. Cancellation preserves saved media.

**Ketogether/group listening has not been added.** Its implementation awaits the user's explicit decision. Existing single-device Wi-Fi handoff stays unchanged.

![Ketvoice](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/releases/download/v2.8.0/ketvoice-banner.png)

# Ketvoice 2.8.0 — glass, motion, equalizer & local Wi-Fi handoff

**Mobile/tablet and Quest — versionCode 17 — 23 October 2026**

Download **`Ketvoice-2.8.0.apk`** for Android 12+ phones and tablets, and **`Ketvoice-2.8.0-Quest.apk`** for Quest 3/3S. Both are built from the same source and keep the existing interface: no new dashboard, no oversized Quest toolbar.

## Liquid Glass, refined

- Tighter bevel and refraction on glass panels, a soft gradient rim, and a slightly lighter tint. The result stays readable on artwork and Canvas without turning into an opaque card.
- Buttons, transport controls, sliders, and sheets share the same surface treatment.
- On Quest, hovering a control now highlights it with light that follows the pointer. No hand-tracking permission and no 3D scene are added.

## Motion

- One timing vocabulary: 220 ms fades, 140 ms presses, 380 ms lyric follow. Decorative motion no longer uses unrelated spring and duration values.
- A new **Animations réduites** setting, and Android's system animator scale, remove decoration while keeping lyric timing, seeking, and karaoke accurate.
- The three intro dots now match the requested Apple Music behaviour: **three fixed-size dots that light up one after another**. No halo, no growing circle, no merge and no zoom. The dots keep a reserved slot, so the first lyric does not jump when they disappear.
- Lyrics stay visible during the intro, follow the active line, and stop following while you scroll manually. Seeking re-enables following.
- Karaoke text masks are built once per line layout instead of once per playback frame, and Canvas video pauses when the app is not visible.
- Queue rows keep stable per-occurrence keys, so duplicate songs, insertions, and reordering no longer rebuild the wrong row.

## Player polish

- Wide layouts align title, artist, seek, transport, and volume on the same left edge as the artwork.
- The favorite star animates its colour and gives a short press feedback; touch targets are at least 48 dp while the visible icons keep their previous size.
- **Canvas panoramique** is a new optional setting, **off by default**. When enabled, the Canvas plays as a dimmed, darkened background and the foreground artwork stays static to avoid a second video decoder.

## New: native equalizer

- Five bands (60 Hz, 230 Hz, 910 Hz, 3.6 kHz, 14 kHz) with presets (Flat, Bass, Voice, Bright, Rock) and ±12 dB range in the interface.
- The effect runs on the real ExoPlayer audio session through Android's native `Equalizer`. Gains are mapped to the bands and millibel range the device actually exposes; unsupported ranges are clamped instead of pretending to apply.
- If the device has no equalizer, the screen says so. Settings persist, and the effect is released when the playback service is destroyed or its audio session changes.
- Verified on the emulator: the effect chain appears in `dumpsys media.audio_flinger` for the playback session.

## New: same-Wi-Fi handoff, no QR code and no account

- Enable **Transfert sur le même Wi-Fi** on both devices. Ketvoice advertises itself with mDNS and lists nearby Ketvoice instances on the same private IPv4 subnet.
- Choose the recipient. The receiver must **explicitly accept** the request before anything plays. A device on the same Wi-Fi cannot take over playback silently.
- The current track, playback position, shuffle/repeat/autoplay flags and up to 50 queue entries are sent. Only catalog metadata crosses the network: **no cookies, account tokens, stream URLs, local files, or source configuration**.
- The receiver resolves the catalog itself. Messages are bounded, unknown fields are rejected, nonces are single-use, and the start command works once, after approval.
- The sender pauses only after the receiver confirms it is ready. A refusal, timeout, or failure keeps local playback untouched.
- Works only with both apps in the foreground on the same private network. Guest Wi-Fi or access-point isolation blocks discovery, and the screen says so.

## Also

- Lyrics text size (Standard, Large, Very large) now applies to phones and tablets too, not only Quest.
- The publisher music-upload fix from 2.7.0 is unchanged; no backend change is made in this release.

## Validation

- **87 JVM tests pass per flavor** (87 tests for mobile, the same 87 for Quest), 0 failures. New tests cover the intro-dot state machine, equalizer gain mapping/clamping, queue occurrence keys, LAN message validation, subnet checks, HTTP request rejection, and the approval/start/ready protocol over a real loopback socket.
- Android lint: **0 errors**, 125 warnings, 8 hints for both flavors.
- Signed releases installed and checked on an Android 16 emulator: phone player and its lyrics; Quest landscape split player; equalizer dialog with a live native effect; Wi-Fi dialog with mDNS discovery; a real LAN offer displaying the receiver consent dialog, and refusal returning `rejected` without starting playback.
- Both APKs verified with `apksigner` (same development certificate), `zipalign -c`, and credential scan.

## Verify

```text
SHA-256
ab9d4d0bf350d44e835a7782afdf07151c3a7f72f53b4e5214d70c066e09d142  Ketvoice-2.8.0.apk
1cd2ccb9adce8a787372da4a5e285382753b3baa4346458b10490587d7a961c6  Ketvoice-2.8.0-Quest.apk

Signing certificate SHA-256
ae25a19cee8ac781f30de4c933541257fdd46a6ea7fca6f7ab021f68221f37a9
```

Both APKs are signed with the existing **Android Debug development certificate**, not a production or Meta Store identity. Checksums, validation metadata, and screenshots are attached to the release.

## Limits

- **No physical Quest 3/3S was available.** Horizon OS pointer behaviour, window resizing, audio mixing, thermals, and frame pacing still need headset testing. No Meta Store certification or fixed-FPS guarantee is claimed.
- Quest remains a **2D app window**, landscape-only, not an immersive VR environment.
- The equalizer depends on the device's native audio effect support; some devices expose fewer bands or a narrower gain range.
- The Wi-Fi handoff requires a private IPv4 network without client isolation, both apps open, and tracks available in the online catalog. Transfers of local imports or custom-source tracks are intentionally refused.
- Discovery and receiver consent/refusal were checked on Android; the complete protocol was tested on a JVM loopback socket. **A full playback handoff between two physical devices has not been verified.**
- LAN messages use unencrypted HTTP, not authenticated pairing. Device names are self-reported, not verified identities. Enable this option only on a trusted private Wi-Fi network; other network participants may observe catalog metadata and position. No end-to-end encryption is claimed.
- No real mailbox-owner login or real music upload was performed for this release. External services, email limits, and storage quotas are unchanged.
- Previous releases (2.7.1, 2.7.0, 2.6.1, 2.6.0, 2.5.0) are preserved. Historical 1.2.0–2.3.0 APKs remain withheld.

# Ketvoice 2.7.0 — Mobile-style Quest window and music-upload fix

**versionCode 15 · 22 October 2026**

## Download the right APK

- **Ketvoice-2.7.0.apk** — phone/tablet build, Android 12+.
- **Ketvoice-2.7.0-Quest.apk** — Quest 3/3S Android-window build, Android 12L+.

Both use the existing development signing certificate and package name. They can update the previous app without uninstalling; they do not install side-by-side on the same device.

## Quest: the mobile UI, not a new dashboard

- Reuses the **original mobile player and floating navigation**: same artwork/Canvas treatment, icon controls, transitions, gestures, synchronized lyrics, and Liquid Glass. No oversized Quest toolbar, tablet navigation rail, or forced two-column player.
- A portrait default window and bounded content preserve phone-like proportions even when the panel is resized wide.
- Optional lyric sizing and playback keep-awake live in ordinary Settings. A 15/30/60-minute sleep timer lives in the normal track ⋯ menu; it can be cancelled there.
- Original control sizes are preserved. Subtle pointer hover/focus feedback is added without replacing the visual design.
- Headset manifest declares Quest 3/3S, optional touchscreen/faketouch, a resizable panel, and 64-bit ARM support. This is a **2D window**, not an immersive 3D environment.

See [Quest installation and limitations](https://github.com/Tysnnn23/Ketvoice/blob/main/docs/QUEST.md).

## Music publication fix — already deployed server-side

Logs showed audio and cover uploads succeeding, followed by a `SyntaxError` and rollback. An associated lyrics INSERT returned **HTTP 201 with an empty body** (PostgREST's normal `return=minimal` behavior). The broker incorrectly tried to parse that body as JSON.

The database-response helper now accepts empty successful responses. Regression tests reproduce the old 500 and pass with the fix, including songs with lyrics/cover, songs without lyrics, legacy 204 responses, and rollback on a genuine database failure. **Existing 2.6.1 clients also benefit from this server fix.** Server-side publisher authorization, rights confirmation, size/signature checks, and public content behavior remain unchanged.

## Validation

- **66 JVM tests pass for each build flavor** (the same 66 tests run twice), with no failures/errors.
- Both release APKs build, sign, and pass Android lint with **0 errors**.
- **21 mocked publication API checks** pass, including empty-201 regression and rollback checks. No real media is published by the test harness.
- Signed Quest APK installs over the existing app on an Android 16 emulator. Original mobile UI is visually checked in portrait and wide windows; timer start/persistence/cancellation is exercised.
- Live deployed broker health succeeds; unauthenticated publisher access is rejected. `verify_jwt` remains enabled.
- APK manifests/ABIs, signatures, ZIP integrity, and source/APK credential scans are checked.

## Checksums

## Limitations

- **No physical Quest was available.** This is a headset-targeted build with emulator validation, not a claim of exhaustive hardware compatibility, Meta Store approval, or guaranteed headset FPS.

# Ketvoice 2.6.1

**Android 12+ · versionCode 14 · 22 October 2026**

## Publisher email login fix

- Open a newly requested email login link on the device running Ketvoice. Supabase now redirects to **`ketvoice://auth`**, not localhost, and Ketvoice opens the publisher screen automatically.
- Cold-start and already-running app links are supported. When Android offers Ketvoice for the original Supabase verification URL, the app can also verify that link directly.
- The manual paste fallback is fixed: the `token` in a Supabase email URL is a **token hash**, not a numeric email OTP. Numeric codes remain supported if an email provider supplies one. Pasted links are masked; numeric codes remain readable.
- Callback identity and expiry are not trusted. A callback refresh token is exchanged for a server-validated session, and the publication broker must approve the confirmed publisher mailbox before access is enabled. Authorization on every write is unchanged.
- Strict callback URL/parameter validation rejects foreign hosts, unexpected ports/paths, duplicate parameters, malformed encoding, and oversized links. Callback credentials are not retained in the Activity launch intent or copied into the input field.
- Updated instructions are bundled in all 11 interface languages. French remains the default. Tablet layouts, Liquid Glass, song search, and public song/lyrics behavior are unchanged.

## Use it

1. Install **`Ketvoice-2.6.1.apk`** over the existing app.
2. Request a **new** login link from the publication screen.
3. Open that email's link on the **same device**. Choose Ketvoice if Android asks. The app checks your access automatically.
4. If your email client does not reopen Ketvoice, request a fresh link and paste the original email link into the app without opening it first.

Older emails may still contain a localhost redirect or an already-used token. Do not reuse them. Only the verified **konnektsupport@gmail.com** mailbox can publish; a matching YouTube profile is not authorization.

## Validation

- **61 JVM tests, 0 failures/errors**.
- Release build succeeds; lint: **0 errors**, 122 warnings, 7 hints.
- **17 mocked publication API checks** pass, including unauthorized/forged/other-account rejection and validated public-content publication. No real media is uploaded by this harness.
- Signed release APK on an Android 16 emulator: **5 callback checks** pass (cold start, warm start, forged session, original HTTPS URL, duplicate parameters, safe error handling); no app crash observed.
- Live Supabase check: invalid email-link verification returns HTTP 303 to **`ketvoice://auth`** with an error fragment, not localhost. Auth configuration reads back the exact custom-scheme site URL and redirect allow-list.

# Ketvoice 2.6.0

- **Tablet-ready Liquid Glass:** the real window size decides the layout. A compact labelled rail appears at tablet widths, an expanded rail on wide landscapes, track grids gain columns, Explore tiles adapt, and Settings/import forms keep readable widths.
- **Two-pane player:** artwork and controls sit beside synchronized lyrics or the queue when the window has room. A short landscape window, such as a phone, keeps the single-pane landscape player instead of squeezing two panes.

- **Supplementary public lyrics:** imported TTML/LRC lyrics are published as a new public version and add a selectable **Ketvoice API** provider. Auto mode may use it when it answers within a short window, then falls back to the existing providers. Timing is preserved, never invented.
- **Server-enforced publishing:** a matching YouTube profile only reveals the entry point. The `ketvoice-content` broker re-checks the Supabase Auth user and its confirmed email on every write, rejects forged/unauthenticated requests, and performs validated uploads with a server-side service role.
